words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.ex: He watched the whole series of the show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完了这部剧的整个系列。
words.en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

words.ex: The movie shows a fantasy, not reality.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示的是幻想，而不是现实。
words.en: Reality is the state of things as they actually exist, rather than as they may appear or might be imagined.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: He completely forgot his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他完全忘记了钥匙。
words.en: In a way that is whole or entire; to the fullest extent.

words.ex: He left the room immediately after the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 铃声一响，他就立即离开了房间。
words.en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

words.ex: A problem arose during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议中出现了一个问题。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises, it begins to exist or people start to become aware of it.

words.tr: v. 完成；“finish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 完成的；完蛋的；
words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: Having completed or concluded an activity, task, or work.

words.ex: Call me whenever you need help.
words.ex_cn: 无论何时你需要帮助，就给我打电话。
words.en: at any or every time that

words.ex: You can eat anything you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: Any object, event, fact, etc., that is not specified or known.

words.ex: He expresses his feelings with words.
words.ex_cn: 他用语言表达自己的感受。
words.en: To convey or communicate a thought, feeling, or idea in words or by gestures and conduct.

words.ex: These industries make cars and phones.
words.ex_cn: 这些行业制造汽车和手机。
words.en: Industries are groups of companies that produce goods or provide services that are similar or related to each other.

words.ex: He hired a legal lawyer to help him.
words.ex_cn: 他请了一位法律律师来帮助他。
words.en: Relating to the law or to lawyers, or permitted or required by law.

words.tr: v. 接受；拿(走)；带领；乘坐；费时；吃；“take”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is taking the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受这份工作邀请。
words.en: The act of taking something, especially by force or by a legal process.

words.tr: v. 复制；生殖；复制( reproduce的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The photo was reproduced in the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片被复制到了杂志中。
words.en: To produce a copy of something; to make something happen again in the same way; (of living things) to produce young.

words.ex: It is impossible to finish the race in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 五分钟内完成比赛是不可能的。
words.en: If something is impossible, it cannot be done or cannot happen.

words.ex: The cost is proportional to the size.
words.ex_cn: 成本与大小成比例。
words.en: If one amount is proportional to another, the two amounts increase and decrease at the same rate so there is always the same relationship between them.

words.ex: This town has a peculiar custom of dancing at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有一个独特的午夜跳舞习俗。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as peculiar, you think that they are strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way.

words.tr: n. 进展；进步；缓慢前进；稳步前进；
words.ex: The project shows slow progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目进展缓慢。
words.en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

words.tr:
adj. 完整的；完成的；
v. 完成；
words.ex: The book is complete with all chapters.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有所有章节，是完整的。
words.en: If you complete something, you finish doing, making, or producing it.

words.tr:
n. 规则；统治；
v. 统治；
words.ex: The teacher made a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了一个新的作业规则。
words.en: A rule is a statement telling people what they should do in order to achieve success or a benefit of some kind.

words.ex: The plant grows quickly in sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在阳光下生长得很快。
words.en: To increase in size or amount, or to become more advanced or developed.

words.ex: The police opened an inquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An inquiry is a question which you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: He bought gold bullion as an investment.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了金条作为投资。
words.en: Gold or silver in bulk before coining, or valued by weight.

words.tr:
pron. 几个；一些；
adj. 不同的；
words.ex: I have several books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我桌上放着几本书。
words.en: Several means a number of people or things that is more than a few but not a lot.

words.ex: There is a tendency for people to use phones before bed.
words.ex_cn: 人们在睡觉前使用手机是一种趋势。
words.en: A tendency is a likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction, which is often bad or undesirable.

words.ex: The rules remained unchanged.
words.ex_cn: 这些规则没有改变。
words.en: If something is unchanged, it has stayed the same for a particular period of time.

words.ex: He is wholly responsible for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他完全对这个错误负责。
words.en: Completely or entirely.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.tr:
adj. 辅助的；附属的
n. 辅助物；附属物；助动词
words.ex: He used an auxiliary verb to form the past tense.
words.ex_cn: 他使用了一个助动词来构成过去时。
words.en: An auxiliary is a person or thing that provides additional help or support.

words.tr:
v. 通过；传递；路过；(时间)流逝；
n. 通行证；(考试)及格；
words.ex: He passed the exam with a high score.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: To move or go past someone or something; to transfer or hand over something to someone.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: I receive a letter from my friend every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周都收到朋友的一封信。
words.en: To get or be given something; to welcome someone officially or socially.

words.tr: v. 表现；表现( embody的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The dancer embodied joy through her movements.
words.ex_cn: 舞者通过她的动作表现了喜悦。
words.en: To embody something means to be a symbol or expression of that thing.

words.tr: adj. 即刻的；立即的；紧接的；最近的；
words.ex: He needs immediate help.
words.ex_cn: 他需要即刻的帮助。
words.en: An immediate action, event, or situation happens or exists without any delay.

words.tr:
v. 叫；打电话；
n. 打电话；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上叫他的狗。
words.en: If you call someone, you telephone them. If you call someone a particular name or title, you give them that name or title. If you call a meeting, you arrange for it to take place. If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr:
n. 术语；学期；期限；措辞；
v. 把…称作；把…叫做；
words.ex: The word 'algorithm' is a technical term in computer science.
words.ex_cn: ‘算法’是计算机科学中的一个术语。
words.en: A term is a word or expression used in relation to a particular subject, especially one that has a specific meaning, or a fixed period of time during which something lasts or is intended to happen.

words.tr:
v. 离开；离去；留下；
n. 休假；
words.ex: He will leave the room after class.
words.ex_cn: 他下课后会离开房间。
words.en: To go away from a place or a person.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.ex: Rain implies wet streets.
words.ex_cn: 下雨意味着街道会湿。
words.en: If something implies something else, it strongly suggests that it is the case.

words.ex: There are 745 markets in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有745个市场。
words.en: Places or systems where goods and services are bought and sold.

words.ex: Five apples constitute a basket.
words.ex_cn: 五个苹果构成一篮子。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.tr: v. 转移；调动；“transfer”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He transferred his money to a new bank.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱转到了一家新银行。
words.en: To move someone or something from one place, vehicle, person, or group to another.

words.tr:
adv. 另外；其他；
adj. 别的；其他的；
words.ex: I want tea, else coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我想喝茶，另外也想喝咖啡。
words.en: In addition to what has already been mentioned or considered.

words.tr: adj. 团结的；联合的；统一的； v. （使）团结；（使）联合；（使）统一；“unite”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The united team won the match.
words.ex_cn: 这个团结的团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: If people are united, they all agree about something or are working together for the same aim.

words.ex: Perhaps it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 或许明天会下雨。
words.en: You use perhaps to express uncertainty, for example, when you do not know that something is definitely true, or when you are mentioning something that may possibly happen in the future in the way you describe.

words.ex: Poor diet and lack of sleep are factors in his illness.
words.ex_cn: 饮食不良和睡眠不足是他生病的因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, a decision, or a situation.

words.ex: He has a monopoly on selling ice cream in this town.
words.ex_cn: 他在这座小镇上垄断了冰淇淋的销售。
words.en: If a company, person, or state has a monopoly on something such as an industry, they have complete control over it, so that it is impossible for others to become involved in it.

words.tr: n. 购买；购买的东西 v. 购买
words.ex: She made several purchases at the mall.
words.ex_cn: 她在商场买了几样东西。
words.en: Purchases refer to the act of buying something or the items that have been bought.

words.ex: The paper proves his ownership of the house.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件证明了他对这所房子的物主身份。
words.en: Ownership is the state or fact of owning something.

words.ex: He found an old manuscript in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆里发现了一份旧手稿。
words.en: A manuscript is a handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's first version of a book before it is published.

words.tr:
adj. 清楚的；明确的；清晰的；清澈的；晴朗的；
v. 清空；清除；放晴；使明确；
adv. 清楚地；彻底地；
words.ex: The instructions are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很清楚。
words.en: Free from anything that marks or darkens; transparent; bright; not obscure or ambiguous; easily understood; free from guilt or blame.

words.ex: He visits many places during his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行期间去了很多地方。
words.en: Places refer to specific areas or locations, which can be physical locations or positions within a sequence or order.

words.tr:
v. 工作；从事于……；运转；（使）干活；在……从事活动；
adj. 技术娴熟的；
words.ex: He worked in a factory last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年在工厂工作。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of work. To engage in physical or mental activity in order to achieve a purpose or result, especially in one's job; to function or operate.

words.ex: The car moved rapidly down the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车迅速地沿着道路行驶。
words.en: If something happens rapidly, it happens very quickly.

words.tr: adj. 再次发生的；再次兴起的；更新的； v. 更新；“renew”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The conflict was renewed after the peace talks failed.
words.ex_cn: 和平谈判失败后，冲突再次发生。
words.en: If something is renewed, it is made new again or replaced so that it is like new.

words.tr: v. 开始；“start”的现在分词； n. 开始；出发；
words.ex: He is starting his homework now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在开始做作业。
words.en: Starting refers to the act of beginning something, such as a process, activity, or journey.

words.tr: adj. 延长的；扩大范围的；延伸的；
words.ex: The meeting was extended by thirty minutes.
words.ex_cn: 会议被延长了三十分钟。
words.en: Made larger or longer than usual.

words.tr: adv. 自然地；理所当然地；
words.ex: Babies cry naturally when they are hungry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿饿了时会自然地哭。
words.en: in a natural manner; as a matter of course; by nature

words.ex: The bank recorded all transactions yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 银行昨天记录了所有交易。
words.en: Transactions are the actions or processes of buying, selling, or exchanging goods, services, or money.

words.ex: He seems tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后好像很累。
words.en: If something seems to be true, it appears to be true, although you cannot be certain.

words.ex: He likes coffee, whereas she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，然而她更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

words.ex: The company had many turnovers last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年有很多人员流动。
words.en: Turnovers refer to the amount of business done in a particular period, the number of times a particular asset is replaced, or the act of turning something over.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.ex: The two shirts are identical.
words.ex_cn: 这两件衬衫是一样的。
words.en: Exactly the same, or very similar.

words.ex: The French Revolution changed the government.
words.ex_cn: 法国大革命改变了政府。
words.en: A revolution is a sudden, extreme, or complete change in something, or the act of making such a change.

words.tr:
n. 头脑；意向；心；智力；
v. 介意；注意；
words.ex: He lost his mind after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了理智。
words.en: Your mind is your ability to think and reason. If you mind something, you are bothered by it or you object to it.

words.tr: n. 磨坊；磨粉机；磨坊( mill的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The old mills stand by the river.
words.ex_cn: 旧磨坊伫立在河边。
words.en: A mill is a building in which grain is crushed to make flour, or a factory where a particular substance is produced.

words.ex: The government took quick action to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 政府迅速采取行动解决问题。
words.en: The fact or process of doing something, typically to achieve an aim.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.tr: n. 重量；重物；重要性；负担；
words.ex: The weight of the box is 10 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是10公斤。
words.en: Weight is the force with which a body is attracted toward the earth or a celestial body by gravitation and which is equal to the product of the mass and the local gravitational acceleration.

words.ex: He uses simple methods to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.ex: He gradually learned to ride a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他渐渐学会了骑自行车。
words.en: If something changes or is done gradually, it changes or is done in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.ex: He gave careful consideration to his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的决定进行了仔细考虑。
words.en: Consideration is the process of giving careful thought to something before making a decision or taking action. It also refers to the quality of being thoughtful towards the needs and feelings of others.

words.ex: The accident was caused by human error.
words.ex_cn: 这起事故是由人为错误引起的。
words.en: If something causes an event, it makes it happen.

words.ex: He earned his masters in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了计算机科学硕士学位。
words.en: A master's degree is an advanced academic degree awarded by universities or colleges upon completion of a course of study demonstrating mastery or a high-order overview of a specific field of study or area of professional practice.

words.ex: He performs the task every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天执行这项任务。
words.en: To carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function; to present a form of entertainment such as a play, concert, or dance.

words.ex: Water is a common substance.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的物质。
words.en: A substance is a particular kind of matter with uniform properties.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.ex: The government provides free education.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供免费教育。
words.en: The group of people who officially control a country or the system used for controlling a country.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.ex: He listed the main points of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他列出了会议的主要要点。
words.en: A point is a detail, aspect, or quality of something or someone. It can also refer to the sharp end of something or a unit of scoring in games and sports. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending one's finger or something held in one's hand.

words.tr:
n. 中间；
adj. 中间的；
words.ex: The ball stopped in the middle of the field.
words.ex_cn: 球停在了场地的中间。
words.en: The middle of something is the part of it that is equally distant from its edges or outer limits.

words.tr:
n. 两倍；
v. 加倍；是…的两倍；把…对折；
words.ex: He earned a double of his salary last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月赚了两倍的薪水。
words.en: If something is double, it is twice as much or twice as many. If you double something, you make it twice as much or twice as many.

words.tr: adv. 早些时候；“early”的比较级； adj. 之前的；早期的；“early”的比较级；
words.ex: He left the party earlier.
words.ex_cn: 他早些时候离开了派对。
words.en: Before the present time or before the time one is referring to.

words.tr:
prep. 在...外；
n. 外面；外边；外部；
adv. 在外面；
adj. 外面的；外界的；
words.ex: The cat is sitting outside the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子外面。
words.en: The outer side or surface of something; not inside a building; external to a particular place or thing.

words.ex: They equally share the housework.
words.ex_cn: 他们同样分担家务。
words.en: In a manner that is the same in amount, degree, or value.

words.tr:
v. 包含；
vt. 包含；容纳；
words.ex: This box contains five apples.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子包含五个苹果。
words.en: If something such as a box, bag, room, or place contains things, those things are inside it.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: The package includes a free book.
words.ex_cn: 这个套餐包括一本免费的书。
words.en: If one thing includes another, it has the other thing as one of its parts.

words.ex: The proportions of water to flour are important in baking.
words.ex_cn: 水和面粉的比例在烘焙中很重要。
words.en: The correct, attractive, or ideal relationship in size, shape, or position between the different parts of something.

words.tr: n. 术语；条款；期间；学期；“term”的复数；
words.ex: The book explains the terms of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书解释了计算机科学的术语。
words.en: Terms refer to the conditions that are set for an agreement or the words used to describe specific things in a particular field.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.tr: v. 执行；表演；履行；执行( perform的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He performed the task quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速地执行了任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill something, such as a task or duty. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play or concert, to an audience.

words.ex: I like red ones more than blue ones.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢红色的那些，而不是蓝色的那些。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr: v. 需要； n. 需求；需要；“need”的复数；
words.ex: He needs help with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.ex: He uses his powers to help people in need.
words.ex_cn: 他运用自己的能力帮助有需要的人。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; the capacity or ability to direct or influence the behavior of others or the course of events.

words.ex: The farmers work in the fields every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫们每天早上在田里工作。
words.en: People who own or manage a farm.

words.ex: The movements for clean water grew stronger last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年，清洁用水的活动变得更强烈了。
words.en: Movements refer to the act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place. It can also denote a group of people working together to advance their shared political, social, or artistic ideas.

words.ex: He won three successive championships.
words.ex_cn: 他连续赢得了三届冠军。
words.en: Following one after the other without interruption.

words.ex: Manufactures in this country have grown rapidly.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的制造业增长迅速。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: I am ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 我准备好考试了。
words.en: If you are ready, you are prepared for something or are in a suitable state to do or deal with it.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.ex: The accident occurs on a rainy day.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生在雨天。
words.en: If something occurs, it happens.

words.tr: v. 构成；创立；使成形； adj. 成形的；制作（form 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The rocks formed the foundation of the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这些岩石构成了山的基础。
words.en: To form something means to make it into a particular shape or to create it.

words.tr:
v. 表达；表示；
adj. 明确的；
n. 特快列车；快件服务；
words.ex: He can express his feelings clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他能清楚地表达自己的感受。
words.en: If you express an idea or feeling, or express yourself, you show what you think or feel.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.tr: v. 离开；“leave”的过去式和过去分词； n. 左；左边； adj. 左边的； adv. 向左；在左边；
words.ex: He left the house early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上早早离开了家。
words.en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

words.tr: v. 采取；接受；拿；取；乘坐；吃；“take”的过去式；
words.ex: He took a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了一种新的方法来解决问题。
words.en: The past tense of 'take', which means to lay hold of something with one's hands; to reach for and hold.

words.ex: I visited my grandparents twice last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年我去了祖父母家两次。
words.en: Two times; on two occasions.

words.ex: He lives in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他住在巴黎。
words.en: The capital city of France, known for its art, fashion, gastronomy, and culture.

words.ex: Good food and sleep help maintain health.
words.ex_cn: 良好的饮食和睡眠有助于保持健康。
words.en: The condition of a person's body or mind, especially in terms of the presence or absence of illnesses, injuries, or impairments.

words.tr:
n. 输出；出口；
v. 输出；出口；
words.ex: This country is a big export of wheat.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家是小麦的大输出国。
words.en: To send goods to another country for sale.

words.ex: This new machine replaces the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器取代了旧的。
words.en: To take the place of something or someone; to substitute.

words.ex: The proceeds from the sale went to charity.
words.ex_cn: 销售所得收益捐给了慈善机构。
words.en: Proceeds are the money that is received from a particular event or activity, especially when it is used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: His conception of the new app was simple but clever.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新应用的构想简单而巧妙。
words.en: A conception is an idea or a plan that someone has in their mind.

words.tr: n. 外观；外表；出现；露面；
words.ex: The appearance of the house surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The way that someone or something looks or the act of coming into view.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.tr:
n. 硬币；金属钱币；
v. 创造；
words.ex: He has a coin in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有一枚硬币。
words.en: A coin is a small, flat, round piece of metal or plastic that is used as money.

words.tr: v. 假定；“assume”的现在分词； conj. 假定；假如；
words.ex: Assuming it rains, we will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 假定下雨，我们就待在家里。
words.en: If you describe someone as assuming, you are critical of them because they behave in a way that shows they think they are more important than other people.

words.ex: He likes reading books; moreover, he writes his own stories.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读书；此外，他还写自己的故事。
words.en: You use moreover to introduce a piece of information that adds to or supports the previous statement.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: He is creating a new painting.
words.ex_cn: 他正在创作一幅新画。
words.en: To bring something into existence.

words.tr: v. 调整；管制；“regulate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The government regulated the price of food.
words.ex_cn: 政府调整了食品的价格。
words.en: If an activity, process, or industry is regulated, it is controlled by rules or laws.

words.tr:
adj. 最坏的；最糟糕的；
n. 最坏的事；
words.ex: This is the worst day of my life.
words.ex_cn: 这是我生命中最糟糕的一天。
words.en: Superlative of bad: of the lowest quality, or the most unpleasant, difficult, or severe

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.tr: v. 向…提供（物资等）；供给；供给( supply的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The school supplied books to all students.
words.ex_cn: 学校向所有学生提供了书籍。
words.en: Provided with what is needed or wanted; furnished.

words.ex: He always follows the principle of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实的原则。
words.en: A principle is a basic idea or rule that explains or controls how something happens or works.

words.tr: v. 建立；确立；制订；使被安排好；“establish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 已确立的；
words.ex: They established a school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所学校。
words.en: If you use established to describe something such as an organization, you mean that it is officially recognized or generally approved of because it has existed for a long time.

words.ex: His determination helped him finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的决心帮助他完成了比赛。
words.en: Determination is the quality that you show when you have decided to do something and you will not let anything stop you.

words.tr: n. 银行业；银行业务； v. “bank”的现在分词；
words.ex: He works in banking in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事银行业。
words.en: Banking refers to the business activity of accepting and safeguarding money owned by other individuals and entities, and then lending out this money in order to earn a profit.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.tr: v. 获得；获得( obtain的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He obtained a scholarship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项奖学金。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.tr:
adj. 分开的；分离的；单独的；
v. 分离；隔离；
words.ex: They live in separate houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在分开的房子里。
words.en: To cause to move or be apart; to divide or keep apart.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.ex_cn: 他从不谈论过去。
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.tr:
v. 无所事事；闲荡
adj. 懈怠的；闲散的；不做事的
words.ex: He idles away the whole afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他整个下午都无所事事。
words.en: If you describe someone as idle, you mean they are not doing anything or they are not working hard.

words.ex: The project has three main stages.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目有三个主要阶段。
words.en: A stage is a particular point or period in the development or progress of something. It can also refer to a raised platform on which actors, entertainers, or speakers perform.

words.ex: Children depend on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

words.tr: v. 是…的成员；应被放在；
words.ex: He belongs to a book club.
words.ex_cn: 他是读书俱乐部的成员。
words.en: Is the property or possession of someone or something.

words.ex: He bought some securities to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一些证券来存钱。
words.en: Securities are financial instruments that represent an ownership position in a publicly-traded corporation (stock), a creditor relationship with governmental body or a corporation (bond), or rights to ownership as represented by an option.

words.tr: adj. 非物质的；无形的；不重要的
words.ex: The color is immaterial to the function.
words.ex_cn: 颜色对功能无关紧要。
words.en: If you say that something is immaterial, you mean that it is not important or not relevant.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.ex: He brings his lunch to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带午饭去上班。
words.en: To bring something means to carry or convey it to the place where you are or to the place you are talking about.

words.tr: n. 阶段；（月亮、行星的）位相；[化学]相( phase的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The project has three phases.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目有三个阶段。
words.en: Phases refer to distinct periods or stages in a process or development, or to the particular appearance of the moon or a planet at a given time.

words.tr: v. 雇用( employ的第三人称单数 ); 使用，利用
words.ex: The factory employs 50 workers.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂雇佣了50名工人。
words.en: If a person or company employs you, they pay you to work for them.

words.ex: The temperature decreases at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚温度降低。
words.en: If something decreases or if you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了头。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看；
n. 节目；演出；展览会；表现；
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To show something means to make it visible or to allow it to be seen. It can also refer to a performance or exhibition intended to entertain or educate.

words.tr:
n. 姓名；名称；
v. 说出…的名字；命名；
words.ex: His name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字是汤姆。
words.en: The word or words that a person, thing, or place is known by.

words.tr:
v. 生活；居住；活着；
adj. 活的；现场的；实况转播的；
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: To live means to be alive, to have your home in a particular place, or to spend your life in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.ex: There are different modes of transportation.
words.ex_cn: 有不同的出行方式。
words.en: Modes refer to the ways in which something is done or experienced, or the forms that something takes.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.ex: The class begins at eight.
words.ex_cn: 课程八点开始。
words.en: To start doing something; to take the first step in an activity or process.

words.tr: v. （使）参与；从事于；雇佣；“engage”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 忙着的；
words.ex: The teacher engaged the students in a group discussion.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们参与了一次小组讨论。
words.en: If you are engaged in an activity, you are doing it or involved in it. If you are engaged to someone, you have agreed to marry them.

words.ex: The old loom has wooden spindles.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧织布机有木制的纱锭。
words.en: A spindle is a rod or pin, typically one that rotates or on which something revolves, especially in a machine or a spinning wheel.

words.ex: The school organized a fun activity for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们组织了一场有趣的活动。
words.en: An activity is something that you spend time doing.

words.ex: He will continue walking after the break.
words.ex_cn: 休息后他会继续走路。
words.en: If someone or something continues to do something, they keep doing it and do not stop.

words.tr: n. 矿井；矿；矿( mine的名词复数 ) v. 在…中开采，开采( mine的第三；
words.ex: The workers went down into the mines to dig coal.
words.ex_cn: 工人们进入矿井挖煤。
words.en: Mines can refer to excavations in the earth for extracting coal, minerals, or precious stones, or to explosive devices placed in the ground or water to destroy enemy personnel or vehicles.

words.tr: n. 普通老百姓；民众；平民大众；普通老百姓，民众，平民大众（注意复数形式）；
words.ex: The masses want better healthcare and education.
words.ex_cn: 普通老百姓想要更好的医疗和教育。
words.en: The masses refer to the large body of people in a society or community, especially when regarded as a political or social force.

words.tr: n. 纺纱机；纺纱工；转盘
words.ex: The spinner turned wool into thread.
words.ex_cn: 这台纺纱机将羊毛纺成线。
words.en: A spinner is a person or machine that spins wool, cotton, or other material into thread or yarn.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.tr: v. 预先假定；以…为先决条件
words.ex: He presupposes that everyone knows the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他假定每个人都了解这些规则。
words.en: If one thing presupposes another, the first thing cannot be true or exist unless the second thing is true or exists.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.ex: Farmers grow wheat in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植小麦。
words.en: Wheat is a cereal plant that is grown in temperate countries and is the most important kind grown for food.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.ex: The economist predicts higher prices next year.
words.ex_cn: 这位经济学家预测明年价格会上涨。
words.en: An economist is a person who studies, teaches, or writes about economics.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.tr: v. 重新转换；重新改变信仰
words.ex: The old factory was reconverted into a museum.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧工厂被重新改造成了博物馆。
words.en: To convert something back to its original state or to a different state again.

words.ex: The boys are playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这些男孩正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: Boys are male children or young men.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 流动；
words.ex: The flow of water in the river is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 河里水的流动非常快。
words.en: To move along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

words.ex: His death made everyone very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的去世让所有人都很难过。
words.en: The end of the life of a person or organism.

words.ex: He did it out of spite.
words.ex_cn: 他出于恶意做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something out of spite, you do it because you want to hurt or upset someone.

words.ex: He lives in France.
words.ex_cn: 他住在法国。
words.en: A country in western Europe, known for its cultural heritage, including art, fashion, and cuisine.

words.tr: n. 影响；效果；效应；作用；“effect”的复数；
words.ex: The effects of pollution are harmful to animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染对动物有有害的影响。
words.en: Effects refer to the results or consequences of an action or other cause.

words.ex: He found a way whereby he could save money.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种借以省钱的方法。
words.en: You use whereby to introduce a clause in which you mention the means by which something happens.

words.ex: The aliquot part of the sample was used for analysis.
words.ex_cn: 样品的可分量部分用于分析。
words.en: An aliquot is a portion of a larger whole, especially a sample taken for chemical analysis or other testing.

words.tr: n. 生活必需品；日用品；生活必需品，日用品（注意复数）；
words.ex: The family bought supplies like food, water, and soap.
words.ex_cn: 这家人买了食物、水和肥皂等生活必需品。
words.en: Supplies are the things that are needed for a particular purpose or that are used or consumed in a particular situation.

words.ex: The bike has many components like wheels and pedals.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有很多部件，比如轮子和踏板。
words.en: Components are the parts that make up a whole system or machine.

words.ex: From my standpoint, this plan is too risky.
words.ex_cn: 从我的立场来看，这个计划太冒险了。
words.en: A standpoint is a particular way of considering something, or a particular attitude towards it.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.ex: The story includes an illustration of kindness.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事包含了一个善良的例证。
words.en: An illustration is a picture or diagram that helps make something clear or attractive.

words.ex: The small towns are quiet and peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 这些小镇安静而平和。
words.en: A town is a place with many streets and buildings, where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 上升的； v. 上升；提高；“rise”的现在分词； n. 上升；
words.ex: The rising sun warmed the earth.
words.ex_cn: 上升的太阳温暖了大地。
words.en: Going up, increasing, or becoming higher or greater.

words.tr: v. 重复；“repeat”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 重复的；反复发生的；
words.ex: He repeated the words after the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他跟着老师重复了这些话。
words.en: Something that is repeated happens or is done more than once.

words.ex: He bought the book for study purposes.
words.ex_cn: 他买这本书是为了学习目的。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.tr:
adj. 偏僻的；离群的；孤独的；内向的
v. 撤回；撤退；“withdraw”的过去分词
words.ex: The cabin is in a withdrawn area, far from the town.
words.ex_cn: 小木屋位于一个偏僻的地方，远离城镇。
words.en: If someone is withdrawn, they are very quiet, and do not want to talk to other people. If something is withdrawn, it is taken back or removed.

words.ex: The buildings are tall and old.
words.ex_cn: 这些建筑又高又旧。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.tr: v. 提到；说起；提到( mention的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He mentioned his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他提到了他去巴黎的旅行。
words.en: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

words.ex: He has possession of the keys.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这些钥匙。
words.en: The state of having, owning, or controlling something.

words.ex: The rain was continuous all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨一整天都在下个不停。
words.en: Something that is continuous happens or exists without stopping or being interrupted.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.tr:
prep. 沿着；
adv. 沿着；
words.ex: We walked along the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着河走。
words.en: If you move or look along something such as a road, you move or look towards one end of it.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.ex: The preceding chapter explains the basics.
words.ex_cn: 前一章解释了基础知识。
words.en: Existing or coming before something else in time, order, or importance.

words.ex: The workpeople finished their shift at five.
words.ex_cn: 工人们五点结束了班次。
words.en: Workpeople refers to the people who are employed to do physical or manual work, especially in a factory or other industrial setting.

words.tr: n. 约翰（男性名）；俚语指厕所；
words.ex: John is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 约翰是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A male given name.

words.ex: He hurt his body while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤到了身体。
words.en: The physical structure of a person or an animal, including the bones, flesh, and organs.

words.ex: My feet hurt after walking all day.
words.ex_cn: 我走了一整天，脚很疼。
words.en: The plural of foot, which is the lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks. Also, a unit of linear measure equal to 12 inches (30.48 cm).

words.tr:
adj. 接近的；亲密的；
adv. 紧挨地；接近地；
v. 关闭；
words.ex: They are close friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们是亲密的朋友。
words.en: To move so as to bar passage through something; to shut.

words.ex: The rain brings cool air.
words.ex_cn: 雨带来了凉爽的空气。
words.en: To bring something means to carry or convey it to the place where you are or to the place you are talking about.

words.ex: The outlay for the new computer was high.
words.ex_cn: 这台新电脑的花费很高。
words.en: An outlay is an amount of money that you have to spend in order to buy something or to start a project.

words.tr:
n. 未来；将来；前途；
adj. 将来的；未来的；
words.ex: We cannot predict the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们无法预测未来。
words.en: The future is the time after the present, or the events that will happen then.

words.tr: n. 数字；人物；体形；“figure”的复数；
words.ex: The figures show a rise in sales this month.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字显示本月销售额有所上升。
words.en: A figure is a number or a person, especially a well-known one. It can also refer to a shape or form, especially that of a person.

words.tr: v. 出现；呈现，出现，发生( arise的现在分词 )；
words.ex: Problems are arising from the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 新政策出现了问题。
words.en: Resulting or emerging from something.

words.tr: n. 国家（nation 的复数）; n. （Nations）人名；（英）内申斯
words.ex: The nations signed a peace agreement.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家签署了一项和平协议。
words.en: Sovereign states or large communities of people with a common identity and government.

words.ex: He lives in Ireland.
words.ex_cn: 他住在爱尔兰。
words.en: Ireland is an island in the North Atlantic. It is separated from Great Britain to its east by the North Channel, the Irish Sea, and St George's Channel. Ireland is the second-largest island of the British Isles, the third-largest in Europe, and the twentieth-largest on Earth.

words.tr: adj. 打算中的；有意的； v. 打算；“intend”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The intended plan was to go hiking.
words.ex_cn: 打算中的计划是去徒步旅行。
words.en: If something is intended for a particular purpose, it has been planned to fulfill that purpose.

words.ex: The landlords raised the rent last month.
words.ex_cn: 房东上个月提高了租金。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns and rents land such as a house, apartment, or condo.

words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.ex: He bought food and water, the basic necessities.
words.ex_cn: 他买了食物和水，这些基本必需品。
words.en: Necessities are things that you must have in order to live properly or do something.

words.tr: n. 代表；推销员；销售代表；发言人；
words.ex: He is the rep for our team.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们团队的代表。
words.en: A rep is a person who acts on behalf of a group or organization, especially in selling products or services.

words.ex: He played the role of a teacher in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中扮演了老师的角色。
words.en: The function or position that someone has in a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.ex: The main reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The most important part or aspect of something.

words.ex: The car moved at a rapid speed.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以迅速的速度行驶。
words.en: A rapid change or event happens very quickly.

words.ex: He begins his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: To start doing something; to take the first step into a process or activity.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.tr: adj. 更短的；更矮的；“short”的比较级；
words.ex: This rope is shorter than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这根绳子比那根更短。
words.en: Comparative of short: having a small distance from one end to the other.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的过去式和过去分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school provides free lunch to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If a particular condition is true or if a particular event happens, then another condition will be true or another event will happen.

words.ex: The plant develops quickly in sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在阳光下迅速成长。
words.en: If you develop something, you make it grow, change, or become more advanced.

words.ex: There are numerous books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: If people or things are numerous, they exist or are present in large numbers.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；连接的； v. 连接；“connect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two events are connected.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是相关的。
words.en: If one thing is connected with another, there is a link or relationship between them.

words.tr: prep. 包括；包含； v. 包括；包含；“include”的现在分词；
words.ex: The package includes apples, bananas, and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹包括苹果、香蕉和橙子。
words.en: You use including to introduce examples of people or things that are part of the group of people or things that you are talking about.

words.ex: The book has a short introduction at the beginning.
words.ex_cn: 这本书开头有一段简短的引言。
words.en: The act of presenting something new to someone or something, or the process of making something known or familiar to people.

words.ex: The war ended last year.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争去年结束了。
words.en: A war is a period of fighting or conflict between countries or states.

words.ex: The child is playing with toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个儿童正在玩玩具。
words.en: A child is a human being who is not yet an adult.

words.tr: v. 包含；容纳；认为；保存；把握；拿；
words.ex: This box holds all my books.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子装着我的所有书。
words.en: To have or keep in the hand; keep fast; grasp; to contain or be capable of containing.

words.ex: The gross income of the company is $5 million.
words.ex_cn: 公司的总收入是500万美元。
words.en: If you describe something as gross, you mean it is very obvious, unacceptable, or unpleasant.

words.tr: v. 有关；看待； n. “regard”的复数；
words.ex: This letter regards your application.
words.ex_cn: 这封信与你的申请有关。
words.en: Regards can be used to express good wishes or respect towards someone, or to refer to the way in which someone or something is considered or judged.

words.tr: adj. 增加的；增长的；增强的； v. 生长；成长；种植；渐渐变成；“grow”的现在分词； n. 成长；
words.ex: The growing demand for clean water is a big problem.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水日益增加的需求是一个大问题。
words.en: Increasing in size or amount; developing.

words.ex: She resolves to start exercising every day.
words.ex_cn: 她决定每天开始锻炼。
words.en: To resolve means to find a solution to a problem or to make a firm decision about something.

words.tr: v. 讲话；发言；“speak”的现在分词； n. 谈话；演讲； adj. 交谈的；
words.ex: He is speaking to his friend on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他正在打电话和朋友讲话。
words.en: The act of talking or making speeches in public.

words.tr: adv. 社会上；交际上；以社会方式地；
words.ex: He is socially active in his community.
words.ex_cn: 他在社会上积极参与社区活动。
words.en: In a way that relates to society or its organization.

words.ex: The country enjoys prosperity after years of peace.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在多年的和平后迎来了繁荣。
words.en: Prosperity is a condition in which a person, community, or country is thriving and successful, especially in financial terms.

words.tr: n. （一）套；集；凝固( set的名词复数 )； v. 放；
words.ex: He bought a new set of tools for his workshop.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车间买了一套新工具。
words.en: Sets can refer to a collection of items or the act of placing or fixing something in a specific position or condition.

words.tr: adj. 纯的；纯净的；纯粹的；
words.ex: She drank pure water from the spring.
words.ex_cn: 她喝了从泉水中取的纯净水。
words.en: Something that is pure is clean and does not contain any harmful substances.

words.ex: The room has a bed and a window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.tr:
adj. 最终的；最后的；
n. 决赛；
words.ex: This is the final answer.
words.ex_cn: 这是最终的答案。
words.en: Last in a series or coming at the end of a process.

words.tr:
adj. 法国的；法国人的；法语的；
n. 法语；法国人；
words.ex: She ate french bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了法国面包。
words.en: relating to France, its people, or its language

words.tr: adj. 活跃的；积极的；主动的；
words.ex: He is an active student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上是一个活跃的学生。
words.en: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

words.ex: He accepted a nominal fee for the service.
words.ex_cn: 他为这项服务收取了微不足道的费用。
words.en: If you say that something is nominal, you mean that it is very small in comparison to the real value or importance of something.

words.tr: v. 扩大；扩张；更充分地阐述；“expand”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The company expanded its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司扩大了业务到其他国家。
words.en: If something expands or is expanded, it becomes larger.

words.ex: His monthly expenses are too high.
words.ex_cn: 他的月支出太高了。
words.en: Expenses are the costs incurred in the process of doing something or the money spent on something.

words.ex: The earthquake had magnitudes of 7.0 on the Richter scale.
words.ex_cn: 这次地震的震级为里氏7.0级。
words.en: Magnitudes refer to the size, extent, or importance of something, often used in scientific contexts to describe the scale or intensity of phenomena.

words.ex: The new legislation bans plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法规禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: Legislation refers to the process of making or enacting laws by a government or other authority.

words.ex: The improvements in his English helped him pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他英语的改善帮助他通过了考试。
words.en: Improvements are changes that make something better or more satisfactory.

words.tr: v. 举行；持有；抓住；保存；容纳；“hold”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The school held a science fair last week.
words.ex_cn: 学校上周举行了一场科学展览会。
words.en: To have or keep in the hand; keep fast; grasp; to have or possess, as something in one's power or control.

words.tr:
conj. 直到；
prep. 直到；
words.ex: He waited till the rain stopped.
words.ex_cn: 他一直等到雨停。
words.en: Until a particular time or event.

words.tr: n. 场地；院子( yard的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The children played in the yards after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在场地上玩耍。
words.en: A unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 meters, often used for measuring land.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书五英镑。
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.tr:
n. 循环；周期；自行车；
v. 骑自行车；循环；
words.ex: The water cycle is important for nature.
words.ex_cn: 水循环对自然界很重要。
words.en: A cycle is a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order or a bicycle.

words.ex: The rainwater drains into the street.
words.ex_cn: 雨水排入街道。
words.en: If you drain something, you remove the liquid from it, usually by pouring it away or by allowing it to flow away. If something drains, the liquid flows away from it.

words.ex: He loaned me his car for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的车借给了我周末使用。
words.en: To loan means to give something to someone for a period of time, expecting it to be returned, or to lend money.

words.tr: v. 付费；偿还；付酬；“pay”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is paying for his coffee with cash.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用现金支付他的咖啡。
words.en: Paying can refer to the act of giving money for goods or services, or it can describe something that is profitable or yields a return.

words.tr:
v. 位于；站立；忍受；
n. 立场；站立；摊位；站立；
words.ex: The castle stands on a hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡位于一座山上。
words.en: To be in an upright position on the feet; to be situated in a particular place; to tolerate or endure.

words.ex: He ate two pieces of bread.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了两片面包。
words.en: A piece is a part or a section of something larger, or an individual item that is considered separately from the whole.

words.ex: The train runs on the railway.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A railway is a route between two places along which trains travel on steel rails.

words.ex: The importance of homework is clear.
words.ex_cn: 作业的重要性是显而易见的。
words.en: The quality or state of being important; significance.

words.tr: v. 区分；“distinguish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 卓越的；著名的；
words.ex: He distinguished the fake coin from the real one.
words.ex_cn: 他把假硬币和真硬币区分开来。
words.en: If you describe a person or their work as distinguished, you mean that they have been very successful in their career and have a good reputation.

words.ex: Is this your book?
words.ex_cn: 这是你的书吗？
words.en: Belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.tr:
v. 看；看上去；
n. 看；
words.ex: He looks at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看着天空。
words.en: To direct your eyes in a particular direction.

words.ex: He finds a hidden key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他在垫子下发现了一把隐藏的钥匙。
words.en: To discover something or someone after searching.

words.ex: The accident occurred yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something occurs, it happens.

words.tr: n. 线；界线；绳；（剧本中的）台词；“line”的复数；
words.ex: The artist drew straight lines on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家在纸上画了直线。
words.en: Lines can refer to long, narrow marks or bands, a connected series of people or things, or the words an actor speaks in a performance.

words.tr: v. 变成；成为；变得；“become”的过去式；
words.ex: He became a teacher after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后成为一名老师。
words.en: the past tense of 'become', which means to begin to be something

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr: n. 话语；话语( remark的名词复数 )； v. 谈论；评论；
words.ex: His remarks made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他的话让大家笑了。
words.en: Comments or observations made about something or someone.

words.tr: v. 编织；编制；“weave”的现在分词；
words.ex: She is weaving a blanket with colorful threads.
words.ex_cn: 她正在用彩色线编织一条毯子。
words.en: The act or process of forming something by combining various elements in a complex or intricate way, especially the process of making fabric by interlacing threads on a loom.

words.ex: The Amazon River is in America.
words.ex_cn: 亚马逊河位于美洲。
words.en: The term 'America' can refer to the United States of America or the continents of North America and South America collectively.

words.ex: The railways connect many cities in the country.
words.ex_cn: 铁路连接了这个国家的许多城市。
words.en: A railway is a route between two places along which trains travel on steel rails.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.ex: The parliament passed a new law about education.
words.ex_cn: 国会通过了一项关于教育的新法律。
words.en: A parliament is a legislative body of government, typically composed of elected representatives, that is responsible for making laws and representing the interests of the people.

words.ex: There are altogether five apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上面总共有五个苹果。
words.en: Altogether is used to emphasize that something is completely the case or to indicate the total number or amount of something.

words.tr:
n. 种类；类别；
v. 理清；解决；把…分类；拣选；
words.ex: This store sells all sorts of fruits.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。
words.en: A sort is a kind or category of things or people which have similar characteristics.

words.ex: He adds sugar to his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他给咖啡加糖。
words.en: To add is to join or combine numbers or amounts to calculate a total, or to put something with something else to increase the size, number, or importance of it.

words.tr: v. 增加；引起；筹募；提起；养育；
words.ex: The company will raise wages next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将提高工资。
words.en: To raise something means to move it to a higher position or to increase it in amount or level.

words.tr: adv. 完全地；充分地；彻底地；
words.ex: He fully understands the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他完全理解这个问题。
words.en: Completely or entirely; to the fullest extent.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.tr: vi. 衍生；导出；起源；由来；由来 v. 得到( derive的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: This word is derived from Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这个词源自拉丁语。
words.en: If you say that something is derived from a particular source, you mean that it comes from that source.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.tr: v. 提升；饲养；筹募；增加；“raise”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is raising his voice to be heard.
words.ex_cn: 他提高声音以便被人听到。
words.en: The act of increasing something in amount or size, or the process of bringing up and educating children.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with one exception.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都通过了考试，只有一个例外。
words.en: An exception is a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.ex: The weather is favourable for a picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气对野餐有利。
words.en: If your opinion or your reaction is favourable to something, you agree with it and approve of it.

words.ex: The books are sorted into different categories.
words.ex_cn: 这些书被分成了不同的类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things, people, or ideas that have similar characteristics.

words.tr: v. 分发；分配；“distribute”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher distributed the books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师把书分发给学生们。
words.en: If things are distributed, they are spread out or shared among a group of people or over an area.

words.ex: The study uses quantitative data to measure results.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究使用定量数据来测量结果。
words.en: Relating to, measuring, or measured by the quantity of something rather than its quality.

words.ex: He is a pro player in esports.
words.ex_cn: 他是电子竞技的专业选手。
words.en: A pro is someone who is professional in a particular activity or sport, or someone who supports a particular idea or course of action.

words.ex: He reads a book, whilst she listens to music.
words.ex_cn: 他读书，而她听音乐。
words.en: Whilst means the same as 'while'. It is used in British English.

words.tr:
n. 服务；
v. 保养；
words.ex: The restaurant offers excellent service.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅提供出色的服务。
words.en: The act of helping or doing work for someone; a system that provides something the public needs, such as transport, communications, or utilities.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability or potential to do it.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；“source”的复数；
words.ex: Water comes from natural sources like rivers and rain.
words.ex_cn: 水来自河流和雨水等自然来源。
words.en: Sources refer to the origins or places from which something comes or is obtained. They can be people, books, documents, etc., that provide information.

words.ex: The new policy was effected immediately.
words.ex_cn: 新政策立即生效了。
words.en: To bring about or cause something to happen.

words.ex: The decision was made in accordance with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定是按照规则做出的。
words.en: Agreement or harmony; conformity.

words.ex: The connection between the two wires is loose.
words.ex_cn: 两根电线之间的连接松了。
words.en: A connection is a relationship between two things, people, or groups.

words.ex: The funds were appropriated for the new project.
words.ex_cn: 这些资金被挪用于新项目。
words.en: To take something for one's own use, typically without the owner's permission.

words.ex: His words are a contradiction.
words.ex_cn: 他的话是矛盾的。
words.en: A contradiction is a situation or statement in which two aspects or elements are opposed to each other, making it impossible for both to be true at the same time.

words.ex: The children are of different ages.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子的年龄不同。
words.en: Ages refers to a very long time or the period of history that is being referred to.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.ex: He pays high rents for his apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城市里的公寓支付高额租金。
words.en: Rents refer to payments made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: He placed the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: To put something in a particular position or location.

words.ex: The agents helped the client find a house.
words.ex_cn: 这些代理人帮助客户找到了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.tr: v. 改善；改进；“improve”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 改良的；改进的；
words.ex: He improved his English by practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天练习改善了自己的英语。
words.en: If something improves or if you improve it, it gets better.

words.ex: Hitherto, no one has solved the problem.
words.ex_cn: 迄今为止，没有人解决过这个问题。
words.en: Until now or until the point in time under discussion.

words.tr: v. 完成；“complete”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 完整的；已完成的；
words.ex: He completed his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: Having all necessary or normal parts, components, or steps; fully carried out or accomplished.

words.ex: The outcome is depending on your effort.
words.ex_cn: 结果依赖于你的努力。
words.en: If you say that something depends or is depending on something else, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

words.ex: He frequently visits his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他经常去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If something happens frequently, it happens often.

words.tr: adj. 丰饶的；富有的；富裕的；
words.ex: The land is rich in minerals.
words.ex_cn: 这片土地矿物丰富。
words.en: Having a great deal of money or assets; wealthy.

words.tr: adj. 已知的；知名的；出了名的； v. 知道；认识；“know”的过去分词；
words.ex: This is a known fact.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个已知的事实。
words.en: Recognized, familiar, or within the scope of knowledge.

words.tr: v. 下降；跌倒；“fall”的过去分词； adj. 落下的；
words.ex: The leaf fallen from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 叶子从树上落了下来。
words.en: Having dropped or come down from a higher place, often used to describe leaves, snow, or someone's moral state.

words.ex: The worker fixed the machine quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位工作者迅速修好了机器。
words.en: A worker is a person who does a particular job to earn money.

words.ex: I nearly missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上差点没赶上公交车。
words.en: Almost, but not quite; very close to.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.tr:
adj. 美国的；美洲的；
n. 美国人；美洲人；
words.ex: She bought an American car.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一辆美国车。
words.en: relating to the United States of America or its people, culture, or language

words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.tr: v. 强迫，使不得不( compel的过去式和过去分词 ); 引起反应
words.ex: He was compelled to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他被迫说出了真相。
words.en: If a situation, a rule, or a person compels you to do something, they force you to do it.

words.ex: There was a big improvement in his English skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平有了很大改进。
words.en: The act of making something better or the state of being made better; an example or instance of this.

words.tr: adj. 丢失的； v. 丢失；输；“lose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The lost keys were found under the table.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙在桌子下面找到了。
words.en: If you are lost, you do not know where you are or you are unable to find your way.

words.tr:
adj. 额外的；
n. 额外的事物；
adv. 额外地；
words.ex: He did extra work to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他做了额外的工作来赚更多的钱。
words.en: If something is extra, it is added to an existing amount or number.

words.tr:
n. 出口商品；
v. 出口；
words.ex: The country's exports include electronics and textiles.
words.ex_cn: 该国的出口商品包括电子产品和纺织品。
words.en: Goods or services sold to another country.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: Inasmuch as the weather is good, we will have the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 由于天气好，我们将举行野餐。
words.en: You use inasmuch as to introduce a reason for a particular statement or to say to what extent you agree with or accept something.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.ex_cn: 这栋高楼有20层。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.ex: I sometimes walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 我有时走路去学校。
words.en: At times; occasionally.

words.ex: The strange phenomena in the forest puzzled scientists.
words.ex_cn: 森林中奇怪的现象让科学家们感到困惑。
words.en: A phenomenon is something that is observed to happen or exist, especially something interesting or unusual.

words.ex: The diminution of water in the lake is obvious.
words.ex_cn: 湖中水量的减少是显而易见的。
words.en: A diminution of something is its reduction in size, importance, or intensity.

words.tr: v. 陪伴；伴随；伴奏（accompany 的过去分词）； adj. 伴随的；相伴的；
words.ex: He was accompanied by his friend to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他由朋友陪伴去公园。
words.en: If you accompany someone, you go somewhere with them.

words.ex: The project finally materialised after months of planning.
words.ex_cn: v. 经过数月的规划，这个项目终于实现了。
words.en: To materialise means to become actual fact; to happen or become real.

words.tr: n. 勋爵；主；上帝；统治者；
words.ex: The lord lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位勋爵住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A lord is a man who has a high rank in the nobility, especially in Britain, or a man who has authority or control over others.

words.ex: The turns of the wheel made the car move.
words.ex_cn: 车轮的转动使车前进。
words.en: Actions or movements that change direction or position, or opportunities to act in a sequence.

words.tr: adj. 封建的；封建制度的
words.ex: The land was owned by feudal lords.
words.ex_cn: 土地由封建领主拥有。
words.en: Relating to, resembling, or characteristic of feudalism.

words.tr: n. 危机；危急关头；“crisis”的复数；
words.ex: The country faced many crises last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家经历了许多危机。
words.en: A crisis is a time of great difficulty, danger, or suffering, especially in politics or economics.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: This apple differs from that one in color.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个苹果的颜色不同。
words.en: To be unlike or dissimilar; to have a different character or quality.

words.ex: He learned about slavery in history class.
words.ex_cn: 他在历史课上学到了奴隶制。
words.en: Slavery is the system by which people are owned by other people as slaves.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.ex: He lives in Scotland.
words.ex_cn: 他住在苏格兰。
words.en: Scotland is a country that is part of the United Kingdom, known for its distinct culture, history, and landscapes.

words.tr: v. 影响；“affect”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 染病的；受感动的；
words.ex: The rain affected the game.
words.ex_cn: 雨影响了比赛。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as affected, you disapprove of the fact that they behave in an unnatural way that is intended to impress other people.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.ex: The separation of the two chemicals caused a reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质的分离引起了反应。
words.en: The act of separating or the state of being separated.

words.ex: Each individuals has unique thoughts.
words.ex_cn: 每个个体都有独特的想法。
words.en: Individuals are single human beings as distinct from a group, class, or family.

words.ex: The calculation took only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这个计算只花了五分钟。
words.en: The process of using mathematics to find a number or amount.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.tr: v. 保持；保管；“keep”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She kept the room clean every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天保持房间干净。
words.en: Kept is the past tense and past participle of keep. To keep something means to have it or continue to have it in your possession, or to store it somewhere because you might need it later.

words.ex: He seems tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后似乎很累。
words.en: If something seems to be a particular way, it appears to be that way.

words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.ex: The company's sales increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 该公司上个月的销售额增加了。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: He returned home after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后回家了。
words.en: Having come back or been sent back to a place or person.

words.tr: v. 决定；“determine”的现在分词； adj. 决定性的；
words.ex: The teacher is determining the final grades.
words.ex_cn: 老师正在决定最终成绩。
words.en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: v. 吸引；"draw"的过去分词；画；拉；提取；“draw”的过去分词；
words.ex: The bright colors drawn the children's attention.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引了孩子们的注意。
words.en: If someone looks drawn, their face is thin and they look very tired, ill, worried, or unhappy.

words.tr: n. 工具；刀具；器具；“tool”的复数；
words.ex: He uses simple tools to fix the chair.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的工具修理椅子。
words.en: Tools are objects such as hammers, screwdrivers, or saws that you use to help you do a particular type of work.

words.ex: They have mutual respect for each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此相互尊重。
words.en: Mutual is used to describe a situation, feeling, or action that is experienced, felt, or done by each of two or more parties towards the other or others.

words.tr: n. 编织者（weaver 的复数）; n. （Weavers）人名；（英）韦弗斯
words.ex: The weavers were known for their intricate patterns.
words.ex_cn: 这些编织者以其复杂的图案而闻名。
words.en: People who weave fabric or textiles, especially as a trade.

words.tr: v. 应用；申请；适用；“apply”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 应用的；实用的；
words.ex: He applied the new method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他应用了这个新方法来解决问题。
words.en: Applied means relating to or put to practical use, especially in a particular field.

words.tr: adj. 偏远的；隔离的；孤独的； v. 使隔离；“isolate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The village is isolated, far from any city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄很偏远，远离任何城市。
words.en: If something is isolated, it is far away from other places, buildings, or people.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: The students made exchanges of books after class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在课后进行了书籍交换。
words.en: The act of giving one thing and receiving another in return; a place where people meet to buy and sell goods or securities.

words.ex: He always follows the principles of honesty and fairness.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实和公平的原则。
words.en: A principle is a general belief that you have about the way you should behave, which influences your behavior.

words.tr: n. 检查员( inspector的名词复数 ); （英国公共汽车或火车上的）查票员; （警察）巡官
words.ex: The inspectors checked the building for safety.
words.ex_cn: 检查员检查了建筑物的安全状况。
words.en: An inspector is a person whose job is to inspect something, especially in order to check that it meets legal or official standards.

words.ex: This is her book.
words.ex_cn: 这是她的书。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a female person or animal previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: The young athlete demonstrated a great vis during the competition.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻的运动员在比赛中展现了极大的活力。
words.en: A prefix meaning 'see' or 'look at'.

words.tr:
n. 东方；
adj. 东方的；
adv. 在东方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun rises at the equinoxes, on the right-hand side of a person facing north.

words.ex: He started his project anew after the failure.
words.ex_cn: 失败后，他重新开始了他的项目。
words.en: If you do something anew, you do it again, often in a different way from before.

words.ex: He came to school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天来学校了。
words.en: The past tense of come, meaning to move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker.

words.ex: The boy rides a horse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩每天早上骑马。
words.en: A horse is a large animal which people can ride. Some horses are used for pulling ploughs and carts.

words.ex: He is the author of this book.
words.ex_cn: 他是这本书的作者。
words.en: An author is a person who writes books, stories, or articles, especially as a job.

words.ex: He traveled to Europe last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了欧洲。
words.en: Europe is one of the world's seven continents, comprising the westernmost peninsula of Eurasia. It's known for its rich history, diverse cultures, and significant contributions to art, science, and politics.

words.tr: v. 应付；“deal”的现在分词； n. 交易；
words.ex: He is dealing with a difficult boss.
words.ex_cn: 他正在应付一个难搞的老板。
words.en: Dealing refers to the way in which someone behaves towards other people or the way in which someone does business.

words.ex: The country buys many imports from other nations.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家从其他国家购买许多进口商品。
words.en: Imports refer to goods or services that are brought into one country from another for sale. It can also mean the process of bringing these goods or services into a country.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.ex: He explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地解释了这道数学题。
words.en: To make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.ex: The establishment of the school took five years.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的建立花了五年时间。
words.en: The act of establishing something or the state of being established. It can also refer to an organization or institution, especially a business or public body.

words.ex: He is the tallest in his class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班里最高的。
words.en: suffix. Used to form the superlative degree of adjectives and adverbs.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.tr: n. 代理；副职；恶习；缺点；
words.ex: He acted as vice for the manager during her absence.
words.ex_cn: 在经理缺席期间，他担任代理。
words.en: A vice is a moral fault or weakness in someone's character.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；褶；
v. 折叠；
words.ex: The paper has a deep fold in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸中间有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies flat on top of another part; to be able to be bent in this way.

words.ex: He had a good idea to fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想到了一个修自行车的好主意。
words.en: An idea is a thought, plan, or suggestion about what to do, or a belief or opinion.

words.tr: v. 注意；备注；“note”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 著名的；闻名的；显著的；
words.ex: He noted the time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他记下了会议的时间。
