words.ex: Thousands of people watched the concert.
words.ex_cn: 成千上万的人观看了这场音乐会。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of a hundred and ten; 1,000.

words.ex: The old dwellings were small but cozy.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧住处虽然小，但很温馨。
words.en: Dwellings are houses or places where people live.

words.ex: He overcame many obstacles to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了许多障碍，完成了比赛。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.tr: v. 预先假定；预料；以…为先决条件
words.ex: He presupposes that everyone likes coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他假设每个人都喜欢咖啡。
words.en: If one thing presupposes another, the first thing cannot be true or exist unless the second thing is true or exists.

words.ex: The company will compensate you for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 公司会因延误而补偿你。
words.en: If you compensate for a lack of something or for something you have done wrong, you do something to show that you are sorry or that you are trying to make things better.

words.tr: v. 包含；控制；控制( contain的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The box is containing all my books.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子装着我所有的书。
words.en: To have something inside or include something as a part.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.tr: v. 补偿；补偿（compensate 的过去式）；
words.ex: He was compensated for his lost time.
words.ex_cn: 他因失去的时间得到了补偿。
words.en: If you compensate for something, you give something or do something to make up for it.

words.ex: The translation of the book took two months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的翻译花了两个月。
words.en: The process of translating words or text from one language into another.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.tr: n. 出神；心不在焉；抽象
words.ex: He sat by the window in abstraction, staring at the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边出神，凝视着云朵。
words.en: An abstraction is a general idea rather than one that is based on a specific real thing or event.

words.tr: v. 预料；“anticipate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 预期的；
words.ex: He anticipated the rain and brought an umbrella.
words.ex_cn: 他预料到会下雨，所以带了伞。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.tr: n. 分解；分裂；溶解；解体；解除；死亡
words.ex: The dissolution of sugar in water is quick.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中的分解很快。
words.en: The act or process of ending or breaking up an organization, agreement, or legal arrangement.

words.ex: He lost consciousness after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了意识。
words.en: The state of being aware of and able to think about oneself, one's surroundings, and one's experiences.

words.ex: The amount of sugar is proportionally increased with the amount of flour.
words.ex_cn: 糖的量随着面粉的量成比例增加。
words.en: In a way that corresponds in size or amount to something else.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.ex: The fish swim in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海里游泳。
words.en: The sea is the salty water that covers about three-quarters of the Earth's surface.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.ex: He practiced the pas every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习这个舞步。
words.en: A step in dancing, especially in ballet.

words.tr: n. 少许；小块；片刻； v. “bite”的过去式；
words.ex: Can you give me a bit of sugar?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我一点点糖吗？
words.en: A bit is a small piece or quantity of something.

words.tr:
n. 废墟；
v. 破坏；
words.ex: The old temple is now a ruin.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙现在已成为废墟。
words.en: Ruin means the physical destruction or disintegration of something or the state of disintegrating or being destroyed.

words.tr:
v. 费力地做；苦干；跋涉
n. 苦工；劳累的工作
words.ex: He toils in the field every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在田里辛苦劳作。
words.en: If you toil, you work very hard doing something that is difficult or tiring.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.ex: The meeting runs smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 会议进行得很顺利。
words.en: To move quickly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride; to operate or function.

words.tr: n. 半挂车；（一侧与其他建筑相连的）半独立式的住宅
words.ex: The truck driver parked the semi near the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 卡车司机把半挂车停在了仓库附近。
words.en: A semi is a trailer that is attached to the back of a truck and is used for transporting goods.

words.tr: v. 无法做到；失败；不及格；倒闭；
words.ex: He failed to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他没能完成比赛。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.ex: The park has many quiet areas for reading.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园有许多安静的区域可以读书。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a town, a country, a region, or the world.

words.ex: The baker makes bread every morning.
words.ex_cn: 面包师每天早上都做面包。
words.en: A baker is a person whose job is to bake bread, cakes, or pastries.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.ex: His birth was in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: The emergence of a baby or other young from the body of its mother; the start of life as a physically separate being.

words.ex: He reads the bible every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读《圣经》。
words.en: The Bible is the holy book of Christianity, consisting of the Old Testament and the New Testament.

words.tr:
adj. 零下的；负的；
n. 缺点；
prep. 减去；
words.ex: The temperature is minus ten degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 气温是零下十摄氏度。
words.en: A minus is a mathematical symbol that represents subtraction or a negative quantity.

words.tr: v. 交；递；（非正式）（使）轻松得到（hand 的过去式及过...；
words.ex: He handed the book to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把书交给了他的朋友。
words.en: Having a hand or hands. Used to describe someone's preference or ability in using a particular hand.

words.tr: v. 失败；无法做到；不及格；“fail”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He failed the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他数学考试没及格。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.ex: He learned a new phrase in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一个新的西班牙语短语。
words.en: A phrase is a short group of words that people often use as a way of saying something. The meaning of a phrase is often not obvious from the meaning of the individual words in it.

words.tr: v. 移动；“move”的现在分词；搬家； adj. 运动的；感人的；动人的；可移动的；
words.ex: The boy is moving his toy car.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩正在移动他的玩具车。
words.en: If something is moving, it makes you feel strongly touched or emotional.

words.ex: He is an expert in the domain of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 他是人工智能领域的专家。
words.en: A domain is a particular field of thought, activity, or interest, especially one over which someone has control, influence, or rights.

words.ex: He walked toward the door.
words.ex_cn: 他朝门走去。
words.en: In the direction of; in relation to; near to; for the purpose of.

words.tr: v. 显示；表现；展示；“show”的过去式；
words.ex: The graph showed the increase in temperature.
words.ex_cn: 图表显示了温度的上升。
words.en: The past tense and past participle of 'show', which means to make something visible or noticeable.

words.tr: v. 买得起；担负得起；有时间做；
words.ex: I can't afford a new car.
words.ex_cn: 我买不起一辆新车。
words.en: If you cannot afford something, you do not have enough money to pay for it.

words.ex: She took a glance at the clock.
words.ex_cn: 她瞥了一眼钟。
words.en: If you glance at something or someone, you look at them very quickly and then look away again immediately.

words.ex: The statute says drivers must stop at red lights.
words.ex_cn: 这项法律规定司机必须在红灯时停车。
words.en: A statute is a formal written law of a country or state, enacted by its legislative authority.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.ex: He is learning quantum physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习量子物理。
words.en: In physics, a quantum is the minimum amount of any physical entity involved in an interaction.

words.tr: v. 开始；创立；创始；发动（机器）；开动；出发，启程（start 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: He started his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: If you start to do something, you do something that you were not doing before and you continue doing it.

words.ex: He felt sad after the failure of his business.
words.ex_cn: 他的生意失败后，他感到很难过。
words.en: The lack of success in achieving or doing something.

words.ex: The concept of freedom is important in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 自由这个观念在许多国家都很重要。
words.en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

words.ex: The country has a budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年这个国家的预算不足额。
words.en: A deficit is the amount by which something, especially a sum of money, is too small.

words.tr: n. 图画；绘画；制图； v. 提取；吸引；画；“draw”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child made a drawing of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A drawing is a picture made with a pencil, pen, or crayon rather than paint.

words.ex: The creditor asked for the money back.
words.ex_cn: 债权人要求把钱还回来。
words.en: A creditor is a person or organization to whom money is owed.

words.tr: v. 承认；许可进入； adj. 许可进入( admit的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He admitted he made a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认自己犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.ex: He read the first three chapters of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的前三章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.ex: The underground passages connect the two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 地下通道连接了这两座建筑。
words.en: A passage is a long narrow space with walls or fences on both sides, which connects one place or room with another.

words.ex: The water supply is adequate for the village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对这个村庄来说是足够的。
words.en: If something is adequate, there is enough of it or it is good enough to be used or accepted.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.tr: v. 扔；抛；掷；投； n. 投掷运动；投( throw的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is throwing the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: The act of propelling something with force through the air by a movement of the arm and hand.

words.ex: The magician makes the rabbit vanish.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师让兔子消失了。
words.en: To disappear suddenly and completely.

words.ex: Everyone likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 每个人喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: You use everyone or everybody to refer to all the people in a particular group.

words.tr: adj. 不需要特殊技能的；
words.ex: He took an unskilled job at the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 他在仓库找了一份不需要特殊技能的工作。
words.en: If someone is unskilled, they have no particular training or skill for a job.

words.tr: adv. 完美地；圆满地；完全地；
words.ex: She sang perfectly in the concert.
words.ex_cn: 她在演唱会上唱得完美极了。
words.en: In a perfect manner; completely or entirely.

words.tr: n. 享受；乐趣；乐事；享有；
words.ex: She finds enjoyment in reading books.
words.ex_cn: 她从读书中获得享受。
words.en: The pleasure that you get from something.

words.ex: The company announced that it would pay dividends to its shareholders next month.
words.ex_cn: 该公司宣布下个月将向股东支付股息。
words.en: A dividend is a sum of money paid regularly by a company to its shareholders out of its profits.

words.tr: v. 显示，表明；n. 清单，载货单
words.ex: The data manifests a significant increase in sales.
words.ex_cn: 数据显示销售额有显著增长。
words.en: To manifest something means to show it clearly and visibly. As a noun, a manifest is a list of passengers or cargo on a ship or aircraft.

words.tr: adv. 有名无实地；名义上地
words.ex: He is nominally the boss, but others make the decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他名义上是老板，但实际决策由别人做出。
words.en: If something is nominally true, it is true according to the name or title, but it may not really be true in fact.

words.tr: adv. 准确地；精确地；正确地；
words.ex: He measured the length accurately.
words.ex_cn: 他准确地测量了长度。
words.en: In a way that is correct or exact.

words.ex: He worked hard to accomplish his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的目标。
words.en: To accomplish something means to succeed in doing it, especially after a lot of effort.

words.tr: v. 起源于，来自，产生( originate的第三人称单数 ); 创造; 创始; 开创
words.ex: This tradition originates in ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: If something originates from a particular place or time, it starts to exist or happen in that place or at that time.

words.tr:
adj. 结束的；结论的
v. 推断出；得出结论；结束；“conclude”的现在分词
words.ex: The concluding chapter summarized the entire book.
words.ex_cn: 最后一章总结了整本书的内容。
words.en: If you say that something is concluding, you mean it is the last part of a process, event, or piece of writing.

words.tr: v. 规定；开药方；“prescribe”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 规定的；法定的；
words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for the cough.
words.ex_cn: 医生规定了治疗咳嗽的药物。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.tr: v. 记得；回忆起；“remember”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I remembered my mother's birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我记得我妈妈的生日。
words.en: Kept in one's memory; not forgotten.

words.tr: n. 熟练工；学徒期满的工人
words.ex: The journeymen were responsible for training the new apprentices.
words.ex_cn: 熟练工负责培训新学徒。
words.en: A journeyman is a worker who has completed an apprenticeship and is fully qualified in a trade or craft.

words.ex: The two kids stayed in equilibrium on the seesaw.
words.ex_cn: 两个孩子在跷跷板上保持了平衡。
words.en: A state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced.

words.ex: It is advantageous to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 早起是有利的。
words.en: If something is advantageous to you, it is likely to benefit you.

words.tr: adv. 跟经济有关地；经济地；
words.ex: The country is developing economically.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在经济上发展。
words.en: In a way that relates to economics or finance; in a way that uses no more of something than is necessary.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；附近地区；
words.ex: We know all our neighbours in this neighbourhood.
words.ex_cn: 我们认识这个街坊里的所有邻居。
words.en: A neighbourhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.ex: The children laughed spontaneously when they saw the puppy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到小狗时自发地笑了。
words.en: If something happens spontaneously, it happens without being planned or organized, or without any external influence.

words.ex: The industrialists invested heavily in new technology.
words.ex_cn: 工业家们在新技术上投入了大量资金。
words.en: Industrialists are people who own or manage large industrial companies or who have a lot of influence in industry.

words.ex: The boy is playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: A boy is a male child or a young male person.

words.tr: v. 遇见；见面；满足；“meet”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I met my friend at the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园里遇见了我的朋友。
words.en: Met is the past tense and past participle of meet. To meet someone means to come into their presence by chance or arrangement.

words.ex: She sees a bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 她看见树上有一只鸟。
words.en: To perceive with the eyes; to understand or realize something.

words.ex: The North Pole is covered with ice all year round.
words.ex_cn: 北极全年都被冰雪覆盖。
words.en: A pole is a long, thin, rounded piece of wood or metal, used especially for supporting things.

words.ex: The children play in the yard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在院子里玩耍。
words.en: A yard is an area of land next to a building, often with grass and plants, or a unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 meters.

words.ex: He bought a flower for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的妻子买了一朵花。
words.en: A wife is a married woman considered in relation to her husband.

words.ex: He tries to run every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早晨试图跑步。
words.en: If you try to do something, you make an effort to do it.

words.tr:
v. 打破；打断；
n. 休息；中断；破裂；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打破了玻璃。
words.en: If you break something, you cause it to separate into two or more pieces, often in a way that is irreparable.

words.tr: n. 观点；见解；“view”的复数； v. 审视；
words.ex: His views on education are very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的观点与我的非常不同。
words.en: The way in which someone sees or considers something; an opinion or belief.

words.tr: v. 处理；“deal”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He dealt with the problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速处理了这个问题。
words.en: If you deal with a particular person or organization, you have business or social contact with them.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.tr:
adj. 白色的；
n. 白色；
words.ex: The white cat sat on the windowsill.
words.ex_cn: 白色的猫坐在窗台上。
words.en: White is the lightest color and is achromatic (having no hue), because it fully reflects and scatters all the visible wavelengths of light.

words.ex: He is aware of the danger.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到危险。
words.en: If you are aware of something, you know about it.

words.ex: He has a habit of waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他有早起的习惯。
words.en: A habit is something that you do often or regularly.

words.tr:
pron. 哪里
adv. 从哪里；从何处
n. 根源；来处
words.ex: The traveler asked whence the river flowed.
words.ex_cn: 旅行者问这条河从何处流来。
words.en: from what place, source, or cause; from where

words.ex: The poorer families need more help.
words.ex_cn: 更穷的家庭需要更多的帮助。
words.en: Comparative of poor; having less money or fewer possessions than someone else, or than you had before; of a lower quality or standard than someone or something else.

words.ex: He lives in Russia.
words.ex_cn: 他住在俄罗斯。
words.en: A country in Eastern Europe and Northern Asia, known for its vast territory and rich history.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 大约；到处；在附近；环绕；
words.ex: The children are running around the tree.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在树周围跑。
words.en: In a position or direction surrounding, or in the vicinity of, a particular place or thing.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；无偿的
adv. 免费地；无偿地
words.ex: You can download the software gratis from the company's website.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从公司网站免费下载该软件。
words.en: If something is done or given gratis, it is done or given without payment.

words.tr: adj. 隐藏的； v. 隐藏；“hide”的过去分词；
words.ex: The keys are hidden under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: If something is hidden, it is not easily noticed or found.

words.tr:
n. 修理；修补；
v. 修理；修补；
words.ex: The repair of the car took two days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的修理花了两天时间。
words.en: To repair something that is damaged or not working properly means to fix it.

words.ex: He thinks it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他认为明天会下雨。
words.en: If you think that something is the case, you have the opinion that it is the case.

words.tr: adj. 统治的；支配的； v. “rule”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ruling class controls the government.
words.ex_cn: 统治阶级控制着政府。
words.en: A ruling is an official decision made by a judge or court, or a decision made by someone in authority.

words.ex: The cows graze in the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Pasture is land covered with grass where animals such as cows and sheep can graze.

words.ex: The abolition of serfdom in Russia was a significant social change.
words.ex_cn: 俄罗斯废除农奴制是一个重大的社会变革。
words.en: Serfdom is the status of peasants under feudalism, specifically relating to manorialism. It was a condition of bondage or modified slavery which developed primarily during the High Middle Ages in Europe and lasted in some countries until the mid-19th century.

words.ex: The shops are in the town centres.
words.ex_cn: 商店在城镇中心。
words.en: A centre is a point or part that is equally distant from all sides, ends, or surfaces of something; the middle. It can also refer to a place where a particular activity or service is concentrated.

words.tr: n. 模样；面貌；方面；朝向；“aspect”的复数；
words.ex: The aspects of the old house still look charming.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子的外貌仍然很迷人。
words.en: a particular part or feature of something

words.ex: The doctor treated his disease with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生用药物治疗了他的疾病。
words.en: A disease is an illness that affects people, animals, or plants, often caused by infection or a failure of health rather than by an accident.

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

words.ex: He handles the company's affairs carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他小心地处理公司的事务。
words.en: Affairs refer to matters or events that are of public or personal concern, often involving complex issues or relationships.

words.ex: Females are more likely to study biology than physics.
words.ex_cn: 女性更有可能学习生物而不是物理。
words.en: Females are individuals of the sex that can bear offspring or produce eggs, distinguished biologically by the production of gametes (ova) that can be fertilized by male gametes.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.tr: v. 适应；改编；“adapt”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 适合…的；改编成…的；
words.ex: The fish adapted to the cold water.
words.ex_cn: 这种鱼适应了冷水。
words.en: If something is adapted to a particular situation or purpose, it is especially suitable for it.

words.tr: v. 恢复；“restore”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 恢复的；复原的；
words.ex: The old house was restored to its original state.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子被恢复到了原来的状态。
words.en: If something that has been lost or stolen is restored to its owner, it is returned to them.

words.ex: The scarcity of water caused problems in the village.
words.ex_cn: 水的缺乏给村庄带来了问题。
words.en: A scarcity of something is a situation in which there is not enough of it.

words.tr: v. 清除；“clear”的现在分词； n. 空旷地；
words.ex: They are clearing the leaves from the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在清除院子里的树叶。
words.en: A clearing is an open area in a forest where there are no trees or bushes.

words.ex: The temperature rose steadily throughout the day.
words.ex_cn: 白天温度稳定地上升。
words.en: If something happens or changes steadily, it happens or changes in a regular way without interruption.

words.tr: adj. 有准备的；准备好的； v. 准备；预备；“prepare”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was prepared for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他为考试做好了准备。
words.en: If you are prepared for something, you are ready for it or have made plans in advance to deal with it.

words.ex: The tea contains natural extracts from herbs.
words.ex_cn: 这种茶含有来自草本植物的天然提取物。
words.en: Extracts are substances that have been obtained from a source material, often by using a solvent or other method of separation. They can also refer to selected passages from a text.

words.ex: The scholarship afforded her the opportunity to study abroad.
words.ex_cn: v. 奖学金为她提供了出国留学的机会。
words.en: If you are afforded something, it is given to you or made available to you.

words.ex: The breaking of the ice caused a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 冰的破裂发出了一声巨响。
words.en: The act of breaking something; a pause or interruption in continuity.

words.ex: He felt tired after the exertion of running up the hill.
words.ex_cn: 在努力跑上山后，他感到很累。
words.en: The use of physical or mental energy; hard work.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.ex: The governor signed the new law yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 州长昨天签署了这项新法律。
words.en: A governor is a person who is responsible for the political administration of a region, such as a state or a colony.

words.tr: v. 需要；要求；“require”的现在分词；
words.ex: This job is requiring more time than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要比预期更多的时间。
words.en: If something is required, it must be had or obtained because it is necessary or very important.

words.ex: He is comparing the prices of two phones.
words.ex_cn: 他正在比较两部手机的价格。
words.en: To compare means to examine or look for the differences and similarities between two or more things.

words.tr: n. （任何面值上的）扣除额；贴现( discount的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The store offers discounts on all summer clothes.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店对所有夏季服装提供折扣。
words.en: A discount is a reduction in the usual price of something.

words.ex: He was realising his mistake too late.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到自己的错误时已经太晚了。
words.en: to become aware of or understand something; to achieve something you wanted

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: The simplicity of the design makes it easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这种设计的简单使它容易使用。
words.en: The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do.

words.ex: The study reached two main conclusions.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究得出了两个主要结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result. When you write a paper, you always end by summing up your arguments and drawing a conclusion.

words.tr: adj. 逐渐减少的； v. 减少；减损；“diminish”的现在分词；
words.ex: The diminishing supply of water causes problems.
words.ex_cn: 逐渐减少的水资源供应引发了问题。
words.en: Becoming smaller or less; decreasing.

words.tr: n. 义务；债务( obligation的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He must fulfill his obligations to his family.
words.ex_cn: 他必须履行对家庭的义务。
words.en: An obligation is a duty or commitment that someone is required to fulfill, often legally or morally.

words.ex: The tailor made small alterations to the dress.
words.ex_cn: 裁缝对裙子做了些小修改。
words.en: Changes or modifications made to something.

words.ex: The room has good ventilation through the windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间通过窗户有良好的通风。
words.en: The provision of fresh air to a room, building, etc., or the system that does this.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.tr: v. 保持；保养；坚持；保持( maintain的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is maintaining his health by exercising daily.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天锻炼来保持健康。
words.en: To maintain something means to continue to have it, and to ensure that it remains in good condition or working order.

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: The institutions help students learn math.
words.ex_cn: 这些机构帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.ex: He showed appreciation for her hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的辛勤工作表示欣赏。
words.en: Recognition of the quality, value, significance, or magnitude of people and things.

words.ex: He appropriates the money for his own use.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱挪作己用。
words.en: To take something for one's own use, typically without the owner's permission.

words.tr:
adj. 成比例的；相应的；相称的
v. 使成比例；使适应
words.ex: The punishment should be proportionate to the crime.
words.ex_cn: 惩罚应当与罪行相称。
words.en: If one thing is proportionate to another, it increases or decreases according to the changes in the other thing, and there is a sensible relationship between them.

words.tr: n. 兑换; 可改变性，可变化性
words.ex: The convertibility of the currency is crucial for international trade.
words.ex_cn: 货币的兑换性对国际贸易至关重要。
words.en: The quality of being able to be changed or exchanged into something else, especially a currency.

words.tr:
adv. 不；不仅如此；而且 
n. 反对票
words.ex: They said nay to the proposal.
words.ex_cn: 他们对提议投了反对票。
words.en: Used to introduce a more precise or explicit statement, or to emphasize a point just made.

words.tr:
adj. 缓慢的；迟钝的；
v. 使减速；
words.ex: The slow car moved across the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 那辆缓慢的车驶过桥。
words.en: Moving or capable of moving only at a low speed; not fast.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A king is a man who is the most important member of the royal family of his country, and who is considered to be the head of state of that country.

words.ex: The dog is huge.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很大。
words.en: Extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: The garden was often described as an earthly Eden.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园常常被描述为人间的伊甸园。
words.en: In the Bible, Eden is the garden where Adam and Eve lived. By extension, it can refer to any place of pristine or abundant natural beauty.

words.ex: Children tend to be more active in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子往往在早上更活跃。
words.en: If someone tends to do something, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.ex: He reads books every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读书。
words.en: To look at and understand the meaning of written or printed words or symbols.

words.tr:
adj. 黑色的；
n. 黑色；
words.ex: He wore a black shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件黑色的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is black is of the darkest colour that there is, the colour of the sky at night when there is no light at all.

words.ex: He cited a book in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在文章中引用了一本书。
words.en: To cite something means to quote it or mention it, especially as an example or proof of what you are saying.

words.tr:
n. 十分之一；第十；
adj. 第十的；
words.ex: He ate a tenth of the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了蛋糕的十分之一。
words.en: The tenth item in a series is the one that you count as number ten.

words.tr: n. 标记；记号；“mark”的复数； v. 做标记；
words.ex: The teacher put marks on the paper to show correct answers.
words.ex_cn: 老师在纸上做了标记来表示正确答案。
words.en: Marks can refer to symbols or signs used to indicate something, grades or scores given to students' work, or physical traces left by something. As a verb, it means to make a mark on something, to grade or score something, or to pay attention to something.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.tr:
v. 计算；看作；清点；
n. 计数；计算；
words.ex: He counts the apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他计算桌子上的苹果数量。
words.en: To determine the total number of a collection of items.

words.ex: Jones is a teacher at the local school.
words.ex_cn: 琼斯是当地一所学校的老师。
words.en: A common surname or given name; also used informally to refer to a person.

words.ex: I did it myself.
words.ex_cn: 我自己做的。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself as the object of a verb or preposition when he or she is the subject of the clause.

words.tr: v. 出发；开始；起动；开办；
words.ex: He starts at six every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上六点出发。
words.en: To begin something or to cause something to begin.

words.ex: I expect a gift on my birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我期待在生日时收到一份礼物。
words.en: If you expect something, you believe that it is likely to happen or that it will be the case.

words.tr: int. 谢谢； n. 感谢；“thank”的复数；
words.ex: Thanks for helping me.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢你帮我。
words.en: an expression of gratitude

words.ex: George likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 乔治喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A male given name, derived from the Greek name Georgios, meaning 'farmer' or 'earth-worker'.

words.ex: The rain rendered the road slippery.
words.ex_cn: 雨水使道路变得滑溜。
words.en: To render something means to cause it to become or to provide it. It can also mean to express or translate something.

words.tr: v. 寻求；“seek”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He sought help from his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向老师寻求帮助。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.ex: The park is in the centre of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园在城市的中心。
words.en: The centre of something is the middle of it.

words.ex: He chose the lesser price.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了更少的价格。
words.en: You use lesser to indicate that something is smaller in extent, degree, or amount than another thing that has been mentioned.

words.tr: n. 行会；协会；同业公会
words.ex: The guilds in medieval Europe were powerful organizations.
words.ex_cn: 中世纪的欧洲行会是强大的组织。
words.en: A guild is an association of artisans or merchants who oversee the practice of their craft or trade in a particular area.

words.ex: The government does a census every ten years.
words.ex_cn: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查。
words.en: A census is an official count or survey of a population, typically recording various details of individuals.

words.ex: The teacher allows students to use calculators.
words.ex_cn: 老师允许学生使用计算器。
words.en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

words.tr: v. 强迫；推行； adj. 自己担负的 v. 强迫( impose的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The government imposed a new tax on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府强迫征收了一项新的糖税。
words.en: If you impose something on people, you use your authority to force them to accept it.

words.ex: She expends a lot of energy on her daily workouts.
words.ex_cn: 她每天锻炼消耗大量能量。
words.en: To expend means to use or spend resources such as time, money, or energy.

words.ex: He rightly answered the question.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了这个问题。
words.en: If you say that someone rightly does something, you mean that it is morally or legally correct for them to do it.

words.ex: He is the creator of that popular game.
words.ex_cn: 他是那个流行游戏的创作者。
words.en: A creator is someone who brings something into existence, especially someone who invents or designs something new.

words.ex: The professor's marxian approach to economics emphasizes class struggle.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授的马克思主义经济学方法强调阶级斗争。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of the theories of Karl Marx, especially in economics and politics.

words.tr: v. 提供，供给，供应( provide的第三人称单数 )；
words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

words.ex: He normally goes to bed at 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他通常晚上10点睡觉。
words.en: If you say that something normally happens or that you normally do a particular thing, you mean that it is what usually happens or what you usually do.

words.tr: adj. 漂浮的； v. “float”的现在分词；
words.ex: The floating leaves drifted on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 漂浮的叶子在湖面上飘荡。
words.en: Something that is floating is not fixed in one place or position but moves around or is easy to move.

words.tr: v. 接受；“accept”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 公认的；
words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: Generally agreed to be correct or satisfactory.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.tr: n. 平衡；余额；v. 使平衡；结算
words.ex: She balances her work and personal life very well.
words.ex_cn: 她很好地平衡了工作和个人生活。
words.en: A balance is a situation in which different elements are equal or in the correct proportions. It can also refer to the amount of money in a bank account or the act of keeping something steady.

words.tr: v. 操作；经营；运转； adj. 运转( operate的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He operated the machine carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他小心地操作了这台机器。
words.en: To operate means to control the functioning of a machine, process, or system, or to perform a surgical operation.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.ex: He ate a moderate amount of food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了适量的食物。
words.en: If you moderate something or if it moderates, it becomes less extreme or violent, or if you moderate a discussion, you help the people in it to reach an agreement.

words.tr: n. 英国货币；英镑；标准纯银；银制品；
words.ex: He paid for the book with sterling.
words.ex_cn: 他用英镑支付了这本书的费用。
words.en: Sterling is used to describe something of very high quality or value. It can also refer to British money or a standard of purity for silver.

words.tr: n. 生物体；有机体；有机组织；
words.ex: A bacterium is a simple organism.
words.ex_cn: 细菌是一种简单的生物体。
words.en: An organism is a living thing that has an organized structure, can react to stimuli, reproduce, grow, adapt, and maintain homeostasis.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: The distance between the two towns is 10 kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 两个城镇之间的距离是10公里。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things.

words.ex: This is the smallest apple in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 这是篮子里最小的苹果。
words.en: The superlative form of 'small', meaning the least in size or amount.

words.ex: She remarked on the beauty of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 她评论了日落的美丽。
words.en: To say something as a comment; to notice or observe something.

words.tr:
n. 住宅；住所
v. 居住；栖身；沉湎于；“dwell”的现在分词
words.ex: He lives in a small dwelling near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一个小住所里。
words.en: A dwelling is a place where someone lives, such as a house or apartment.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；“reflect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The lake reflected the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 湖面映出了山峦。
words.en: If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.tr: adj. 禁止的；不许的； v. “forbid”的过去分词；
words.ex: The forbidden area is off-limits to visitors.
words.ex_cn: 这个禁止区域对游客关闭。
words.en: If something is forbidden, you are not allowed to do it or have it.

words.tr:
adj. 疏远的；不合群的
v. 使疏远；离间；转让；“alienate”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He felt alienated after his friends stopped talking to him.
words.ex_cn: 他的朋友们不再和他说话后，他感到被疏远了。
words.en: Feeling isolated or estranged from a group or activity to which one should belong or in which one should be involved.

words.ex: He is virtually always on time.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是准时。
words.en: In effect though not formally recognized; practically.

words.ex: They used mediation to solve their argument.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过调解解决了争端。
words.en: Mediation is a process in which a neutral third party helps two or more parties in a dispute to reach a mutually acceptable agreement.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: The book describes a small village in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这本书描写了一个山中的小村庄。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.tr: v. 取代；“displace”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The new robot displaced the worker on the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 新机器人取代了装配线上的工人。
words.en: Forced to leave their home, especially because of war or a natural disaster.

words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To originate means to have a specific beginning or to start something.

words.ex: The lab has a new apparatus for measuring temperature.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有一台新的温度测量装置。
words.en: The complex structure of a particular system or organization, or the equipment used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He maintains his daily exercise routine.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天锻炼。
words.en: To maintain something means to continue to have it, and to ensure that it remains in good condition or in good health.

words.tr:
adj. 文明的；开化的；有法制伦理的
v. 使开化；使文明；教化；“civilise”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: In a civilised society, everyone respects the rights of others.
words.ex_cn: 在一个文明的社会中，每个人都尊重他人的权利。
words.en: A civilised person or society is polite and reasonable, and has a well-organized system of government, laws, etc.

words.ex: The cat disappeared behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫从房子后面消失了。
words.en: If someone or something disappears, they go away or are taken away so that you cannot see them any more.

words.tr: v. 设想；构想；怀孕；想出；想出( conceive的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He conceived a new plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他设想了一个新的省钱计划。
words.en: To conceive means to form or devise a plan or idea in the mind, or to become pregnant.

words.ex: He is analysing the data to find patterns.
words.ex_cn: 他正在分析数据以寻找模式。
words.en: If you analyse something, you consider it carefully or use statistical methods in order to fully understand it.

words.tr: n. 丰富；充实；浓缩；富集
words.ex: The school offers enrichment activities for gifted students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为天才学生提供拓展活动。
words.en: The act of improving or enhancing the quality or value of something.

words.tr:
n. 代用品；代替物；
v. 替代；
words.ex: Honey is a good substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是糖的良好代用品。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another.

words.ex: Please tell me beforehand if you can't come.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不能来，请提前告诉我。
words.en: If you do something beforehand, you do it earlier than a particular event.

words.ex: The stringency of the rules made it hard to pass.
words.ex_cn: 规则的严格性使得通过很难。
words.en: Stringency refers to the quality or condition of being strict, severe, or rigorous, especially in relation to rules or standards.

words.ex: He followed the directions to find the park.
words.ex_cn: 他按照方向找到了公园。
words.en: Directions refer to the way in which someone or something moves, faces, or is aimed; guidance or instruction on how to do something or reach a place.

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.ex: His opinion is subordinate to the manager's.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见比经理的次要。
words.en: If someone is your subordinate, they have a less important position than you in the organization that you both work for.

words.ex: His knowledge of history is superficial.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史的了解是表面的。
words.en: If you describe someone as superficial, you disapprove of them because they do not think deeply, and have little understanding of anything serious or important.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.tr: v. 使改观；使改变形态；使改变外观（或性质）；改变( transform的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The new paint is transforming the old house.
words.ex_cn: 新油漆正在使这所旧房子改观。
words.en: To change something completely, usually to improve it.

words.ex: The two companies made combinations to develop new technology.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司合作开发新技术。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of different things or people.

words.ex: The phone calls caused many interruptions.
words.ex_cn: 电话造成了许多打扰。
words.en: Interruptions refer to the act of stopping something from continuing in its usual way by causing a break or a pause.

words.ex: The characteristics of this animal include long legs and big ears.
words.ex_cn: 这种动物的特征包括长腿和大耳朵。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: He works hard, and correspondingly, he gets good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，相应地，他取得了好成绩。
words.en: In a way that corresponds to something else; in a corresponding manner.

words.ex: He lives in a big city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个大城市里。
words.en: A city is a large town where many people live and work.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.tr:
v. 停止；阻止；
n. 停止；阻止；车站；停留；
words.ex: He stopped walking when he saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到狗时，他停止了走路。
words.en: If you stop something from happening, you prevent it from happening or prevent it from continuing.

words.tr: n. 头部；头脑；上端； v. （无释义）； adj. 上端( head的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The baby touched his heads with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝用双手摸了摸自己的头部。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or top part of an animal's body, containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs; the person in charge of a group or organization; the side of a coin that bears the image of a head.

words.ex: The cow eats straw from the barn.
words.ex_cn: 牛吃谷仓里的稻草。
words.en: A straw is a thin tube of paper or plastic that you use to suck a drink into your mouth.

words.ex: We had a small party last Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期六举办了一个小型聚会。
words.en: A party is a social gathering of invited guests, typically involving eating, drinking, and entertainment.

words.tr: n. 扶手；围栏；铁路；栏杆( rail的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He held the rails while walking up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼梯时扶着扶手。
words.en: A rail is a fixed bar, for example one that is used as a support or to prevent people from falling. A rail is also a metal bar that trains run along.

words.tr: adj. 更老的；更旧的；更年老的；“old”的比较级；
words.ex: My older brother works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥年纪更大一些，是一名老师。
words.en: Comparative of old; having lived or existed for a longer time; more aged.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.tr:
adj. 次要的；轻微的；小的；小调的；
n. 未成年人；
words.ex: The mistake was a minor error.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是一个小错误。
words.en: A minor is a person who is under the age at which they legally become an adult.

words.ex: The queen's reign lasted 70 years.
words.ex_cn: 女王的统治持续了70年。
words.en: The period during which a sovereign rules; to hold royal office; to prevail

words.tr:
n. 睡眠；
v. 睡觉；
words.ex: He needs more sleep to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他需要更多的睡眠来感觉好些。
words.en: Sleep is the natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed, your body is inactive, and your mind is unconscious.

words.tr: v. 销声匿迹；突然消失；
words.ex: The magic trick made the coin vanish.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让硬币销声匿迹了。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.tr:
adj. 女性的；雌性的；
n. 雌性；女性；
words.ex: The female teacher is very kind.
words.ex_cn: 这位女老师非常和蔼。
words.en: A female is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs.

words.tr: v. 重视；“value”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被尊重的；
words.ex: I valued his advice during my hard time.
words.ex_cn: 我在困难时期很重视他的建议。
words.en: considered to be important or beneficial; cherished

words.ex: He is a member of the school club.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校俱乐部的成员。
words.en: A member is a person who belongs to a group such as a club, organization, or team.

words.ex: He lives in a small county in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他住在乡村的一个小郡里。
words.en: A county is a region of a country used for administrative or other purposes in certain modern nations.

words.ex: He expended all his money on food.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的钱都花在了食物上。
words.en: To expend something, especially energy, time, or money, means to use it or spend it.

words.tr: n. 结束；结局； v. 结束；“end”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ending of the movie was surprising.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的结束令人惊讶。
words.en: The final part of something, especially a story, movie, or play.

words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.tr: v. 轻击球；放置（put的现在分词）；轻击球（putt的现在分词）；
words.ex: He is putting the ball into the hole.
words.ex_cn: 他正在轻击球进洞。
words.en: To move something to a particular place or position, especially using your hands.

words.tr:
v. 诈骗；骗取
n. 诈取；骗局
words.ex: He tried to swindle money from old people.
words.ex_cn: 他试图欺骗老人的钱。
words.en: To swindle means to deceive someone in order to get money or possessions from them dishonestly.

words.ex: Ideally, we should finish the project by Friday.
words.ex_cn: 理想地，我们应该在周五前完成这个项目。
words.en: In an ideal or perfect way; in a way that would be best in an ideal world.

words.tr: v. 设置；放；“set”的现在分词； n. 环境；背景；
words.ex: He is setting the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把闹钟设置为早上6点。
words.en: The context and environment in which something is set or takes place.

words.ex: He needs 120 credits to graduate.
words.ex_cn: 他需要120个学分才能毕业。
words.en: Credits can refer to the acknowledgment of someone's contribution to a project, the units of value awarded for academic work, or the financial trust allowing a person to obtain goods or services before payment.

words.ex: He briefly explained the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他简要地解释了这个计划。
words.en: For a short time; in few words.

words.tr: vt. 成为…的原因（cause的现在分词形式）
words.ex: The storm is causing heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴正在引起大雨。
words.en: If something causes an event, it makes it happen.

words.ex: His incomes are from his job and rent.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入来自他的工作和租金。
words.en: Money received, especially on a regular basis, for work or through investments.

words.ex: She wore a suit made of worsted wool to the interview.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件精纺毛料的套装去面试。
words.en: A fine smooth yarn spun from combed long-staple wool, or a fabric made from such yarn.

words.ex: The barn is used for storage of grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个谷仓用于粮食的贮存。
words.en: The act of storing something or the space where things are stored.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；认真的；严肃的；
words.ex: The accident caused a serious injury.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故造成了严重的伤害。
words.en: If you are serious about something, you are sincere about it and mean what you say.

words.ex: His weekly earnings are enough to pay rent.
words.ex_cn: 他的周收入足以支付房租。
words.en: Money obtained in return for labor or services.

words.tr: v. 对待；处理；探讨；请客； n. 处理( treat的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is treating his friends with kindness.
words.ex_cn: 他正在以善意对待他的朋友。
words.en: Treating refers to the action of behaving towards someone or dealing with something in a particular way, or the act of providing medical care.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.ex: Many diseases can be prevented with clean water.
words.ex_cn: 许多疾病可以通过干净的水来预防。
words.en: A disease is an illness which affects people, animals, or plants, for example one which is caused by bacteria or infection.

words.tr: adj. 强制的；强迫的；强有力的
words.ex: The police used forcible entry to get inside.
words.ex_cn: 警察强行进入里面。
words.en: Forcible is used to describe something that is done using physical force or violence, or something that is done in a strong and effective way.

words.ex: His sadness manifested in his quiet eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他的悲伤表现在他安静的眼神中。
words.en: To manifest something means to show it clearly and visibly.

words.tr: v. 任命；委派；“appoint”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 约定的；指定的；
words.ex: The boss appointed him as manager.
words.ex_cn: 老板任命他为经理。
words.en: If someone is appointed to a job or position, they are given it officially.

words.ex: He obviously forgot his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他显然忘了做作业。
words.en: in a way that is easily perceived or understood; clearly.

words.tr: v. 分开；分裂；“split”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tree is splitting in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: Splitting refers to the act of dividing or separating something into parts, often with force or intensity.

words.tr: v. 使再转变；使再改变信仰
words.ex: They reconvert the old building into a library.
words.ex_cn: 他们把旧楼重新改造为图书馆。
words.en: To convert something back to a previous state or form, or to cause someone to return to a previous religion or belief.

words.ex: The creditors asked for their money back.
words.ex_cn: 债权人要求拿回他们的钱。
words.en: A creditor is a person or organization to whom money is owed.

words.tr: adj. 抑郁的； v. 降低；“depress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt depressed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到抑郁。
words.en: If you are depressed, you are sad and feel that you cannot enjoy anything, because your situation is so difficult and unpleasant.

words.ex: This symbol signifies peace.
words.ex_cn: 这个符号意味着和平。
words.en: Indicates or points to something, often in a symbolic or representative way.

words.ex: He calculates the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速计算出总成本。
words.en: To determine by mathematical methods; compute.

words.ex: Going first is a privilege, not a right.
words.ex_cn: 优先权是一种特权，而不是权利。
words.en: A privilege is a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.

words.ex: This rule is applicable to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: If something is applicable to a particular situation, it is relevant or suitable for that situation.

words.ex: The locomotive pulled the train down the track.
words.ex_cn: 机车拉着火车沿着轨道行驶。
words.en: A locomotive is a powered rail vehicle used for pulling trains.

words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A systematic approach or method is one that is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way.

words.ex: Some inventions help people every day.
words.ex_cn: 一些发明每天都在帮助人们。
words.en: Inventions are new devices, methods, or processes that have been developed as a result of study and experimentation.

words.tr: v. 公认；意识到；认出；“recognise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is recognised as a great scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他被公认为一位伟大的科学家。
words.en: Generally accepted or acknowledged as being true or existing.

words.tr: adj. 随之发生的；作为结果的；
words.ex: The rain was heavy, and the flood was consequent.
words.ex_cn: 雨下得很大，洪水随之发生。
words.en: Following as a result or effect.

words.ex: The experiment is based on simple assumptions.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验基于简单的假定。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.ex: The doctor did an examination of his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生对他手臂进行了检查。
words.en: An examination is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.ex: The hospital is a public institution.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一家公共机构。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.ex: The stock market shows daily fluctuation.
words.ex_cn: 股票市场每天都有波动。
words.en: A fluctuation is a change in something, especially in a continuous process such as temperature, prices, or levels of activity.

words.ex: The utilisation of solar energy is growing.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能的使用正在增加。
words.en: The act of using something in an effective way.

words.tr: v. 预先假定；以…为先决条件
words.ex: The argument presupposed that all people want peace.
words.ex_cn: 这个论点预设了所有人都希望和平。
words.en: If one thing presupposes another, the first thing cannot be true or exist unless the second thing is true or exists.

words.ex: The factory increased its productions last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这家工厂增加了制作量。
words.en: The process of making or growing something to be sold, especially in large quantities.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.tr: n. 花费( expenditure的名词复数 ); 使用; （尤指金钱的）支出额; （精力、时间、
words.ex: The government is trying to control public expenditures.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在努力控制公共支出。
words.en: Expenditures refer to the amounts spent on goods or services, or the act of spending money.

words.ex: This task necessitates careful planning.
words.ex_cn: 这项任务需要仔细规划。
words.en: If something necessitates a particular action, it makes that action necessary.

words.ex: He gave an antagonistic reply to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了敌对的答复。
words.en: If someone is antagonistic to someone or something, they show hatred or opposition towards them.

words.ex: He does calculations every day for his job.
words.ex_cn: 他每天为工作做计算。
words.en: Calculations are mathematical determinations of the size or number of something.

words.ex: The manager was accused of appropriating company funds for personal use.
words.ex_cn: 经理被指控挪用公司资金用于个人用途。
words.en: To take something for one's own use, typically without the owner's permission.

words.ex: The road is long and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 这条路又长又安静。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.tr: v. 打赌( lay的第三人称单数 ); 提出; 放置; 铺
words.ex: He lays a bet on the football match.
words.ex_cn: 他打赌足球比赛的结果。
words.en: To put something down carefully or gently; to set something down; to produce eggs.

words.tr:
n. 风；
v. 缠绕；蜿蜒；
words.ex: The wind blew strongly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风猛烈地吹过树木。
words.en: Wind is the natural movement of air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.

words.tr:
n. 鱼；鱼肉；
v. 钓鱼；捕鱼；
words.ex: He caught a big fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 他在河里钓到了一条大鱼。
words.en: A fish is a creature that lives in water and has a tail and fins. Fish is also the flesh of a fish eaten as food.

words.ex: He asks questions in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上提问。
words.en: Requests information or expresses a question.

words.ex: The serfs toiled in the fields from dawn until dusk.
words.ex_cn: 农奴从早到晚在田里辛勤劳作。
words.en: A serf is a person in a condition of servitude, required to render services to a lord, commonly attached to the lord's land and transferred with it from one owner to another.

words.ex: The rata scurried across the kitchen floor.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠在厨房地板上匆匆跑过。
words.en: A small rodent with a pointed snout, long tail, and typically gray or brown fur.

words.ex: The males are playing basketball outside.
words.ex_cn: 这些男性在外面打篮球。
words.en: Males are the members of the sex that cannot bear offspring or produce eggs.

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty for peace.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: Peace is a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area.

words.ex: She meets her friend at the café every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周五在咖啡馆见她的朋友。
words.en: To come into the presence of someone or something; to fulfill or satisfy a requirement or condition.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: He visited Italy last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了意大利。
words.en: A country in southern Europe, known for its rich cultural heritage, history, art, and cuisine.

words.tr: n. 拖鞋; 骡( mule的名词复数 ); <口>顽固的人; 越境运毒者
words.ex: She wore a pair of mules to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一双拖鞋去了海滩。
words.en: A mule is the offspring of a male donkey and a female horse. Mules are known for their strength, endurance, and stubbornness.

words.tr: v. 尝试；试图；努力；“try”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 经过考验的；
words.ex: I tried to run faster.
words.ex_cn: 我尝试跑得更快。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of try. To make an effort to do or accomplish (something); attempt.

words.ex: He made an error in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: An error is a mistake.

words.ex: Family bonds keep us close together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭纽带让我们紧密相连。
words.en: Bonds are fixed-income securities that represent a loan made by an investor to a borrower (typically corporate or governmental).

words.ex: The bears live in the forest near the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 熊住在山边的森林里。
words.en: A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws. In another sense, to bear means to carry, support, or endure something.

words.ex: He took three steps to reach the door.
words.ex_cn: 他走了三步就到了门边。
words.en: A step is one of a series of actions that you take in order to achieve something.

words.ex: He speaks fluent English.
words.ex_cn: 他讲一口流利的英语。
words.en: If someone is fluent in a particular language, they can speak it easily and correctly.

words.ex: He uses tokens to play games at the arcade.
words.ex_cn: 他用代币在游戏厅玩游戏。
words.en: A token is a thing serving as a visible or tangible representation of a fact, quality, feeling, etc.

words.tr:
adv. 很；相当；
adj. 漂亮的；
words.ex: The movie was pretty good.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很好。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they are attractive in a delicate way without being truly beautiful.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.ex: The baby is 20 inches long.
words.ex_cn: 这个婴儿有20英寸长。
words.en: An inch is a unit of length in the British imperial and United States customary systems of measurement. It is also used to describe a very small amount or degree of something.

words.ex: The land is arable and good for growing wheat.
words.ex_cn: 这块地是可耕的，适合种植小麦。
words.en: Arable land is land that is suitable for growing crops.

words.ex: The company reported significant losses this quarter.
words.ex_cn: 该公司本季度报告了重大亏损。
words.en: Losses refer to the amount of money or value that is lost, especially in business or financial contexts.

words.ex: He suffered from a bad cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周患了重感冒。
words.en: To experience something unpleasant, such as injury, pain, or loss.

words.ex: The potter made a clay bowl by hand.
words.ex_cn: 陶工用手制作了一个陶碗。
words.en: A potter is someone who makes pottery, and to potter means to busy oneself in a desultory but pleasant manner.

words.ex: He is a writer who loves to write stories.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位喜欢写故事的作家。
words.en: A writer is a person who writes books, stories, or articles as a job or regular occupation.

words.ex: She sent her best wishes for the New Year.
words.ex_cn: 她送上了对新年的美好祝愿。
words.en: A wish is a desire or hope for something to happen.

words.ex: She speaks English fluently.
words.ex_cn: v. 她英语说得很流利。
words.en: To say words in order to express thoughts, opinions, or feelings.

words.ex: He runs faster than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比他弟弟快。
words.en: Comparative of fast: moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个轮子。
words.en: Circular objects that revolve on an axle and are fixed below vehicles to enable them to move over the ground.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: The charity provides food and shelter for paupers.
words.ex_cn: 该慈善机构为穷人提供食物和住所。
words.en: Paupers are people who are extremely poor and lack the basic necessities of life.

words.ex: He used a pretext to leave the meeting early.
words.ex_cn: 他找了个借口提前离开了会议。
words.en: A pretext is a false reason that you give for doing something, usually something bad, in order to hide the real reason.

words.ex: The mountains look distant from here.
words.ex_cn: 从这里看，山显得很远。
words.en: If you describe something as distant, you mean that it is far away in space or time.

words.ex: The four seasons are spring, summer, fall, and winter.
words.ex_cn: 四个季节是春天、夏天、秋天和冬天。
words.en: Seasons refer to the four periods of the year (spring, summer, autumn, and winter) into which the year can be divided based on the weather and the amount of daylight.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.ex: Charles likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 查尔斯喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A male given name of Germanic origin, meaning 'free man'.

words.ex: He is wanting a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一辆新自行车。
words.en: If something is wanting, it is lacking or not good enough in a particular way.

words.ex: He writes cheques to pay for groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他用支票支付食品杂货费用。
words.en: A cheque is a printed form on which you write an amount of money and who it is to be paid to. Your bank then pays the money to that person from your account.

words.ex: The robbery happened at the bank yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天银行发生了抢劫。
words.en: The crime of stealing from someone or somewhere, especially using violence or threats.

words.ex: We will discuss the homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天讨论作业。
words.en: To discuss something means to talk about it with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions.

words.ex: The address is 720 liberty street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是自由大街720号。
words.en: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.

words.ex: He sleeps in his bedroom every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都在卧室睡觉。
words.en: A bedroom is a room in a house or apartment where people sleep.

words.tr: adj. 暴露的；无遮蔽的；易受攻击（或批评）的； v. 暴露；“expose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The baby's skin is exposed to the sun.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的皮肤暴露在阳光下。
words.en: If a place is exposed, it has no natural protection against bad weather or enemies, for example because it has no trees or is on very high ground.

words.ex: He handed me a pamphlet about the new park.
words.ex_cn: 他递给我一份关于新公园的小册子。
words.en: A pamphlet is a small book containing information on a particular subject or expressing political or religious views.

words.tr: adj. 迷惑的；混乱的； v. 迷惑；混淆；“confuse”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He looked confused when the teacher asked the question.
words.ex_cn: 老师问问题时，他看起来很迷惑。
words.en: If you are confused, you do not know exactly what is happening or what to do.

words.tr: v. 宣传；提升；促进；将（体育运动队）晋级（promote 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The company promoted the new product on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司通过电视宣传了新产品。
words.en: If someone is promoted, they are given a more important job or rank in the organization that they work for.

words.tr: n. 印刷；印刷术； v. “print”的现在分词；
words.ex: The printing of books started long ago.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的印刷很久以前就开始了。
words.en: Printing is the process of producing texts and images, typically with ink on paper using a printing press.

words.ex: The new statutes will take effect next month.
words.ex_cn: 新法规将于下个月生效。
words.en: Statutes are laws that are formally written and enacted by a legislative body.

words.ex: He was forcibly taken by the police.
words.ex_cn: 他被警察强行带走了。
words.en: In a way that involves physical force or strength, especially against someone's will.

words.tr:
adj. 平行的；
n. 类似的事物；
words.ex: The two lines are parallel and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行的，永远不会相交。
words.en: Something that is parallel to something else is similar to it in many ways, or happens at the same time as it.

words.ex: The delivery of the package took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹的交付花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of delivering letters, parcels, or goods.

words.ex: He had no recourse but to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他别无依靠，只能求助。
words.en: If you have recourse to a particular course of action, you use it when you are in a difficult situation or when you need to achieve something.

words.tr: n. 储备；保留；保护区；“reserve”的复数；
words.ex: The country keeps oil reserves for emergencies.
words.ex_cn: 该国为紧急情况保留石油储备。
words.en: Reserves refer to supplies of something that are kept for future use, or a group of people who are available to be called upon when needed.

words.ex: My birthday is in February.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在二月。
words.en: February is the second month of the year in the Julian and Gregorian calendars.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.ex: He commonly eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他一般在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: If something is commonly the case, it is usually or often the case.

words.ex: I recently bought a new book.
words.ex_cn: 我最近买了一本新书。
words.en: If something happened recently, it happened only a short time ago.

words.tr: n. 英勇行为；功绩；业绩
words.ex: The knight's exploits were celebrated in songs.
words.ex_cn: 这位骑士的英勇行为被传唱颂扬。
words.en: Exploits are notable achievements or deeds, often involving bravery or skill.

words.ex: The company incurred heavy losses due to the economic downturn.
words.ex_cn: 由于经济下滑，公司遭受了重大损失。
words.en: If you incur something unpleasant, it happens to you because of something you have done.

words.ex: The laborers worked tirelessly in the fields under the hot sun.
words.ex_cn: 劳动者们在烈日下不知疲倦地在田里工作。
words.en: People who do physical work, especially in industries such as construction or farming.

words.tr: v. 联系起来；讲述；叙述；（把…）联系起来( relate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He relates the story to his own life.
words.ex_cn: 他将这个故事与自己的生活联系起来。
words.en: to tell or describe a series of events, or to show or establish a connection between two or more things

words.ex: The smile on his face was illusory.
words.ex_cn: 他脸上的微笑是虚假的。
words.en: If something is illusory, it is not real or true, although it may seem to be.

words.tr: v. 参加；注意，听；照顾；参加( attend的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He attended the meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天参加了会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of someone or something.

words.ex: He said 'free gift', which is a tautology.
words.ex_cn: 他说了‘免费礼物’，这是一种同义反复。
words.en: Tautology is the use of different words to say the same thing twice in the same statement, considered a fault in style.

words.tr: v. 隐藏；“conceal”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He concealed the key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在门垫下面。
words.en: If something is concealed, it is hidden or covered so that it cannot be seen or noticed.

words.ex: He posted an anonymous comment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在网上发布了一条匿名评论。
words.en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

words.ex: The deviation from the plan caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 偏离计划导致了延误。
words.en: A deviation is a noticeable difference from what is expected or from a standard.

words.tr: v. 悬浮；暂停；“suspend”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The particles are suspended in water.
words.ex_cn: 这些颗粒悬浮在水中。
words.en: If something is suspended, it is hanging from somewhere or is not moving or active for a period of time.

words.tr:
n. 基督教徒；
adj. 基督教的；
words.ex: He is a christian who goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每周日都去教堂的基督教徒。
words.en: A Christian is a person who believes in Jesus Christ and follows his teachings.

words.ex: The team consisted of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: To be composed or made up of something.

words.ex: The concert was wonderful.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太精彩了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as wonderful, you think they are extremely good.

words.tr: v. 提前；前进；“advance”的现在分词； adj. 前进的；
words.ex: He is advancing the meeting to Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他把会议提前到周一。
words.en: To move forward or make progress, especially in a purposeful way.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.tr: n. 强迫；强制；难以抗拒的冲动
words.ex: He felt a compulsion to check the door again.
words.ex_cn: 他感到一种必须再次检查门的强迫感。
words.en: A compulsion is a very strong desire to do something, which you find difficult to control.

words.ex: They are exchanging gifts at Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 他们在圣诞节互换礼物。
words.en: to give something to someone and receive something from them in return

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.ex: This car is economical because it uses little fuel.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车很经济，因为它耗油少。
words.en: Using money, resources, or time in a careful and effective way.

words.ex: The cost of lunch was incidental to the main expense.
words.ex_cn: 午餐的费用是主要开销的附带部分。
words.en: If one thing is incidental to another, it is less important than the other thing or is not a major part of it.

words.tr: adv. 显然；表面上看起来；
words.ex: He is apparently late for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他显然迟到了会议。
words.en: You use apparently to indicate that the information you are giving is something that you have heard, but you are not certain that it is true.

words.ex: He lives in Birmingham with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在伯明翰。
words.en: A city in central England, known for its industrial heritage, vibrant cultural scene, and diverse communities.

words.tr: adj. 令人信服的； v. “compel”的现在分词；
words.ex: His story was compelling and made everyone listen.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事令人信服，让所有人都认真聆听。
words.en: A compelling argument or reason is one that makes you believe it or accept it because it is so strong.

words.ex: The city hosted an exposition last summer.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年夏天举办了一场博览会。
words.en: An exposition is a detailed explanation or description of an idea or theory. It can also refer to a large public exhibition of art or trade goods.

words.ex: He wears a protective helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴一顶保护性的头盔。
words.en: If something is protective, it is intended to protect someone or something from harm or damage.

words.tr: v. 收缩；订契约（contract 的过去式和过去分词）； adj. 收缩的；
words.ex: The muscle contracted when he lifted the box.
words.ex_cn: 当他举起箱子时，肌肉收缩了。
words.en: Reduced in size or pulled together; made smaller or narrower; having entered into a formal and legally binding agreement.

words.ex: His sadness manifested in his quiet behavior.
words.ex_cn: 他的悲伤表现在他沉默的行为中。
words.en: To show or demonstrate something clearly and openly.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: He used a disposable cup for his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一次性杯子喝咖啡。
words.en: Something that is disposable is intended to be thrown away after use.

words.ex: The dimensions of the box are 10 cm by 5 cm by 3 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米乘3厘米。
words.en: Dimensions refer to the measurements of something, such as its length, width, and height, or the aspects and features of a situation or problem.

words.tr: adj. 推测的；推理的；思索的；投机的
words.ex: He made a speculative guess about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他对天气做了一个推测性的猜测。
words.en: Based on conjecture rather than knowledge; involving a high risk of loss.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.ex: The company must follow the safety regulations.
words.ex_cn: 公司必须遵守安全条例。
words.en: Regulations are rules or laws designed to control the way that something happens or is done.

words.ex: The competitors ran fast in the race.
words.ex_cn: 这些竞争对手在比赛中跑得很快。
words.en: A competitor is a person, team, or company that is competing against others.

words.ex: This rule is universally accepted.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则被普遍接受。
words.en: In a way that is done or shared by all people or things in the world or in a particular group.

words.ex: He joined two associations last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年加入了两个协会。
words.en: An association is an official group of people who have the same job, aim, or interest.

words.ex: The city is progressively becoming more crowded.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在逐步变得更加拥挤。
words.en: In a way that happens or develops gradually or in stages; increasingly.

words.ex: His words were contradictory.
words.ex_cn: 他的话是矛盾的。
words.en: If two or more facts, ideas, or statements are contradictory, they state or imply that opposite things are true.

words.tr: v. 喂；吃；“feed”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She fed the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To provide food for someone or something, or to give someone or something the necessary materials or resources for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.ex: He has nous to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他有智慧来解决这个问题。
words.en: Nous refers to the intellect or mind, particularly in the context of understanding and reasoning.

words.ex: He visited Rome last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了罗马。
words.en: The capital city of Italy, known for its rich history, architecture, and as the center of the Roman Catholic Church.

words.ex: Can you lend me your pen?
words.ex_cn: 你能把你的笔借给我吗？
words.en: If you lend something you own to someone else, you allow them to have it or use it for a period of time, after which they must return it to you.

words.ex: He hurt his foot while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了脚。
words.en: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.

words.tr:
adj. 简短的；简明的；短暂的；
v. 为…提供信息；
n. 摘要；概要；
words.ex: He gave a brief answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简短的答案。
words.en: If something is brief, it lasts only for a short time.

words.tr: adj. 混合的；混杂的； v. 混合；“mix”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He ate a mixed salad with tomatoes and cucumbers.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一份混合沙拉，里面有番茄和黄瓜。
words.en: If something is mixed, it consists of different things or people.

words.tr:
v. 横过；穿过；交叉；
n. 十字架；十字形记号；
adj. 恼怒的；
words.ex: Please cross the street carefully.
words.ex_cn: 请小心横过街道。
words.en: To go from one side of something to the other; to place or lie across something else; to oppose.

words.tr: v. 在…中失败( fail的第三人称单数 ); 衰退; 衰弱; 破产
words.ex: He fails the math test again.
words.ex_cn: 他又没通过数学考试。
words.en: Is unsuccessful in achieving a desired aim or result.

words.ex: Saint Francis loved animals and helped the poor.
words.ex_cn: 圣方济各热爱动物并帮助穷人。
words.en: A saint is a person who is recognized as having an exceptional degree of holiness, likeness, or closeness to God.

words.ex: His lapse in judgment caused the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他的疏忽导致了事故。
words.en: A lapse is a temporary failure or a slight error, or the process by which something gradually passes into a different state, especially a worse one.

words.tr: v. 打破；打断；“break”的过去式； adj. 破产的；身无分文的；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了玻璃。
words.en: If you are broke, you have no money.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
