words.ex_cn: 他牺牲了自己的时间来帮助朋友。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

words.ex: The milk's expiration date is tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶的保质期是明天。
words.en: The end of the period for which something is valid or the act of breathing out.

words.tr: n. 承包商；承包人；订约人
words.ex: The contractor fixed the roof last week.
words.ex_cn: 承包商上周修好了屋顶。
words.en: A contractor is a person or company that undertakes a contract to provide materials or labor to perform a service or do a job.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不相关的；
words.ex: His opinion is irrelevant to the decision.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见与这个决定无关紧要。
words.en: If you describe something as irrelevant, you mean that it is not important to or not connected with the present situation or discussion.

words.ex: The contract stipulated that the work must be completed by the end of the month.
words.ex_cn: 合同规定工作必须在月底前完成。
words.en: Specified or agreed to as a condition of an agreement.

words.ex: The empire's domination over the region lasted for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这个帝国对该地区的统治持续了几个世纪。
words.en: The exercise of control or influence over someone or something, or the state of being so controlled.

words.tr: v. 忽视；“overlook”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher overlooked his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 老师忽视了他的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.ex: He will inevitably fail if he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不学习，他不可避免地会失败。
words.en: If something will inevitably happen, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.tr: adj. 少量的；微小的；分数的
words.ex: He gave a fractional amount of money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他捐了一点钱给慈善机构。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a fraction or fractions; very small or slight.

words.ex: This book is pertaining to ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于古代历史的。
words.en: relating directly to the subject being considered.

words.ex: He showed excellence in math competitions.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学竞赛中表现出色。
words.en: The quality of being outstanding or extremely good.

words.tr: n. 精心制作；详尽的细节；
words.ex: The chef gave an elaboration to the dish with fresh herbs.
words.ex_cn: 厨师用新鲜香草对这道菜进行了精心制作。
words.en: The process of developing or presenting a theory, policy, or system in detail.

words.ex: The speculators bought up all the available stock, hoping to sell it later at a higher price.
words.ex_cn: 投机者买下了所有可用的股票，希望以后以更高的价格出售。
words.en: Speculators are people who buy goods, property, money, etc. in the hope of selling them at a higher price in the future.

words.ex: The dog accompanies her every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗每天早上都陪伴她。
words.en: To go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort; to be present or occur at the same time as something else.

words.ex: He listed his occupations on the job application.
words.ex_cn: 他在求职申请上列出了自己的职业。
words.en: Occupations refer to the jobs or professions that people do, or the act of taking control of a place, especially by military force.

words.ex: My grandparents, my parents, and I are three generations.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父母、父母和我是三代人。
words.en: Generations refer to all of the people born and living at about the same time, regarded collectively. It can also refer to the average period, generally considered to be about thirty years, in which children grow up, become adults, and have children of their own.

words.ex: The fabrication of the machine took three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的制备花了三周时间。
words.en: The act of inventing or producing something false in order to deceive someone.

words.ex: He is potentially going to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他有可能赢得比赛。
words.en: in a way that is possible or likely to happen or be true

words.ex: The rain necessitated staying indoors.
words.ex_cn: 下雨使待在室内成为必需。
words.en: To necessitate something means to make it necessary for something to be done or to happen.

words.ex: She is withdrawing her application from the university.
words.ex_cn: 她正在撤回她的大学申请。
words.en: To remove or take away something, or to stop participating in something.

words.ex: He is an industrious student who studies every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个勤勉的学生，每天都学习。
words.en: Someone who is industrious works hard and is determined.

words.ex: His supposition is that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是明天会下雨。
words.en: A supposition is a guess or a theory that you have about something, which may not be true.

words.ex: The company is compensating its employees for overtime work.
words.ex_cn: 公司正在为员工的加班工作提供补偿。
words.en: To compensate means to give someone something, typically money, in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury; to make up for something unwelcome or unpleasant by exerting an opposite force or effect.

words.ex: The colonisation of the land changed the lives of native people.
words.ex_cn: 这片土地的殖民化改变了原住民的生活。
words.en: Colonisation refers to the process by which a central system of power dominates the surrounding land and its components.

words.ex: The depopulation of rural areas has led to the closure of many schools.
words.ex_cn: 农村地区的居民减少导致了许多学校的关闭。
words.en: The reduction of the population of an area.

words.tr: n. 企业( undertaking的名词复数 ); 保证; 殡仪业; 任务
words.ex: He made many undertakings but finished few.
words.ex_cn: 他做了很多承诺，但完成的很少。
words.en: Projects, tasks, or commitments undertaken, often requiring effort.

words.ex: The baby slept uninterrupted for six hours.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿连续睡了六个小时。
words.en: Something that is uninterrupted continues for a period of time without stopping.

words.tr: n. 不均衡，不成比例 vt. 使不均衡，使不对称
words.ex: The disproportion of wealth in the country is alarming.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家财富的不均衡令人担忧。
words.en: A disproportion is a state in which things are not of the same size, quantity, or value as they should be.

words.ex: He gave a justification for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他为迟到提供了一个正当的理由。
words.en: A justification for something is an acceptable reason or explanation for it.

words.tr: n. 代表；（销售）代理；议员；“representative”的复数；
words.ex: The representatives spoke for their countries at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 这些代表在会议上为他们的国家发言。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.ex: He sleeps on a soft bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡在一张柔软的床上。
words.en: A bed is a piece of furniture that you lie on when you sleep.

words.ex: He went to the party sans his girlfriend.
words.ex_cn: prep. 他没有带女朋友去参加派对。
words.en: prep. Without; lacking.

words.tr: v. 借给；“lend”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I lent my book to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把我的书借给了我的朋友。
words.en: The past tense and past participle of lend, meaning to give something to someone for a period of time, expecting that it will be returned.

words.tr: adj. 整洁的；整齐的；有条理的
words.ex: He keeps his desk neat.
words.ex_cn: 他保持书桌整洁。
words.en: Neat things are tidy, smart, or carefully arranged.

words.tr:
n. 果皮；
v. 去皮；剥落；
words.ex: The apple peel is rich in fiber.
words.ex_cn: 苹果皮富含纤维。
words.en: To remove the outer covering from something, especially a fruit or vegetable.

words.tr:
n. 小伙子；家伙
v. 皲裂
words.ex: The chap helped me carry the boxes.
words.ex_cn: 那个小伙子帮我搬了箱子。
words.en: A chap is a man or boy. If something chaps your skin, it makes it sore and cracked.

words.tr:
v. 希望；
n. 希望；
words.ex: I hope it rains tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我希望明天下雨。
words.en: If you hope that something is true, or if you hope for something, you want it to be true or to happen, and you usually believe that it is possible or likely.

words.tr: v. 兜售；招徕；吹捧；倒卖（高价票）
words.ex: He touts the new phone as the best on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他吹捧这款新手机是市场上最好的。
words.en: If someone touts something, they try to sell it or convince people that it is good, especially in an aggressive or exaggerated way.

words.ex: She gave him a gift for his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她送了他一份生日礼物。
words.en: A gift is something that you give someone as a present. It can also refer to a natural ability or talent.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.ex: A deer is walking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹿正在森林里走路。
words.en: A deer is a large wild animal that eats grass and leaves. The male has antlers that are shed and regrown each year.

words.tr:
n. 商店；
v. 购物；
words.ex: I bought bread from the local shop.
words.ex_cn: 我从附近的商店买了面包。
words.en: A shop is a place where goods are sold; also, to shop means to visit shops in order to buy things.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；主要的；基本的；最好的；
words.ex: This is the prime reason for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 这是延误的首要原因。
words.en: Prime is used to describe something that is of the best possible quality, or the most important or basic part of something.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.tr:
n. 法官；裁判；
v. 判断；评判；
words.ex: The judge announced the verdict in court.
words.ex_cn: 法官在法庭上宣布了判决。
words.en: A judge is a person who has the authority to decide questions brought before a court of law. To judge means to form an opinion or conclusion about something.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: The store opens at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 商店早上8点开始营业。
words.en: If someone opens something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, its position is changed so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.ex: The farmer loaded the bales of hay onto the truck.
words.ex_cn: 农民把干草捆装上了卡车。
words.en: Bales are large bundles of material, such as hay, cotton, or straw, that are tightly bound together for storage or transport.

words.ex: The river is broad and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这条河宽阔而平缓。
words.en: Something that is broad is wide.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.ex: The boat travels through the canal.
words.ex_cn: 船通过运河航行。
words.en: A canal is a long, narrow stretch of water that has been made for boats to travel along or to bring water to a particular area.

words.ex: There are many shops on this street.
words.ex_cn: 这条街上有很多商店。
words.en: Shops are places where goods are sold to the public. As a verb, to shop means to visit shops to buy goods.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.ex: She helps her brother with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 她帮弟弟做作业。
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of their work or by giving them advice or money.

words.ex: I enjoy eating ice cream on hot days.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在热天吃冰淇淋。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.tr: v. 免除；释放；使…免除；使…释放；使…摆脱；免除，释放( free的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The law freed him from paying taxes.
words.ex_cn: 法律免除了他缴税的义务。
words.en: To release from captivity, confinement, or slavery.

words.ex: The evils of war are well documented in history.
words.ex_cn: n. 战争的罪恶在历史上有详细记载。
words.en: Evils refer to morally wrong or bad actions, conditions, or influences that cause harm or suffering.

words.ex: He used a stick to lever the heavy rock.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子撬动那块大石头。
words.en: A lever is a handle that you pull or push to operate a machine. It can also refer to a rigid bar pivoted about a fulcrum, used to transfer a force to a load and usually to provide a mechanical advantage.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

words.ex: He avoids eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you avoid something, you take action in order to prevent it from happening to you.

words.ex: He will cancel the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会取消会议。
words.en: If you cancel something that has been arranged, you stop it from happening. If you cancel an order for goods or services, you tell the person or organization supplying them that you no longer wish to receive them.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；永久的灭亡；死神；死( death的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The war brought many deaths to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争给村庄带来了许多毁灭。
words.en: The end of the life of a person or organism.

words.ex: The cat occupies the sofa all day.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫整天占据着沙发。
words.en: If people or things occupy a place, they are in it or fill it.

words.ex: The piston moves up and down in the engine.
words.ex_cn: 活塞在发动机中上下移动。
words.en: A piston is a component of reciprocating engines, reciprocating pumps, gas compressors and pneumatic cylinders, among other similar mechanisms. It is the moving component that is contained by a cylinder and is made gas-tight by piston rings.

words.ex: She is owning her mistakes and trying to make amends.
words.ex_cn: v. 她正在承认自己的错误，并试图弥补。
words.en: To have something as one's own; to possess.

words.ex: The rocket's thrust lifted it into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 火箭的推力将它送上了天空。
words.en: To thrust something somewhere means to push it there quickly and forcefully. A thrust is also a powerful push or movement.

words.ex: The children played with stones in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在院子里玩石子。
words.en: Hard solid non-metallic mineral matter of which rock is made, especially as a building material.

words.ex: The farmer ploughs the field every spring.
words.ex_cn: 农民每年春天都犁地。
words.en: A plough is a large farming implement with one or more blades fixed in a frame, drawn over soil to turn it over and cut furrows in preparation for the planting of seeds. It can also mean to move forward with difficulty or to work hard at something.

words.ex: The book cost me 15 francs.
words.ex_cn: 这本书花了我15法郎。
words.en: The plural of franc, a former monetary unit of France and several other countries.

words.tr: n. 植物；发电厂；工厂；作物；“plant”的复数；
words.ex: Plants need sunlight and water to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要阳光和水来生长。
words.en: Plants are living organisms that typically grow in soil and have leaves, stems, and roots. They are essential for the environment as they produce oxygen and provide food for many animals.

words.tr: adj. 未售出的；无人购买的
words.ex: The unsold books are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 未售出的书存放在仓库里。
words.en: If something is unsold, it has not been sold.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.tr: v. 断言；宣称；坚持；维护
words.ex: He asserts that the answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持认为答案是正确的。
words.en: To state a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.

words.ex: The government imposed a new tax on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府对糖征收了一项新税。
words.en: To impose means to officially force a rule, tax, punishment, etc. to be obeyed or received.

words.ex: The children play tennis on the courts after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在球场打网球。
words.en: Courts can refer to the places where legal cases are heard, areas designated for playing sports such as tennis or basketball, or the residences of a royal family. As a verb, it means to try to win the favor or support of someone, often with romantic intentions.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.ex: The news reported many issues last week.
words.ex_cn: 新闻报道了上周的许多事件。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are discussing or arguing about.

words.ex: She has written several volumes on the history of art.
words.ex_cn: 她写了几卷关于艺术史的书籍。
words.en: Volumes refers to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the amount of space that a container can hold. It can also refer to a book, especially one of a set of books.

words.tr: n. 格拉斯哥（英国城市）
words.ex: He lives in Glasgow.
words.ex_cn: 他住在格拉斯哥。
words.en: Glasgow is the largest city in Scotland and the third largest in the United Kingdom. It is situated on the River Clyde in the country's West Central Lowlands.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.ex: The lengths of the two sticks are different.
words.ex_cn: 这两根棍子的长度不同。
words.en: The measurement or extent of something from end to end; the greater of two or the greatest of three dimensions of a body.

words.tr: n. 寄宿处； v. “lodge”的现在分词；
words.ex: He found cheap lodging near the train station.
words.ex_cn: 他在火车站附近找到了便宜的寄宿处。
words.en: Lodging refers to a place to live or stay, especially temporarily.

words.ex: The offices are on the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 办公室在二楼。
words.en: A room, set of rooms, or building used as a place for commercial, professional, or bureaucratic work.

words.tr:
adv. 在其中；在那里；在那种情况下
conj. 其中；在那里；在那种情况下
words.ex: The book wherein he wrote his thoughts is old.
words.ex_cn: 他写下自己想法的那本书很旧了。
words.en: in which; in what way or respect

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.ex: The bank is loaning money to small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 银行正在向小企业贷款。
words.en: The act of lending something, especially money, to someone with the expectation that it will be paid back.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.tr: v. 划分; 分( divide的第三人称单数 ); 分离; （使）产生分歧
words.ex: Four divides twelve into three equal parts.
words.ex_cn: 四把十二分成三个相等的部分。
words.en: To separate or be separated into parts or groups; to distribute among a number of recipients.

words.tr: v. 展示；表明；显现；放映；上演；“show”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is showing his drawings to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向全班展示他的画作。
words.en: An act of presenting a movie, play, or other form of entertainment to an audience.

words.tr: n. 重量；砝码；[计量]砝码（weight 的复数）；
words.ex: He lifted heavy weights at the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他在健身房举重物。
words.en: Units of mass used in measurement, especially in the context of exercise or weighing objects.

words.tr: v. 设法做到；管理；“manage”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He managed to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他设法按时完成了项目。
words.en: To be in charge of or control something; to succeed in doing something, especially something difficult.

words.tr: v. 下定义；“define”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 明确的；
words.ex: The teacher defined the word clearly.
words.ex_cn: 老师清楚地给这个词下了定义。
words.en: If something is defined, it is explained or described in a clear and precise way.

words.ex: The teacher checked the answers on the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师检查了试卷上的答案。
words.en: An answer is a response to a question, problem, or situation. It can be a solution to a problem or a reply to a question.

words.tr: adj. 逻辑上的；合乎逻辑的；
words.ex: His argument is logical and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点合乎逻辑，容易理解。
words.en: In accordance with the principles of logic; reasonable.

words.tr: v. 流；流动；“flow”的现在分词；
words.ex: The river is flowing fast.
words.ex_cn: 河水正在快速流淌。
words.en: Moving smoothly and continuously in a current or stream.

words.ex: He tries to procure food for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力为家人获取食物。
words.en: To obtain something, especially with care or effort.

words.tr: adj. 愿意的；乐意的； v. “will”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is willing to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If someone is willing to do something, they are happy to do it if it is needed.

words.ex: Mankind needs to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要保护环境。
words.en: Human beings considered collectively; the human race.

words.tr: v. 寻找；探寻；探索；企图；试图；寻找，探寻( seek的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is seeking his lost keys.
words.ex_cn: 他正在找他丢失的钥匙。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.tr:
adj. 未知的；不为人知的；
n. 未知的地方（或事物）；
words.ex: The unknown cause of the accident is being investigated.
words.ex_cn: 事故的未知原因正在调查中。
words.en: If something is unknown, it is not known or recognized by people.

words.tr: n. 裁缝；v. 定制，使适应
words.ex: The tailors in this shop are very skilled.
words.ex_cn: n. 这家店的裁缝非常熟练。
words.en: A tailor is a person whose job is to make, alter, or repair clothes. As a verb, it means to make or adapt something for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: vt. 把…归入某等级，把…看作（class的过去式与过去分词形式）
words.ex: He is classed as an expert in math.
words.ex_cn: 他被归类为数学专家。
words.en: Classified or categorized into a particular group or type.

words.tr: n. 会议；会面； v. 遇见；见面；“meet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting starts at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 会议上午九点开始。
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.tr: v. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；“delay”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 延时的；
words.ex: The flight was delayed because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，航班被推迟了。
words.en: If something is delayed, it happens later than planned or expected.

words.ex: He showed maturity when he apologized for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 当他为自己的错误道歉时，表现出了成熟。
words.en: Maturity is the state of being fully developed or grown, or the time when a financial arrangement becomes ready to be paid.

words.ex: Reading gives me great pleasure.
words.ex_cn: 阅读带给我极大的快乐。
words.en: Pleasure is a feeling of happiness, satisfaction, or enjoyment.

words.tr: n. 阁下；贵族身分（或权威）；统治
words.ex: The lordship welcomed the guests with kindness.
words.ex_cn: 阁下以仁慈欢迎了宾客。
words.en: Lordship is a title used to address or refer to a man who has a high rank in the nobility, especially in Britain.

words.tr: adj. 可感知的；易察觉的；明显的
words.ex: The tension in the room was palpable.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的紧张感是明显的。
words.en: If you describe something as palpable, you mean that it is obvious or intense and easily noticed.

words.tr: adj. 反向的；倒转的； v. “invert”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The inverted image appeared on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 倒置的图像出现在屏幕上。
words.en: Something that is inverted is turned upside down or reversed in position, direction, or order.

words.ex: The justices of the Supreme Court are highly respected.
words.ex_cn: 最高法院的法官们备受尊敬。
words.en: Justices are judges in a court of law, especially those in the Supreme Court.

words.tr: v. 出现；碰巧；发生（ happen的过去式和过去分词 ）；
words.ex: A strange noise happened last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚出现了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.tr: v. 认为；以为；相信； n. 相信( belief的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He believes the weather will be sunny tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他认为明天天气会晴朗。
words.en: If you believe something, you think it is true, correct, or real.

words.ex: The minister signed the new law.
words.ex_cn: 部长签署了新法律。
words.en: A minister is a person who is in charge of a particular government department or a member of the clergy in some Christian churches.

words.tr: adj. 搞错的；弄错的；误解的； v. “mistake”的过去分词；
words.ex: He was mistaken about the time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他对会议的时间搞错了。
words.en: If you are mistaken about something, you are wrong about it.

words.tr: v. 指导；指示；“direct”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 定向的；
words.ex: The teacher directed the students to finish their homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师指导学生完成作业。
words.en: If something is directed at a particular person or thing, it is aimed at them.

words.ex: The project was plagued by technical failures.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目因技术故障而受挫。
words.en: Failures refer to the lack of success in doing or achieving something, especially in relation to a particular activity.

words.ex: The vehicles are parked near the school.
words.ex_cn: 这些车辆停在学校附近。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people from place to place.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.tr: v. 分配；指派；“assign”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 指定的；
words.ex: The teacher assigned homework to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们布置了作业。
words.en: Given a specific task, role, or responsibility.

words.tr: v. 把…放入口袋；侵吞，盗用
words.ex: He pocketed the money without anyone noticing.
words.ex_cn: v. 他悄悄地把钱放进了口袋，没人注意到。
words.en: To put something into a pocket, especially secretly or without permission; to take or keep something, especially money, dishonestly.

words.ex: The storm destroys the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了房子。
words.en: To destroy something means to damage it so severely that it cannot be repaired or no longer exists.

words.ex: His attempts to cheat failed.
words.ex_cn: 他企图作弊，但失败了。
words.en: To make an effort to achieve or complete something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.ex: My parents are allowing me to stay out late.
words.ex_cn: 我父母允许我晚点回家。
words.en: To permit someone to do something or to let something happen.

words.ex: The priest visited several parishes last week.
words.ex_cn: n. 牧师上周访问了几个教区。
words.en: Parishes are local church communities within a diocese, each typically served by a single church and a priest.

words.tr:
n. 明天；
adv. 在明天；
words.ex: I will go to school tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天去学校。
words.en: The day after today; in the future.

words.ex: The elephant is gigantic compared to a dog.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象相比狗来说是巨大的。
words.en: If you describe something as gigantic, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The bright light was a stimulus for the baby to open his eyes.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的光线是让婴儿睁开眼睛的刺激物。
words.en: Something that causes growth or activity.

words.ex: The question confuses the student.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题让那个学生感到困惑。
words.en: verb. to make someone unable to think clearly or understand something.

words.tr: n. 操纵；处理； v. 处理；操纵；“handle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The handling of the machine requires training.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的操纵需要培训。
words.en: The act of managing or dealing with something.

words.ex: The city improved its drainage system after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 洪水之后，这座城市改进了它的排水系统。
words.en: Drainage is the system or process by which water or other liquids are drained from a place.

words.tr: v. （凭长期努力）达到；取得；完成；成功（achieve 的过去式及过去分词）；
words.ex: He achieved his goal after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他经过多年的努力实现了自己的目标。
words.en: If you achieve a particular aim or effect, you succeed in doing it or causing it to happen, usually after a lot of effort.

words.tr: v. 完成；结束；“finish”的现在分词； n. 结尾；结束；完成； adj. 最后的；完工的；
words.ex: He is finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在完成他的作业。
words.en: The act of completing something or the final touches added to something.

words.ex: The directors voted to increase the company's profits.
words.ex_cn: 董事们投票决定增加公司利润。
words.en: Directors are people who are in charge of managing a company or organization, or who are responsible for the artistic aspects of a film, play, or similar production.

words.ex: The table is fashioned in a rustic style.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是乡村风格的。
words.en: Made in a particular form or style, often implying that it is old-fashioned or traditional.

words.ex: The teacher designated him as the group leader.
words.ex_cn: 老师指派他为组长。
words.en: If you designate someone or something as a particular thing, you formally give them that description or name.

words.tr: n. 计算；算帐；账单； v. “reckon”的现在分词；
words.ex: The reckoning of the costs took an hour.
words.ex_cn: 计算费用花了一个小时。
words.en: A reckoning is a calculation or a judgment about something, especially about how much money is owed or how much something is worth.

words.ex: The divisions between the two groups are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这两个群体之间的分开很明显。
words.en: Divisions are the parts into which something is divided or the act of dividing something.

words.tr: v. 谴责；“condemn”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被谴责的；
words.ex: The public condemned the corrupt politician.
words.ex_cn: 公众谴责了这位腐败的政客。
words.en: If someone is condemned, they are officially declared to be guilty of a crime and are punished, especially by being sent to prison or executed.

words.ex: He remembers his childhood as a happy time.
words.ex_cn: 他记得自己的童年是一段快乐的时光。
words.en: Childhood is the period of a person's life when they are a child.

words.tr: n. 分数；小部分；<数>分数( fraction的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He added two fractions together.
words.ex_cn: 他把两个分数加在一起。
words.en: A fraction is a part of a whole number, such as 1⁄2 or 3⁄4.

words.ex: The secretary types letters for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 秘书为经理打字。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.tr: adj. 无限制的；无限量的；
words.ex: He has unlimited access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他可以无限制地使用图书馆。
words.en: If something is unlimited, there is no limit to it.

words.ex: He visits a religious temple every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都去一座宗教寺庙。
words.en: Relating to or believing in a religion.

words.tr: v. （使）漂白；（使）晒白；（使）变成淡色；
words.ex: The sun is bleaching the clothes on the line.
words.ex_cn: 阳光正在使晾衣绳上的衣服变白。
words.en: The process of making something white or lighter in color by using chemicals or sunlight.

words.ex: The teacher conducted a science experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师实施了一次科学实验。
words.en: To have carried out a particular activity or process, especially in a systematic way.

words.tr: v. 允许；允许( permit的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The teacher permitted us to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 老师允许我们早点离开。
words.en: Allowed or authorized, especially by an authority.

words.ex: He got accepted to Cambridge last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被剑桥大学录取了。
words.en: Cambridge is a city in the United Kingdom, known for its prestigious university, the University of Cambridge.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.tr: adj. 同等的；相等的；相当于
words.ex: Lying is tantamount to cheating.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎等于欺骗。
words.en: If you say that one thing is tantamount to a second, more serious thing, you are emphasizing how bad, unacceptable, or unfortunate the first thing is by comparing it to the second.

words.tr: adj. 习惯的；惯常的； v. “accustom”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you know it so well or have experienced it so often that it seems natural, unsurprising, or easy to deal with.

words.ex: The attraction of the city draws many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: An attraction is something that makes people want to go to a place or do a particular thing because they are interested in it.

words.ex: The withdrawal of the offer surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 撤销这项提议让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The act of removing or taking something away, especially money from a bank account, or the process of stopping taking a drug or medicine.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.tr: n. 破产；倒闭；无偿付能力
words.ex: The company filed for bankruptcy last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年申请了破产。
words.en: Bankruptcy is a legal status of a person or other entity that cannot repay the debts it owes to creditors.

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.tr: vi. 有或起作用（function的过去式与过去分词形式）
words.ex: The machine functioned well yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天运行良好。
words.en: To function means to work or operate in a particular way, or to serve a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.tr: adj. 合法的；法律认可的；合理的；
words.ex: This contract is legitimate and signed by both parties.
words.ex_cn: 这份合同是合法的，并由双方签署。
words.en: Something that is legitimate is acceptable according to the law.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.tr: v. 影响；“influence”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 受影响的；
words.ex: His ideas influenced many students.
words.ex_cn: 他的想法影响了许多学生。
words.en: To have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of someone or something, or the effect itself.

words.ex: He is succeeding in his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他在新工作中很成功。
words.en: Coming after or following in order; subsequent.

words.tr: adj. 令人满意的； v. 使满意；“satisfy”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meal was satisfying and cheap.
words.ex_cn: 这顿饭令人满意且便宜。
words.en: If something is satisfying, it makes you feel happy, especially because you feel you have achieved something.

words.ex: Many people died of starvation during the famine.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在饥荒中饿死了。
words.en: Starvation is a severe deficiency in caloric energy intake, below the level needed to maintain an organism's life.

words.tr: adj. 道歉的；谢罪的；愧疚的
words.ex: He gave an apologetic smile after bumping into her.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到她后露出了歉意的微笑。
words.en: If you are apologetic, you show or say that you are sorry for having caused someone trouble or unhappiness.

words.ex: The town's economy was heavily dependent on the local collieries.
words.ex_cn: 这个城镇的经济严重依赖当地的煤矿。
words.en: Collieries are places where coal is mined.

words.ex: He is explaining the math problem to his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向弟弟解释这道数学题。
words.en: to make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it

words.tr: adj. 有条件的，习惯于…的
words.ex: He is conditioned to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 他已经习惯于早起。
words.en: If someone is conditioned to do something, they have been influenced in such a way that they do it automatically or without thinking about it.

words.tr: n. 贵族政治；贵族统治；贵族
words.ex: The aristocracy lived in big castles long ago.
words.ex_cn: 很久以前，贵族住在巨大的城堡里。
words.en: The highest class in certain societies, especially those holding hereditary titles or offices.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；“illustrate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有插图的；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate means to make something clear or to explain it, often by using examples or pictures.

words.ex: Milk provides good nourishment for children.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶为儿童提供良好的滋养品。
words.en: Nourishment refers to the food or other substances necessary for growth, health, and good condition.

words.ex: The mixture is homogeneous and looks the same throughout.
words.ex_cn: 这种混合物是均一的，看起来处处都一样。
words.en: Something that is homogeneous is uniform in nature or character throughout.

words.ex: The noise from the construction caused a disturbance.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工地的噪音造成了干扰。
words.en: A disturbance is an event or situation in which people behave in a noisy or violent way, or something that interrupts what you are doing.

words.ex: The treaty establishes peace between the two countries.
words.ex_cn: 该条约建立了两国之间的和平。
words.en: To establish means to set up or found something, such as a business, institution, or system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: There has been slow progression in his math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学技能有了缓慢的进展。
words.en: The process of developing or moving gradually towards a more advanced state.

words.ex: The class analyzed statistical data from the survey.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级分析了调查的统计数据。
words.en: Relating to the use of statistics or statistical methods.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.ex: She has traveled extensively across Europe.
words.ex_cn: 她广泛地游历了欧洲。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide range of details, ideas, or items.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.tr: v. 经历；体验；“experience”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有经验的；
words.ex: He experienced a sudden storm while hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他在徒步时经历了一场突如其来的暴风雨。
words.en: Someone who is experienced has knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity because they have done it for a long time.

words.tr: v. 增补；补充；增补，补充（supplement 的过去分词）；
words.ex: He supplemented his income with part-time work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职工作来增加收入。
words.en: To add something extra to something in order to improve it or make it more complete.

words.ex: The building is functionally divided into offices and meeting rooms.
words.ex_cn: 这栋建筑在功能上被划分为办公室和会议室。
words.en: In a way that relates to the way in which something works or operates.

words.ex: The substitution of sugar with honey made the cake healthier.
words.ex_cn: 用蜂蜜代替糖使蛋糕更健康。
words.en: The act of replacing one person or thing with another.

words.ex: He left the party, and subsequently went home.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了派对，随后回家了。
words.en: If something happens subsequently, it happens after something else.

words.ex: The government expropriated the land for public use.
words.ex_cn: 政府征用了这块土地用于公共用途。
words.en: If a government or other authority expropriates someone's property, they take it away from them for public use or benefit.

words.tr: v. 占主导地位；占优势
words.ex: In this region, agriculture predominates over industry.
words.ex_cn: 在这个地区，农业比工业占主导地位。
words.en: If one type of person or thing predominates in a group, there is more of that type than of any other.

words.ex: The modification improved the design.
words.ex_cn: 这个修改改进了设计。
words.en: A modification is a change or alteration made to something to improve it or to make it suitable for a different purpose.

words.ex: He went for a walk irrespective of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾下雨去散步了。
words.en: If something is done or happens irrespective of particular factors, it is not influenced or affected by them.

words.tr:
n. 前提；先决条件
v. 预先处理；事先准备
words.ex: You must finish homework as a precondition to play games.
words.ex_cn: 你必须完成作业才能玩游戏。
words.en: A precondition is something that must happen or exist before something else can happen.

words.ex: The radio signal suffered from interference.
words.ex_cn: 收音机信号受到了干扰。
words.en: Interference refers to the action of interfering or the process of being interfered with, especially in a context where it is unwelcome or inappropriate.

words.tr: v. 描述…的特征；使具有…特征；
words.ex: The city is characterised by narrow streets and old buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市以狭窄的街道和古老的建筑为特征。
words.en: To describe the distinctive nature or features of something.

words.ex: The manifestation of his anger was a loud shout.
words.ex_cn: 他愤怒的显示是一声大喊。
words.en: A manifestation is an event, action, or object that clearly shows or embodies something, especially a theory or an abstract idea.

words.ex: The preponderance of evidence shows he is guilty.
words.ex_cn: 大多数证据表明他有罪。
words.en: If there is a preponderance of one type of thing or person in a group, there are more of that type than of any other.

words.ex: He learned multiplication in second grade.
words.ex_cn: 他在二年级学习了乘法。
words.en: Multiplication is the process of calculating the total of one number multiplied by another.

words.tr: n. 对比的不同，对照的区别
words.ex: He wrote the word 'hot' in contradiction to the word 'cold', in contradistinction.
words.ex_cn: 他写了‘热’这个词，与‘冷’这个词形成对比。
words.en: The act of distinguishing by contrasting; a clear difference.

words.ex: The com is growing fast in this city.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的商业正在快速增长。
words.en: A term used to refer to a company or business, often in the context of commerce or trade.

words.ex: He felt guilt for his sin of lying.
words.ex_cn: 他因撒谎的罪行感到内疚。
words.en: Sin is an action or behaviour that is considered to be morally wrong according to religious or social laws.

words.tr:
n. 船；舰；
v. 装运；
words.ex: The ship sailed across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 船驶过了海洋。
words.en: A ship is a large boat for travelling on water, especially across the sea.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.tr:
n. 一双；一对；
v. （使）配对；
words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子买了一双鞋。
words.en: A pair of things are two things of the same size and shape that are intended to be used together, or that are regarded as a unit.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A goal is an aim or purpose that a person or a group of people is trying to achieve.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.ex: There are two beds in the room.
words.ex_cn: 房间里有两张床。
words.en: A piece of furniture for sleep or rest, typically a framework with a mattress and coverings.

words.ex: He drinks a glass of milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯牛奶。
words.en: Milk is a white liquid produced by cows, goats, and some other animals, which people drink and use in cooking.

words.tr: adj. 私下参与的；私下的；秘密的
words.ex: He is privy to the secret plan.
words.ex_cn: 他知道这个秘密计划。
words.en: If you are privy to something secret, you have been allowed to know about it.

words.ex: The upper shelf is too high to reach.
words.ex_cn: 上面的架子太高了，够不着。
words.en: Higher in place or position; situated above another part.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: He played badly in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中表现得很差。
words.en: If something is done badly or goes badly, it is not successful or effective.

words.tr:
n. 转移；移位；转变；轮班；
v. 变换位置；转移；换（挡）；轮班；
words.ex: The shift of power to the new government was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 权力向新政府的转移是突然的。
words.en: If you shift something or if it shifts, it moves or changes its position slightly. If someone's opinion, attitude, or behaviour shifts, it changes slightly, especially in response to a particular situation or event.

words.ex: A large crowd gathered at the square.
words.ex_cn: 一大群人聚集在广场上。
words.en: A crowd is a large group of people who have gathered together, for example, to watch or listen to something interesting, or to protest about something.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.ex: He added an ounce of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: An ounce is a unit of weight used in Britain and the USA. There are sixteen ounces in a pound.

words.ex: He has a high fever and stays in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧了，躺在床上休息。
words.en: A fever is a condition in which the body's temperature is higher than usual, often as a response to infection.

words.ex: There are nine queens in the palace.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿里有九个女王。
words.en: A queen is a woman who rules a country as its monarch or who is the wife of a king.

words.ex: He dwells in a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一所小房子里。
words.en: If you dwell on something, especially something unpleasant, you think, speak, or write about it a lot or for quite a long time.

words.tr:
v. 引用；报价；
n. 引用；引文；报价；
words.ex: He quoted Shakespeare in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的话。
words.en: To repeat or copy out (a group of words from a text or speech), typically with an indication that one is not the original author or speaker.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.ex: The boat sinks slowly in the water.
words.ex_cn: 船在水中慢慢下沉。
words.en: A sink is a large fixed container in a kitchen, with taps to supply water. It is mainly used for washing dishes. As a verb, to sink means to go down below the surface of something, especially a liquid, or to move to a lower level.

words.tr: n. 面孔；“face”的复数； v. 面临；
words.ex: The children's faces lit up with joy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的面孔因喜悦而发光。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal; or to confront and deal with a problem or difficult situation.

words.tr: v. 有助于，有利于；帮助；帮助( help的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: Eating vegetables helped him stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜有助于他保持健康。
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of their work or by giving them advice or information.

words.ex: He equates success with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 他把成功等同于幸福。
words.en: To consider one thing to be the same as or equal to another thing.

words.ex: The movie was fairly interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影相当地有趣。
words.en: To a moderately sufficient extent or degree.

words.tr:
v. 叛乱；反叛；（使）厌恶
n. 叛乱；厌恶；反感
words.ex: The people revolt against the unfair rules.
words.ex_cn: 人们反抗不公平的规则。
words.en: If a large number of people revolt, they refuse to be controlled or ruled, and take action against authority, often violent action.

words.ex: The relays from the team were fast and accurate.
words.ex_cn: 团队的回答又快又准确。
words.en: A relay is a device that switches electrical circuits on and off. In sports, a relay is a race between teams in which each team member in turn covers part of the total distance.

words.ex: The city has many old canals.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有许多古老的运河。
words.en: A canal is a long, narrow stretch of water that has been made for boats to travel along or to bring water to a particular area.

words.ex: Many epochs have passed since the Earth was formed.
words.ex_cn: 自从地球形成以来，已经过去了许多地质年代。
words.en: An epoch is a period of time in history or a person's life, typically one marked by notable events or particular characteristics.

words.tr: v. 适应(fit的过去分词)；合适； adj. 有…设备的；合适的；按实物尺寸做的 v. 适应(fit的过去分词)；
words.ex: The shoes fitted her perfectly.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋非常适合她。
words.en: If something is fitted, it is designed to be the right size and shape for someone or something. If someone is fitted with something, it is attached to their body or made to fit onto it.

words.ex: Robert likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 罗伯特喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A common male given name, of Germanic origin meaning 'bright fame'.

words.ex: He made a big effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成这个项目，按时交工。
words.en: If you make an effort to do something, you try hard to do it.

words.ex: The parson delivered a sermon on the importance of charity.
words.ex_cn: 牧师在布道中讲述了慈善的重要性。
words.en: A parson is a priest in the Church of England who is in charge of a parish.

words.ex: They leased a car for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一辆车去度假。
words.en: To grant or obtain the temporary use of something, typically property, in exchange for regular payments.

words.ex: There is plenty of food for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有充足的食物。
words.en: A large or sufficient amount or quantity; more than enough.

words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.ex: This book is widely used in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: In a way that extends over a large area or range; extensively.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.tr: v. 使装满；使充满；“fill”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He filled the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满了水。
words.en: Something that is filled has a lot of a particular substance or material inside it.

words.ex: He started afresh after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后从头开始。
words.en: If you do something afresh, you do it again in a different way, often in a way that is better than before.

words.ex: I haven't seen him lately.
words.ex_cn: 我最近没见到他。
words.en: If you say that something has happened lately, you mean that it has happened recently.

words.ex: The golden sun set behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 金色的太阳在山后落下。
words.en: Something that is golden is bright yellow in color, like gold. It can also describe something that is very good or valuable.

words.tr: v. 选择；“choose”的过去分词； adj. 挑选出来的；
words.ex: He was chosen as the team captain.
words.ex_cn: 他被选为队长。
words.en: Having been selected as the best or most suitable.

words.ex: The books are theirs.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是他们的。
words.en: You use theirs to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.

words.tr: adj. 值得…的；值得尊敬的；
words.ex: This book is worthy of reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something or someone is worthy of something, they deserve it because they have the qualities or abilities required.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.tr: v. 滚动；“roll”的现在分词； n. 横摇； adj. 起伏的；转动的；摇摆的；
words.ex: The ball is rolling down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 球正在滚下山坡。
words.en: Moving by turning over and over on an axis.

words.ex: The prisoner wore iron fetters on his legs.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的腿上戴着铁镣。
words.en: Fetters are chains or shackles for the feet, used to restrain a prisoner or slave. Figuratively, they can refer to anything that restricts someone's freedom.

words.ex: The president will declare a holiday next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将在下周宣布放假。
words.en: If you declare something, you state it formally, publicly, or officially.

words.ex: I play soccer with my friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我每个周末都和朋友一起踢足球。
words.en: A friend is someone who you know well and like, but who is not related to you.

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.ex: He secures the door before leaving the house.
words.ex_cn: 他离开家前确保门是锁好的。
words.en: To make something safe or certain; to obtain something.

words.tr: adj. 印刷的； v. 打印；印刷；“print”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He bought a printed book from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店买了一本印刷的书。
words.en: Produced by or involving the process of printing, especially on paper or fabric.

words.ex: The servant cleaned the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 仆人每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A servant is someone who is employed to work in another person's house, doing jobs such as cooking and cleaning.

words.ex: He is stating his opinion clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在清楚地表达自己的观点。
words.en: To state means to express something in speech or writing, especially clearly and definitely.

words.tr: v. 要价；指控；“charge”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 充了电的（带电的）；引起强烈感情的；
words.ex: The shop charged $50 for the shirt.
words.ex_cn: 这家店给这件衬衫要价50美元。
words.en: If a situation or atmosphere is charged, it is filled with emotion and therefore exciting or tense. If someone is charged with a crime, they are officially accused of it.

words.ex: He deduced the answer from the clues.
words.ex_cn: 他从线索中推断出了答案。
words.en: To deduce means to reach a conclusion by reasoning from evidence or premises.

words.ex: He lost his fortune in the stock market.
words.ex_cn: 他在股市中失去了他的财产。
words.en: A large amount of money or assets; chance or luck as an external force in human affairs.

words.ex: He felt trapped in bondage.
words.ex_cn: 他感到被困在束缚中。
words.en: Bondage refers to the state of being a slave or being under the control of another person.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.ex: The readers enjoy the new book.
words.ex_cn: 读者们喜欢这本新书。
words.en: People who read, especially those who read a particular book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.tr: adv. 清楚地；明显地；明白地
words.ex: She spoke plainly, without any attempt to hide her feelings.
words.ex_cn: 她直率地说话，毫不掩饰自己的感情。
words.en: In a manner that is easy to perceive or understand; clearly.

words.ex: The postman delivered three parcels this morning.
words.ex_cn: 邮递员今天早上送了三个包裹。
words.en: Parcels refer to packages wrapped for sending through the post or by courier. It can also mean to divide something into parts and distribute them.

words.ex: The red light signifies stop.
words.ex_cn: 红灯表示停止。
words.en: If an event, a sign, or a symbol signifies something, it is a sign of that thing or represents that thing.

words.ex: The police enforce the law.
words.ex_cn: 警察强制执行法律。
words.en: If people in authority enforce a law or a rule, they make sure that it is obeyed, usually by punishing people who do not obey it.

words.tr: n. 住房供给； v. 收容；“house”的现在分词；
words.ex: The city needs more housing for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为低收入家庭提供更多的住房供给。
words.en: Housing refers to buildings or other shelters in which people live; a place to live.

words.ex: He is confined to his room because he is sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病被限制在房间里。
words.en: If you confine something or someone, you limit them to a particular place or situation.

words.ex: She combines flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To combine means to join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.ex: The country annexed the small island to its territory.
words.ex_cn: v. 该国将小岛并入了其领土。
words.en: To annex means to add or attach something, especially to a larger or more important thing, or to take control of a country or region by force.

words.ex: The journalist referred to the Hansard to verify the politician's statement.
words.ex_cn: 记者查阅了英国议会议事录以核实政治家的声明。
words.en: The official report of the proceedings of the British Parliament, including debates and speeches.

words.ex: The rubber band is elastic.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋是有弹性的。
words.en: An elastic material is able to stretch and then return to its original shape or size.

words.ex: The train arrives at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车在下午五点到达。
words.en: To reach a place, especially at the end of a journey.

words.ex: The locality has many small shops and cafes.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多小商店和咖啡馆。
words.en: A locality is a particular place or area, especially in relation to its geographical position or features.

words.tr: adj. 悲惨的；不幸的；难过的；恶劣的
words.ex: He felt wretched after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到很悲惨。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as wretched, you mean that they are in a very bad or unfortunate situation.

words.ex: I can't find my keys anywhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在任何地方都找不到我的钥匙。
words.en: in, at, or to any place, when it does not matter where

words.tr: v. 处理；安排；使倾向于
words.ex: She disposes of her old clothes by donating them to charity.
words.ex_cn: 她通过捐赠给慈善机构来处理她的旧衣服。
words.en: To arrange or settle matters; to get rid of something; to incline or influence someone towards a particular state of mind.

words.ex: The new product is highly saleable and has already sold out.
words.ex_cn: 这款新产品非常畅销，已经售罄。
words.en: If something is saleable, it is easy to sell or likely to be sold.

words.ex: His words had a profound effect on her life.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的生活产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe something as profound, you mean that it is very great or intense.

words.ex: He supposes that the meeting will be postponed.
words.ex_cn: v. 他认为会议将会被推迟。
words.en: If you suppose that something is true, you believe that it is probably true, although you are not certain.

words.tr: v. 利用；使用；“utilize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He utilised the old wood to make a table.
words.ex_cn: 他利用旧木头做了一张桌子。
words.en: To utilise means to make practical and effective use of something.

words.ex: The kingdom was governed by a wise king.
words.ex_cn: 这个王国由一位英明的国王统治。
words.en: To control and direct the public business of a country, city, group of people, etc.

words.ex: France is a republic with a president.
words.ex_cn: 法国是一个有总统的共和国。
words.en: A republic is a country where power is held by the people or their elected representatives, and which has an elected or nominated president rather than a monarch.

words.tr: v. 超过； adj. 超过( exceed的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 他超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in number or size than something else.

words.ex: The dominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间占优势的颜色是蓝色。
words.en: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.ex: The rotation of teachers helps the school run smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 教师的轮换有助于学校顺利运行。
words.en: Rotation refers to the action of rotating around an axis or center.

words.ex: The officer executed the order quickly.
words.ex_cn: 军官迅速执行了命令。
words.en: Carried out or performed an action, plan, or order; put to death as a legal penalty.

words.ex: The water in the pond was stagnant.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里的水不流动。
words.en: If something such as a business or economy is stagnant, there is little activity or change.

words.ex: The efficacy of the medicine is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物的效果是明显的。
words.en: The ability to produce a desired or intended result.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.tr: v. 命名；“entitle”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有资格的；
words.ex: They entitled the book 'The Silent Wind'.
words.ex_cn: 他们给这本书命名为《寂静的风》。
words.en: If you are entitled to something, you have the right to have it or do it.

words.ex: This book belonged to my grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我祖父。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours. If you belong to a group or organization, you are a member of it.

words.ex: The teacher will critique the student's essay tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会对学生的作文发表评论。
words.en: A critique is a detailed analysis and assessment of something, especially a literary, philosophical, or political theory.

words.tr: v. 认为；以为；相信；对…信以为真；相信( believe的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: I believed he was right.
words.ex_cn: 我认为他是对的。
words.en: If you believe someone or believe what they say, you accept that they are telling the truth. If you believe in something, you think that it is good or right.

words.ex: The police set up barriers on the road.
words.ex_cn: 警察在道路上设置了路障。
words.en: A barrier is a problem, rule, or situation that prevents someone from doing something, or that makes it difficult for them to do it.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏足够教育的；贫穷的； v. 剥夺；使丧失；“deprive”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: Children from deprived areas often struggle to read and write.
words.ex_cn: 来自教育缺乏地区的儿童常常难以阅读和写作。
words.en: If you are deprived of something that you want or need, you do not have it.

words.ex: He attends three lectures every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周上三节讲课。
words.en: Lectures are talks that are given to a group of people to teach them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course.

words.ex: He was the earliest student to arrive at school.
words.ex_cn: 他是最早到校的学生。
words.en: The superlative form of 'early', meaning happening or done before the usual or expected time.

words.ex: The engineers built a new bridge over the river.
words.ex_cn: 工程师们在河上建了一座新桥。
words.en: A person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or public works.

words.tr: n. 时刻；机会( occasion的名词复数 )；
words.ex: We meet on special occasions.
words.ex_cn: 我们在特殊时刻见面。
words.en: Specific times or events suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.tr: v. 征服；克服；攻克( conquer的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The army conquered the small kingdom last year.
words.ex_cn: 军队去年征服了那个小王国。
words.en: If you conquer something, you succeed in ending a problem or overcoming a difficulty.

words.ex: He felt isolation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到孤立。
words.en: The state of being in a place or situation that is separate from others

words.ex: The rain is affecting the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 雨正在影响野餐。
words.en: If something is affecting, it makes you feel strong emotions, especially sadness or pity.

words.ex: The painting is imperfect but full of feeling.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画不完美，但充满情感。
words.en: If something is imperfect, it has faults or is not complete.

words.tr: v. 使满意，满足( satisfy的第三人称单数 ); 使确信; 符合，达到（要求、规定、标准等）
words.ex: This number satisfies the equation.
words.ex_cn: 这个数满足这个方程。
words.en: If someone or something satisfies you, they give you enough of what you want or need to make you pleased or contented.

words.tr: n. 技工; 技师; 创造者; 能工巧匠
words.ex: The artificer made a wooden robot by hand.
words.ex_cn: 工匠手工制作了一个木制机器人。
words.en: A skilled craftsperson or inventor, especially one who creates or designs something.

words.tr: v. 使经受；使遭受；提交( subject的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He was subjected to cold weather during the hike.
words.ex_cn: 他在徒步旅行中经受了寒冷的天气。
words.en: If someone is subjected to something, they are made to experience it, often something unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 水平测量；平整；使平等
words.ex: The workers are levelling the ground for the new building.
words.ex_cn: 工人们正在为新建筑平整地面。
words.en: The process of making something flat or equal, or the act of measuring the height of land.

words.ex: The blood had congealed on the wound.
words.ex_cn: 血在伤口上凝固了。
words.en: When a liquid congeals, it becomes very thick and almost solid, often because it has cooled.

words.ex: The occurring was sudden and surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个事件发生得很突然，让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: To happen or take place; to be found or exist in a particular place or situation.

words.tr: adj. 再发的；循环的； v. “recur”的现在分词；
words.ex: He has a recurring headache every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都会复发头痛。
words.en: Happening or appearing again or repeatedly.

words.ex: He raised an objection to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他对新规定提出了反对。
words.en: An objection is an expression or feeling of disapproval or opposition; a reason for disagreeing.

words.tr: v. 拥抱；包含（embrace 的现在分词）；
words.ex: She is embracing her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她正在拥抱她的弟弟。
words.en: To hold someone closely in one's arms, especially as a sign of affection; to accept or support a belief, theory, or change willingly and enthusiastically.

words.tr:
n. 漠视；忽视；
v. 漠视；不理会；不顾；
words.ex: His advice was met with disregard.
words.ex_cn: 他的建议遭到了漠视。
words.en: If you disregard something, you ignore it or do not take account of it.

words.tr: n. 弗雷德里克（男子名）
words.ex: Frederick is a common name in many European countries.
words.ex_cn: 弗雷德里克是许多欧洲国家的常见名字。
words.en: Frederick is a male given name of Germanic origin, meaning 'peaceful ruler'.

words.ex: The spokesmen spoke for the company.
words.ex_cn: 这些发言人代表公司发言。
words.en: A spokesman is a person who speaks on behalf of a group or an organization.

words.tr: adj．不同的，有差异的：在性质、特点、意见等方面存在差异或不一致。
words.ex: The two accounts of the incident were widely differing.
words.ex_cn: 关于这一事件的两个描述大相径庭。
words.en: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

words.tr: v. 伪装；掩饰；“disguise”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He wore a hat and glasses to keep himself disguised.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着帽子和眼镜来伪装自己。
words.en: If you are disguised, you are wearing clothes and perhaps other things such as a wig or false beard so that people will not recognize you.

words.tr: adj. 控制的；管理的； v. “govern”的现在分词；
words.ex: The governing rules are simple and clear.
words.ex_cn: 控制的规则简单而清晰。
words.en: Having the authority to control or direct the actions of a country, organization, or group.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.tr: v. 竞争；比赛；“compete”的现在分词； adj. 相互矛盾的；
words.ex: Two companies are competing for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司正在为相同的客户竞争。
words.en: If one company or country competes with another, it tries to get people to buy its goods or services rather than those of the other company or country.

words.ex: He translated the letter into Chinese.
words.ex_cn: 他把这封信翻译成了中文。
words.en: To translate means to change speech or writing into another language, or to change something into a different form or medium.

words.tr: v. 卸船； adj. 放电的，泻出的 v. 下（客）( discharge的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The workers discharged the cargo from the ship.
words.ex_cn: 工人们把货物从船上卸下来。
words.en: Allowed to leave a hospital or medical facility after treatment.

words.ex: The characters in the story are very funny.
words.ex_cn: 故事中的角色非常有趣。
words.en: If you describe someone's character, you are describing their personality and the way they behave. If something has a particular character, it has a particular quality or feature.

words.tr:
adj. 指定的；标出的；
vt. 把……定名为；指定；标示；
words.ex: The designated teacher will help the new students.
words.ex_cn: 指定的老师将帮助新生。
words.en: If something is designated for a particular purpose, it is set aside for that purpose.

words.ex: The inequality between rich and poor is growing.
words.ex_cn: 贫富之间的不平等正在加剧。
words.en: Inequality refers to the unfair situation in society when some people have more opportunities, money, etc. than other people.

words.ex: The joy was transitory, and soon he felt sad again.
words.ex_cn: 这种快乐是暂时的，不久他又感到悲伤了。
words.en: Something that is transitory lasts only for a short time.

words.tr: adj. 不完全的；不完整的；
words.ex: The puzzle is incomplete without the last piece.
words.ex_cn: 没有最后一块，这个拼图是不完全的。
words.en: If something is incomplete, it is not yet finished, or it does not have all the parts that it should have.

words.ex: He is possessing a rare collection of stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一套稀有的邮票收藏。
words.en: Having or holding as property; owning.

words.ex: His attendance at the meeting was mandatory.
words.ex_cn: 他必须出席这次会议。
words.en: The act of being present at a place or event.

words.tr:
adj. 可消费的；可消耗的
n. 消耗品；消费品
words.ex: He bought a pack of consumable paper for the printer.
words.ex_cn: 他为打印机买了一包一次性用纸。
words.en: Something that is consumable is intended to be used and then replaced.

words.tr: n. 新教徒（16世纪脱离罗马天主教的基督教徒）
words.ex: He is a protestant who goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名新教徒，每周日都去教堂。
words.en: A Protestant is a member or follower of any of the Western Christian churches that are separate from the Roman Catholic Church and follow the principles of the Reformation, including the Baptist, Presbyterian, and Lutheran churches.

words.tr: adj. 模糊的；不确定的；无限期的
words.ex: He gave an indefinite answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个不确定的答案。
words.en: If you describe something as indefinite, you mean that it has not been decided or defined clearly, or that it has no clear limit or end.

words.ex: He makes occasional visits to his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望祖父母。
words.en: Occasional means happening or done sometimes, but not regularly or often.

words.ex: The plant's roots help in the absorption of water.
words.ex_cn: 植物的根有助于水分的吸收。
words.en: The process by which one thing absorbs or is absorbed by another.

words.ex: The mysterious box appeared on his doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 那个神秘的盒子出现在他的门口。
words.en: If someone or something is mysterious, it is not fully understood or explained and seems interesting or puzzling.

words.tr: adj. 著名的； v. 庆祝；“celebrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a celebrated painter in China.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位在中国著名的画家。
words.en: A celebrated person or thing is famous and much admired.

words.ex: The artificers worked tirelessly to complete the intricate design.
words.ex_cn: 工匠们不知疲倦地工作，以完成复杂的设计。
words.en: Artificers are skilled craftsmen or inventors who create or construct things with great skill and ingenuity.

words.ex: The movie was enormously popular.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极度受欢迎。
words.en: To a very great degree or extent; extremely.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.ex: He earned a respectable salary last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年挣了一份可观的薪水。
words.en: Someone or something that is respectable is approved of by society and considered to be morally correct.

words.ex: The alternation of day and night is natural.
words.ex_cn: 昼夜的交替是自然的。
words.en: The act or process of alternating; a successive change or variation.

words.tr: v. 反驳，否认…的真实性( contradict的第三人称单数 ); 与…发生矛盾，与…抵触
words.ex: His story contradicts the evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他的说法与证据相矛盾。
words.en: Is in conflict with or denies the truth of something.

words.ex: The predominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的主导颜色是蓝色。
words.en: If something is predominant, it is more important, noticeable, or powerful than the other things in a situation.

words.ex: The village is still undeveloped with no roads or electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄仍然不发达，没有道路和电力。
words.en: An undeveloped area of land is one that has not been used for building or farming.

words.ex: The storm was destructive and broke many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴具有破坏性，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: Causing great and irreparable harm or damage.

words.ex: He is undoubtedly the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是班上最好的学生。
words.en: Without doubt; certainly.

words.ex: He permanently moved to Canada last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年永久搬到了加拿大。
words.en: In a way that continues or lasts forever without changing.

words.ex: The significance of this discovery changed science.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现的重要性改变了科学。
words.en: The quality of being worthy of attention; importance.

words.ex: The oscillations of the pendulum were measured accurately.
words.ex_cn: n. 钟摆的摆动被精确测量。
words.en: Oscillations refer to regular variations in magnitude or position around a central point, often seen in physical systems like pendulums or electrical circuits.

words.tr: n. 开始；毕业典礼；学位授予典礼
words.ex: The commencement of the class was at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程的开始时间是上午9点。
words.en: The commencement of something is its beginning.

words.tr: v. 伴随；陪伴；陪同；“accompany”的现在分词； adj. 伴随的；陪伴的；附随的；
words.ex: The music was accompanying her dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐伴随着她的舞蹈。
words.en: If something is accompanying another thing, it is present or occurs with it.

words.tr: v. 促成; （突如其来地）使发生( precipitate的过去式和过去分词 ); 猛然摔下; 使
words.ex: The sudden news precipitated his decision to leave.
words.ex_cn: 突如其来的消息促使他决定离开。
words.en: To cause something to happen suddenly or unexpectedly; to hasten the occurrence of an event; to cause a substance to be deposited in solid form from a solution.

words.ex: The neighbouring town has a big market.
words.ex_cn: 邻近的城镇有一个大市场。
words.en: Neighbouring places are next to or near each other.

words.ex: The accumulations of snow made the roads impassable.
words.ex_cn: 积雪使得道路无法通行。
words.en: The act of gathering or amassing, or something that has been gathered or amassed.

words.ex: You need math skills as prerequisites for this course.
words.ex_cn: 你需要数学技能作为这门课程的必要条件。
words.en: Something that is required as a prior condition for something else to happen or exist.

words.tr: vt. 彻底改变（revolutionise 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: The smartphone revolutionised how people communicate.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机彻底改变了人们的沟通方式。
words.en: To completely change something so that it is much better.

words.tr: n. 误解；误会； v. “misunderstand”的现在分词；
words.ex: There was a misunderstanding between them about the time.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间对时间产生了误解。
words.en: A misunderstanding is a failure to understand something correctly, often leading to confusion or disagreement.

words.tr:
n. 脂肪；
adj. 肥的；
words.ex: This food has too much fat.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有太多脂肪。
words.en: Fat is a substance contained in foods such as meat, cheese, and butter, which is used by the body to produce energy or stored in the body as a layer.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.ex: He wears a black hat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天戴一顶黑帽子。
words.en: A hat is a head covering which is worn for various reasons, including protection against weather conditions, ceremonial reasons such as university graduation, religious reasons, safety, or as a fashion accessory.

words.ex: The engine revs up when you press the accelerator.
words.ex_cn: 当你踩下油门时，发动机会加速。
words.en: To increase the speed of an engine rapidly.

words.ex: He asks me a question every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天问我一个问题。
words.en: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: His aims are to finish school and find a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是完成学业并找到一份好工作。
words.en: If you aim for something or aim to do something, you plan or hope to achieve it.

words.ex: The sun burned his skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳晒伤了他的皮肤。
words.en: Your skin is the natural outer covering of your body.

words.tr: adj. 出生的；天生的； v. 生（孩子）；“bear”的过去分词；
words.ex: He is a born teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是个天生的老师。
words.en: When a baby is born, it comes out of its mother's body at the beginning of its life.

words.tr:
adj. 蓝色的；
n. 蓝色；
words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: Blue is a color that is between green and violet in the spectrum of visible light. It is also used to describe something that is sad or depressed.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.ex: I hear birds singing in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我听到早晨鸟儿在唱歌。
words.en: To perceive or become aware of (sound) through the ear.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.tr: adj. 徒劳的；空虚的；自负的；爱慕虚荣的
words.ex: It's vain to try to fix what can't be fixed.
words.ex_cn: 试图修复无法修复的东西是徒劳的。
words.en: If you describe someone as vain, you are critical of their extreme pride in their own beauty, intelligence, or other good qualities.

words.tr: v. 画；提取；吸引；“draw”的过去式；
words.ex: He drew a cat on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一只猫。
words.en: Drew is the past tense of draw, which means to produce a picture or diagram by making lines and marks on paper or another surface.

words.tr:
n. 一条（面包）
v. 游荡；虚度光阴
words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: A loaf is a quantity of bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and usually sliced before being eaten. As a verb, to loaf means to spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

words.tr: n. 战争；竞争；战争( war的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The country suffered after the wars.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后遭受了苦难。
words.en: A state of armed conflict between different countries or different groups within a country.

words.ex: He found a penny on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上发现了一便士。
words.en: A penny is a small unit of currency used in the United Kingdom and the United States. In the UK, it is the smallest denomination of the pound sterling, and in the US, it is a cent, the smallest denomination of the dollar.

words.ex: David is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 大卫正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A male given name, derived from the Hebrew name דָּוִד (Dāwīḏ), meaning 'beloved'.

words.ex: He visited Egypt last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了埃及。
words.en: A country in northeastern Africa, known for its ancient civilization and monuments such as the pyramids.

words.ex: The child is happy when he plays with his toys.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子玩玩具时，他很快乐。
words.en: If you are happy, you are feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

words.ex: It was an utter mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个完全的错误。
words.en: To say something or to make a sound with your voice; complete or absolute.

words.tr:
adj. 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的；总的；
n. 大钢琴；
words.ex: The grand castle stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 壮丽的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: If you describe a building or a piece of scenery as grand, you mean that its size or appearance is very impressive.

words.tr: n. 物品；商品；项目；条款；“item”的复数；
words.ex: These items are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 这些物品在桌子上。
words.en: Objects or articles that are used for a particular purpose or are present in a situation.

words.ex: The Earth is a globe.
words.ex_cn: 地球是一个球体。
words.en: The globe is the world; especially used to refer to the Earth as a planet.

words.tr: v. 停留；停止； n. 停留，停止( stay的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He stays at home on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他在周末待在家里。
