words.en: If you stay where you are, you continue to be there and do not leave. If you stay in a particular state or situation, you continue to be in it.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.ex: He saves money by walking to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来省钱。
words.en: To save means to keep something, especially money or time, for use in the future, or to prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.tr:
n. 前面；前线；
adj. 前面的；
words.ex: The front of the house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 房子的前面有一个大花园。
words.en: The front is the part of something that faces forward or is the most important or prominent part.

words.ex: He writes a letter every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写一封信。
words.en: To write means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.ex: I truly appreciate your help.
words.ex_cn: 我衷心感谢你的帮助。
words.en: You use truly to emphasize that something has all the features or qualities of a particular thing, or is the case to the fullest possible extent.

words.tr: n. 群体；殖民地；聚居地；
words.ex: A colony of ants moved quickly across the ground.
words.ex_cn: 一群蚂蚁迅速从地上爬过。
words.en: A colony is a country or area that is under the political control of another country, usually one that is far away, and where people from that country live.

words.ex: He collected ancient specie from his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖父那里收集了古代硬币。
words.en: Specie refers to coins, especially those made of precious metals, used as money.

words.tr: v. 失去；输；“lose”的现在分词； n. 失败；损失；
words.ex: He is losing his keys again.
words.ex_cn: 他又在丢钥匙。
words.en: The act of failing to win or to keep something.

words.tr: adj. 明亮的；鲜艳的；聪明的；
words.ex: The room is bright because of the big window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间因为大窗户而很明亮。
words.en: Emitting or reflecting much light; shining.

words.ex: The two countries signed an accord to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项协议以停止战争。
words.en: An accord is an official agreement or treaty. It can also refer to a state of agreement or harmony.

words.tr: n. 货物; 装载; 汲取 v. 装载（货物），装（船），（用勺子）舀出( lade的现在分词 )
words.ex: The lading list shows all the goods on the ship.
words.ex_cn: 载货单显示了船上所有的货物。
words.en: The act of loading goods onto a vehicle or vessel for transport.

words.tr:
adj. 偏远的；久远的；
n. 遥控器；
words.ex: The village is in a remote area far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于远离城市的偏远地区。
words.en: Remote areas are far away from cities and places where most people live, and are therefore difficult to get to.

words.ex: He will surely come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天一定会来。
words.en: without doubt; certainly

words.ex: Spring is a beautiful season.
words.ex_cn: 春天是一个美丽的季节。
words.en: A season is one of the four periods of the year: spring, summer, autumn, or winter. It can also refer to a period of the year characterized by particular conditions of weather, temperature, etc., or a period of the year when a particular sport is played.

words.ex: She picked up a needle to sew the button.
words.ex_cn: 她拿起一根针来缝纽扣。
words.en: A needle is a thin, pointed piece of metal that is used in sewing. It has a hole at one end for thread to pass through.

words.tr:
adj. 稳定的；
v. 使稳住；
words.ex: The boat moved in a steady way on the calm sea.
words.ex_cn: 船在平静的海面上平稳地移动。
words.en: If something is steady, it is firm and does not shake or move about. If you steady something, you stop it from shaking or moving about.

words.tr: n. 商店；“store”的复数； v. 贮藏；
words.ex: There are many stores on this street.
words.ex_cn: 这条街上有很多商店。
words.en: A place where merchandise is offered for sale; also, the act of keeping something for future use.

words.ex: The clothes are drying in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 衣服正在阳光下变干。
words.en: The process of removing moisture from something.

words.ex: He decides to go home early.
words.ex_cn: 他决定早点回家。
words.en: If you decide to do something, you choose to do it, usually after you have thought carefully about the other possibilities.

words.tr: v. 编辑；编辑( edit的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He edited the article before publishing it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发布前编辑了这篇文章。
words.en: Changed or modified in order to improve or correct.

words.ex: Nobody knows the answer.
words.ex_cn: 没有人知道答案。
words.en: Nobody means not any person or no person.

words.tr: vt. 给……定价；问……的价格；“price”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The store priced the apples at $2 per pound.
words.ex_cn: 商店给苹果定价为每磅2美元。
words.en: Set at a particular price or cost.

words.tr: v. 好像，仿佛；好像，仿佛( seem的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He seemed tired after the long walk.
words.ex_cn: 经过长时间的散步，他看起来很累。
words.en: If something seems to be a particular thing or to have a particular quality, it appears to be that thing or to have that quality.

words.tr: n. 城堡的外墙；城堡的庭院
words.ex: The soldiers guarded the bailey of the old castle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们守卫着古老城堡的外墙。
words.en: A bailey is the outer wall of a castle or the courtyard enclosed by such a wall.

words.ex: The workers joined the unions to protect their rights.
words.ex_cn: 工人们加入了工会以保护他们的权利。
words.en: A union is an organization formed by workers to protect their rights and interests at work.

words.ex: The river splits into two smaller streams.
words.ex_cn: 这条河分裂成两条小溪。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.tr:
adj. 诺曼人的；
n. 诺曼底人；
words.ex: The Norman soldiers wore heavy armor.
words.ex_cn: 诺曼士兵穿着厚重的盔甲。
words.en: A Norman is a member of the people of Normandy in northern France, especially in the context of the Norman conquest of England in 1066.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: He keeps apples in the cellar.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果存放在地窖里。
words.en: A cellar is a room underneath a house, often used for storing things such as wine or coal.

words.ex: The seasons follow a yearly cycle.
words.ex_cn: 季节遵循一年一度的周期。
words.en: Cycles refer to a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order, or a complete sequence of a recurring phenomenon such as the phases of the moon. It can also mean to ride a bicycle.

words.tr: adj. 深奥的；深的；严重的；深的( deep的比较级 )；
words.ex: This book has a deeper meaning than it first appears.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的意义比表面上看起来更深奥。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface.

words.tr: v. 同意，赞同( agree的第三人称单数 ); [语法学]（在性、数、人称或格方面）一致; 相同
words.ex: He agrees with his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他同意他朋友的看法。
words.en: If someone agrees with a policy or action, they approve of it. If they agree to do something, they say they will do it.

words.tr: n. 烘焙； adj. 灼热的； v. “bake”的现在分词；
words.ex: Baking is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 烘焙是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The process of cooking food by dry heat without direct exposure to a flame, typically in an oven.

words.ex: The empire ruled many countries long ago.
words.ex_cn: 这个帝国很久以前统治了许多国家。
words.en: An empire is a group of countries or territories that are under the control of a single ruler or government.

words.ex: Samuel plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 塞缪尔每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: Samuel is a male given name of Hebrew origin, meaning 'name of God' or 'God has heard'.

words.ex: He deducts tax from his salary every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每月从工资中扣除税款。
words.en: If you deduct an amount from a total, you subtract it from the total.

words.ex: The rain lasted all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨下了一整天。
words.en: To continue in time; go on.

words.ex: Unlike his brother, he likes quiet places.
words.ex_cn: 不像他的兄弟，他喜欢安静的地方。
words.en: If one thing is unlike another thing, the two things are different in nature or in appearance.

words.ex: The bridge is stable and safe to cross.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥很稳固，可以安全通过。
words.en: If something is stable, it is not likely to change or come to an end suddenly.

words.ex: He firmly believes in truth.
words.ex_cn: 他坚定地相信真理。
words.en: In a way that is strong and not likely to change or move.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: Whoever wants to join can sign up.
words.ex_cn: 任何想加入的人都可以报名。
words.en: used to refer to any person or people, when it does not matter who

words.ex: The warehouse is for storing goods.
words.ex_cn: 这个仓库用于保管货物。
words.en: The act of keeping something in a particular place until it is needed.

words.ex: The asiatic tiger lives in the forests of India.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲虎生活在印度的森林里。
words.en: relating to Asia or its people, customs, or languages.

words.tr: adj. 已婚的； v. 结婚；“marry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They are married and have two children.
words.ex_cn: 他们已婚，有两个孩子。
words.en: Having a husband or wife; united in matrimony.

words.ex: His neglect of the project caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 他对项目的疏忽导致了延误。
words.en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the attention or care that they need.

words.ex: He suffers from a cold.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了。
words.en: If you suffer pain, you feel it in your body or in your mind. If you suffer from an illness or a condition, you have it.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: Symbols are marks or signs that represent something else, such as an idea, a quality, or a relationship.

words.tr: v. 强迫；“force”的现在分词； n. 催熟；
words.ex: They were forcing him to work late.
words.ex_cn: 他们强迫他加班。
words.en: Forcing refers to the act of making someone do something against their will, often using threats or physical power.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is painful.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口很疼。
words.en: If something is painful, it causes you a lot of physical or emotional pain.

words.ex: She buys soft fabrics for her dresses.
words.ex_cn: 她为自己的连衣裙购买柔软的布料。
words.en: Fabrics are materials made by weaving or knitting fibers together, used for making clothes, curtains, etc., or the structure or foundation of something.

words.ex: She attains her goals through hard work.
words.ex_cn: 她通过努力工作达到了她的目标。
words.en: To achieve or reach a goal, level, or standard through effort.

words.ex: Every citizen must follow the law.
words.ex_cn: 每个公民都必须遵守法律。
words.en: A citizen is a person who is legally recognized as a member of a country or state, either by birth or by naturalization, and who is entitled to its protection and privileges.

words.tr: v. 抓住；持有；举行；容纳；保存；“hold”的现在分词； n. 土地；
words.ex: He is holding the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他正紧紧地抓住绳子。
words.en: A holding is a piece of land that is owned by someone or the shares that someone owns in a company.

words.tr:
adv. 向前；前进；
v. 促进；转交；
adj. 向前的；前进的；
words.ex: He walked forward to meet the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去见老师。
words.en: If you move or look forward, you move or look in a direction that is in front of you. In British English, you can also say that you are looking forward to something that is going to happen.

words.tr: n. 费用；控告；指控；负荷；装载；电荷；收费；掌管；“charge”的复数；
words.ex: The hotel charges are very high.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的费用很高。
words.en: If you charge someone an amount of money, you ask them to pay that amount for something that you have sold to them or done for them. Charges are formal accusations that someone has committed a crime.

words.tr:
v. 承诺；答应；
n. 许诺；希望；成功的征兆（或理由）；
words.ex: He promised to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮我做作业。
words.en: A promise is a statement that you will definitely do something or that something will definitely happen.

words.ex: He exercises to strengthen his muscles.
words.ex_cn: 他锻炼以增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscles are the tissues in the body that allow you to move by contracting and relaxing.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.tr: v. 订购；命令；点餐；“order”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I ordered a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我订购了一份披萨当晚餐。
words.en: Arranged or disposed in a neat, tidy way or in a regular sequence.

words.ex: The officer gave a clear order to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军官向士兵下达了明确的命令。
words.en: An officer is a person in a position of authority in the armed forces, the police, or a government organization.

words.ex: Firstly, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: You use firstly in speech or writing when you want to give a reason, make a point, or mention an item that will be followed by others connected with it.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.ex: The professor gave a lecture on history.
words.ex_cn: 教授上了一节历史课。
words.en: A lecture is a talk that someone gives in order to teach people about a particular subject, often at a university or college.

words.ex: The vessels sailed across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些船航行在海上。
words.en: A vessel is a ship or large boat, or a container for holding liquids, or a tube that carries blood through the body.

words.tr: v. 赠给，授予( bestow的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: The award was bestowed upon her by the president.
words.ex_cn: 这个奖项由总统授予了她。
words.en: given or granted as an honor, gift, or privilege.

words.tr:
adv. 径直；直接；直；
adj. 直的；
words.ex: He walked straight to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他径直走向门。
words.en: extending or moving uniformly in one direction only; without a curve or bend.

words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If something reflects an attitude or situation, it shows that the attitude or situation exists or it shows what it is like.

words.tr: n. 清洁；打扫； v. 打扫；“clean”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cleaning of the room took an hour.
words.ex_cn: 打扫房间花了一个小时。
words.en: The act of making something clean, especially the inside of a house or building.

words.tr:
adj. 编号的；有限的；时日无多的
v. 总计；归入；算作；编号；“number”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The pages are numbered.
words.ex_cn: 这些页面是有编号的。
words.en: Having a number or numbers assigned; limited in number.

words.ex: He computed the answer in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 他五分钟内算出了答案。
words.en: To calculate or reckon a figure or amount.

words.ex: The crowding on the bus made it hard to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 公交车上的拥挤让人难以呼吸。
words.en: The presence of a large number of people or things in a space that is too small to accommodate them comfortably.

words.tr: v. 突然消失；销声匿迹；“vanish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 消失了的；
words.ex: The magician vanished in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师在观众面前突然消失了。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.tr: adj. 无知的；缺乏知识的
words.ex: He was ignorant of the basic rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对基本规则一无所知。
words.en: If you describe someone as ignorant, you mean that they do not know things they should know. If someone is ignorant of a fact, they do not know it.

words.tr: adj. 离婚的； v. “divorce”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a divorced father with two children.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有兩個孩子的離婚父親。
words.en: If someone is divorced, they are no longer married because their marriage has been legally ended.

words.ex: The order was reversed.
words.ex_cn: 顺序被颠倒了。
words.en: If something is reversed, it is changed so that it is the opposite of what it was before.

words.ex: The helmet prevents head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 头盔能防止头部受伤。
words.en: To stop something from happening or someone from doing something.

words.ex: The engine has four cylinders.
words.ex_cn: 发动机有四个气缸。
words.en: A cylinder is a geometric figure with straight parallel sides and a circular or oval cross section.

words.tr: v. 使贬值；降低…的价值；使显得廉价
words.ex: He cheapens the gift by saying it was free.
words.ex_cn: 他说礼物是免费的，这使得礼物显得没那么贵重了。
words.en: To make something seem less valuable or important.

words.ex: The soldiers marched in a line.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们列队行进。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: To say, write, or do something as a reaction to a question, letter, etc.

words.ex: I am familiar with this song.
words.ex_cn: 我熟悉这首歌。
words.en: If someone or something is familiar to you, you recognize them or know them well.

words.tr: v. 安排；“arrange”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 安排的；
words.ex: They arranged a meeting for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们安排了明天的会议。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

words.ex: He gave an indirect answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个间接的答案。
words.en: An indirect result or effect is not caused immediately and obviously by a thing or person, but happens because of something else that they have done.

words.ex: He lost his pecuniary support after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了经济支持。
words.en: Pecuniary means relating to money, especially in terms of financial gain or loss.

words.tr: v. 诈骗，骗取钱财( swindle的现在分词 )
words.ex: He is swindling old people out of their money.
words.ex_cn: 他正在欺骗老人的钱。
words.en: Swindling refers to the act of deceiving someone in order to gain something, especially money, dishonestly.

words.ex: His intention was to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.tr: v. 递送；交付；发表； adj. 递送，交付( deliver的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The postman delivered the letter yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 邮递员昨天送来了那封信。
words.en: If you deliver something somewhere, you take it there. If you deliver a speech or a performance, you say or do it in public.

words.ex: The country abolished the old law last year.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家去年废除了旧法律。
words.en: If someone in authority abolishes a system or practice, they formally put an end to it.

words.tr: n. 至高无上；最大权力；最高地位；
words.ex: The king claimed supremacy over all other rulers.
words.ex_cn: 国王宣称自己对所有其他统治者拥有至高无上的权力。
words.en: Supremacy is the state or condition of being superior to all others in authority, power, or status.

words.ex: There are many varieties of apples in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的苹果。
words.en: Varieties refers to the quality or state of being different or diverse; the absence of uniformity, sameness, or monotony.

words.ex: The exploiter took advantage of the workers' lack of knowledge.
words.ex_cn: 剥削者利用了工人们的知识不足。
words.en: An exploiter is someone who uses others unfairly for their own advantage, especially by giving them very little in return for their work.

words.ex: Farmers cultivate rice in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植水稻。
words.en: To cultivate land means to prepare it and grow crops on it. To cultivate a particular quality, skill, or attitude means to try hard to develop it and make it stronger.

words.ex: He is incapable of solving simple math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他无法解决简单的数学问题。
words.en: If someone is incapable of doing something, they are unable to do it.

words.ex: He has prejudice against people from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 他对来自其他国家的人有偏见。
words.en: Prejudice is an unreasonable dislike of a particular group of people or things, or a preference for one group of people or things over another.

words.ex: He traveled to several provinces in China.
words.ex_cn: 他去了中国的几个省份。
words.en: Provinces are the main administrative divisions of a country or state, often with their own local government and distinct characteristics.

words.ex: Elizabeth walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 伊丽莎白每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: A female given name, often associated with British royalty.

words.tr: prep. 关于； v. 看待；“regard”的现在分词；
words.ex: He sent me an email regarding the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给我发了一封关于会议的邮件。
words.en: You can use regarding to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

words.tr: adj. 不足的；缺乏的；有缺陷的
words.ex: The plant is deficient in sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物缺乏阳光。
words.en: If someone or something is deficient in a particular thing, they do not have the full amount of it that they need.

words.ex: He read the afterword before going to bed.
words.ex_cn: 他在睡觉前读了后记。
words.en: An afterword is a section at the end of a book that provides additional information or reflections by the author or another contributor.

words.ex: He learned husbandry from his father on the farm.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里学会了畜牧业。
words.en: Husbandry is the careful management of resources, especially in agriculture or farming, to ensure their efficient use and conservation.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.tr: adj. 优秀的；杰出的；卓越的；
words.ex: He got an excellent score on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了优异的成绩。
words.en: Something that is excellent is very good indeed.

words.ex: He did voluntary work at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院做志愿工作。
words.en: If something is voluntary, you do it because you choose to, and not because you have to.

words.tr: adj. 扭曲的； v. “distort”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The mirror made her face look distorted.
words.ex_cn: 镜子让她的脸看起来扭曲了。
words.en: If something is distorted, it has been changed from its usual, original, natural, or intended meaning, condition, or shape.

words.tr:
adj. 交替的；轮流的；间隔的；
v. （使）交替；（使）轮流；
words.ex: We take alternate days off work.
words.ex_cn: 我们隔天休息一次。
words.en: If something alternates between two things, it repeatedly changes from one to the other and back again.

words.tr: v. 获胜；（思想、观点等）被接受；获胜( prevail的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: Honesty prevailed in the end.
words.ex_cn: 最终，诚实获胜了。
words.en: If a proposal, principle, or opinion prevails, it gains influence or is accepted, often after a struggle or argument.

words.ex: She completes her homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: v. 她在晚饭前完成了她的作业。
words.en: To finish making or doing something.

words.tr: v. 锻炼，训练，练习；锻炼，训练，练习( exercise的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He exercised every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: To exercise means to engage in physical activity to sustain or improve health and fitness. It can also mean to use or apply a right, option, or ability.

words.ex: The mortality rate in the region increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年该地区的死亡率上升了。
words.en: Mortality refers to the state of being subject to death or the number of deaths in a particular population or period.

words.ex: She is a beautiful girl.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个美丽的女孩。
words.en: Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically.

words.ex: The monster made a monstrous sound.
words.ex_cn: 这个怪物发出了巨大的声音。
words.en: If you describe something as monstrous, you mean that it is extremely large or that it is extremely unpleasant or wrong.

words.ex: He gave a reasonable answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个合理的回答。
words.en: Fair and sensible; not excessive or extreme.

words.ex: The bank is a depository for gold.
words.ex_cn: 这家银行是黄金的贮藏所。
words.en: A place where something is deposited for safekeeping.

words.tr: v. 讨论；商讨；“discuss”的现在分词；
words.ex: They are discussing the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在讨论作业。
words.en: If people discuss something, they talk about it, often in order to reach a decision.

words.tr: v. 乘( multiply的第三人称单数 ); （使）相乘; （使）增加; （使）繁殖
words.ex: He multiplies 5 by 3 to get 15.
words.ex_cn: 他把5乘以3得到15。
words.en: To multiply means to increase greatly in number or to perform the mathematical operation of multiplication.

words.ex: The old model was superseded by a newer one.
words.ex_cn: 旧型号被一个更新的型号取代了。
words.en: If something is superseded by something newer, it is replaced because it has become old-fashioned or unacceptable.

words.ex: The heavy rain occasioned the cancellation of the outdoor event.
words.ex_cn: v. 大雨导致了户外活动的取消。
words.en: To cause something to happen or to be the reason for something.

words.ex: The tradition originated in ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: If something originates from a particular place, time, situation, or person, it begins to exist or happen in that place, at that time, in that situation, or because of that person.

words.ex: The store sells fresh foodstuffs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每天早上都出售新鲜食品。
words.en: Foodstuffs are substances that are used as food, especially in their raw or unprocessed state.

words.tr:
adj. 了解的；熟悉的
v. 使熟悉；使相识；“acquaint”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He is acquainted with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are acquainted with someone, you know them slightly.

words.ex: The price of milk fluctuates every week.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶的价格每周都在波动。
words.en: Changes irregularly in amount, level, or strength.

words.ex: He repeatedly asked for help.
words.ex_cn: 他再三地请求帮助。
words.en: If something is done repeatedly, it is done again and again.

words.ex: He explicitly said no to the offer.
words.ex_cn: 他明确地拒绝了这个提议。
words.en: In a clear and detailed manner, leaving no room for confusion or doubt.

words.tr: v. 把…归于；认为…是( attribute的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The success was attributed to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 成功被归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.tr: adj. 引起烦恼的；令人不安的； v. 打扰；妨碍；“disturb”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie showed a disturbing scene of violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一个引起烦恼的暴力场景。
words.en: If you describe something as disturbing, you mean that it makes you feel anxious or upset.

words.ex: The subjection of the people to the law is important.
words.ex_cn: 人民对法律的服从很重要。
words.en: The act of subjecting or the state of being subjected, especially to control or authority.

words.ex: The kitchen has new appliances.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里有新的电器。
words.en: Appliances are devices or machines, usually electrical, that are used in the home, for example for cooking, cleaning, or entertainment.

words.tr: adj. 波动的； v. “fluctuate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The price of oil is fluctuating every day.
words.ex_cn: 石油的价格每天都在波动。
words.en: If something fluctuates, it changes a lot in an irregular way.

words.ex: The rain was unavoidable during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨期间，下雨是不可避免的。
words.en: If something is unavoidable, it cannot be avoided or prevented.

words.ex: The two cultures have a lot of interchange.
words.ex_cn: 这两种文化有很多交流。
words.en: The act or process of exchanging things with each other, especially ideas or information.

words.tr: v. 捐献；撰稿；捐助；捐献( contribute的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He contributed money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐了钱。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you say or do things to help to make it successful.

words.tr: v. 构成; 建立( constitute的过去式和过去分词 ); 指定; （合法或正式地）成立
words.ex: The committee was constituted last week.
words.ex_cn: 这个委员会是上周成立的。
words.en: To be the parts or members that form something; to establish or create something.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: v. 促成；是……的原因之一；（为……）做贡献；捐赠；捐助；
words.ex: Hard work contributes to success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作促成成功。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen, or you give something, especially money or goods, to help achieve or provide something.

words.ex: The restoration of the old house took two years.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子的修复花了两年时间。
words.en: The act of returning something to its original condition, or the state of being returned to its original condition.

words.ex: The manufactory makes toys for children.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂为儿童生产玩具。
words.en: A manufactory is a factory where goods are manufactured or produced.

words.ex: He left the city, and thenceforth he lived in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了城市，从那时起就住在乡下。
words.en: From that time on or thereafter.

words.ex: He ascertained the answer by checking the math.
words.ex_cn: 他通过检查数学确认了答案。
words.en: To find out something or make sure of something.

words.ex: The displacement of the car was 10 meters east.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的位移是向东10米。
words.en: The act of moving something from its place or position, or the condition of having been moved from it.

words.ex: The food industry is plagued by the problem of adulteration.
words.ex_cn: 食品行业饱受掺假问题的困扰。
words.en: The act of making something poorer in quality by adding another substance to it.

words.tr: v. 使…成为必要，需要( necessitate的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: The accident necessitated a quick response.
words.ex_cn: 这起事故需要迅速响应。
words.en: If something necessitates a particular action, it makes that action necessary.

words.tr: adj. 不兼容的；不相配的；
words.ex: The software is incompatible with old systems.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件与旧系统不兼容。
words.en: If one thing or person is incompatible with another, they are very different in important ways, and do not suit each other or agree with each other.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.ex: He waited with anticipation for the results.
words.ex_cn: 他怀着期待等待结果。
words.en: Anticipation is a feeling of excitement about something pleasant or exciting that you know is going to happen.

words.tr: v. 描述…的特性；使具有…的特征
words.ex: This pattern characterises the data.
words.ex_cn: 这个模式体现了数据的特征。
words.en: To describe the distinctive nature or features of something or someone.

words.ex: The peculiarities of the old house confused the new owner.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子的奇特之处让新主人感到困惑。
words.en: The qualities or characteristics that make something or someone different from others, often in a way that is unusual or distinctive.

words.ex: The hotel gave us complimentary breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 酒店免费赠送了我们早餐。
words.en: If something is complimentary, it is given or done free of charge. It can also mean expressing a compliment; praising or approving.

words.ex: Unfortunately, he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 不幸的是，他错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect.

words.tr: adj. 个性化的，针对个人的
words.ex: The teacher gave each student an individualised learning plan.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生制定了个性化的学习计划。
words.en: Made or designed for a particular person or thing; tailored to individual needs or preferences.

words.tr: v. 区分，区别，辨别( differentiate的过去式和过去分词 ); 区别对待; 表明…间的
words.ex: The teacher differentiated the homework for each student.
words.ex_cn: 老师为每个学生区分了作业。
words.en: Having distinct parts or layers; in biology, having specialized cells or tissues.

words.tr: adv. 有系统地；有组织地；
words.ex: He systematically organized his books by subject.
words.ex_cn: 他有系统地按科目整理了他的书。
words.en: in a thorough, methodical, and organized manner

words.ex: He made his decision after careful considerations.
words.ex_cn: 他在仔细考虑后做出了决定。
words.en: Considerations are the thoughts or concerns that someone has when they are thinking about something or making a decision.

words.tr: n. 拟人化；人格化；化身；典型
words.ex: The statue is a personification of freedom.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像是自由的化身。
words.en: The act of attributing human characteristics to something nonhuman, or the representation of an abstract quality in human form.

words.ex: He sent the message via email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了这条消息。
words.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

words.tr:
n. 兽医；
v. 审查；
words.ex: The vet checked the dog's health.
words.ex_cn: 兽医检查了狗的健康状况。
words.en: A vet is a person who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals. As a verb, to vet means to examine something or someone carefully to make sure they are suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The thieves robbed the bank last night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷昨晚抢劫了银行。
words.en: To rob someone or somewhere means to take money or property illegally from them, often using force.

words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe money to someone, they have lent it to you and you have not yet paid it back. You can also say that you owe someone a debt of gratitude if they have helped you in a way that you feel you should thank them for.

words.tr: abbr.abbr. 加值型经销商（value-added reseller）；垂直机载火箭（Vertical...
words.ex: VARs often provide additional services to their customers.
words.ex_cn: 加值型经销商通常为客户提供额外服务。
words.en: In computing, a variable is a storage location paired with an associated symbolic name, which contains some known or unknown quantity of information referred to as a value.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.ex: He wore rags to stay warm.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着破衣服来保暖。
words.en: Pieces of old cloth, especially ones that are torn or worn.

words.ex: He believed his fate was to become a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己的命运是成为一名教师。
words.en: Fate is a power that is believed to control what happens in the future.

words.tr: n. 欧文（男子名，源于威尔士语，意为‘年轻的战士’或‘小勇士’）
words.ex: Owen is a popular name in English-speaking countries.
words.ex_cn: 欧文是英语国家中一个常见的名字。
words.en: A male given name of Welsh origin, meaning 'noble' or 'high-born'.

words.tr: n. 公牛；（阉割的）公牛；“ox”的复数；
words.ex: The farmers drove the oxen to plow the field.
words.ex_cn: 农民们赶着公牛去犁地。
words.en: Oxen are large, strong animals used in some countries for pulling heavy loads or for farming.

words.ex: He eats oats for breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃燕麦。
words.en: Oats are a type of cereal grain grown for its seed, which is known by the same name. They are used for food for people and as fodder for animals, especially horses and cattle.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.tr:
v. 交谈；说话；
n. 谈话；
words.ex: They talk every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后都会交谈。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; conversation or discussion.

words.ex: He feels weak after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场大病之后，他感到虚弱。
words.en: If someone is weak, they are not physically strong or healthy.

words.tr: n. 手臂；武器；兵器；“arm”的复数；
words.ex: He raised his arms to wave at the plane.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手臂向飞机挥手。
words.en: Weapons, especially as used by the military.

words.tr:
adj. 广泛的；宽的；宽阔的；
adv. 广大地；
words.ex: The book has wide use in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: Something that is wide measures a large distance from one side to the other.

words.ex: The fishermen live in small huts by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔民们住在海边的小屋里。
words.en: A hut is a small, simple building, often made of wood, mud, or other natural materials, typically used as a temporary shelter.

words.tr:
adj. 托利党的；保守党的
n. 英国保守党党员（或支持者）
words.ex: He was a staunch Tory supporter.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个坚定的保守党支持者。
words.en: A Tory is a member or supporter of the Conservative Party in Britain or Canada.

words.tr: n. （罪犯有组织的）一帮( gang的名词复数 ); 一伙; （闹事青少年的）一群; （工人有组织
words.ex: The city has been plagued by gangs of looters.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市一直受到一群群抢劫者的困扰。
words.en: A gang is a group of people, especially young people, who go around together and often cause trouble or fight against other groups.

words.ex: He lives in Spain.
words.ex_cn: 他住在西班牙。
words.en: Spain is a country located in southwestern Europe on the Iberian Peninsula.

words.tr: v. 写作；“write”的过去式；书写；写信；
words.ex: He wrote a letter to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友写了一封信。
words.en: The past tense of write, which means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.ex: He took opium for pain relief.
words.ex_cn: 他服用鸦片来缓解疼痛。
words.en: Opium is a powerful drug made from the juice of the opium poppy, which is used to relieve pain or to help people sleep.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的房间在三楼。
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.ex: I bought a dozen eggs from the store.
words.ex_cn: 我从商店买了十二个鸡蛋。
words.en: If you have a dozen things, you have twelve of them.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，树叶是绿色的。
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.ex: He solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: If you solve a problem or a question, you find a solution or an answer to it.

words.ex: He bought new shoes for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为上学买了新鞋子。
words.en: Shoes are objects which you wear on your feet. They cover most of your foot and you wear them over socks or stockings.

words.tr: v. 雇用；租用；“hire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The company hired a new teacher last week.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上周雇用了一名新老师。
words.en: To employ someone for wages or other payment.

words.ex: This book is about the realm of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于人工智能领域的。
words.en: A realm is a country ruled by a king or queen, or an area of activity, interest, or knowledge.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: The ships sail across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 这些船在海洋上航行。
words.en: A ship is a large boat for travelling on water, especially across the sea. Ships are used for carrying people or goods.

words.ex: Prior to the meeting, we reviewed the report.
words.ex_cn: 在会议之前，我们复习了报告。
words.en: Existing or coming before in time, order, or importance.

words.tr:
n. 打印；印刷；
v. 打印；印刷；
words.ex: The print of the photo is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片的打印很清晰。
words.en: To produce text or pictures on paper, usually using a machine called a printer.

words.ex: The children cries when they lose the game.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们输掉比赛时会喊叫。
words.en: To shed tears, especially as an expression of distress or pain; to shout or scream, typically to express fear, pain, or grief.

words.ex: He made a choice to study hard.
words.ex_cn: 他选择努力学习。
words.en: If you have a choice, you can choose between two or more things.

words.ex: The bearer of the ticket can enter the concert.
words.ex_cn: 票的持有人可以进入音乐会。
words.en: A bearer is someone who carries or holds something, especially a document or message, or someone who is entitled to receive something, such as a check or a ticket.

words.ex: He made many errors in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了很多错误。
words.en: Mistakes or inaccuracies, especially those that are the result of a failure to follow a set of rules or standards.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.tr: adj. 荒废的； v. “ruin”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The old house is ruined after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子在风暴后变得荒废了。
words.en: If something is ruined, it is severely damaged or destroyed, often beyond repair.

words.tr:
adj. 犁过而未耕种的；休耕的；休闲中的
n. 休耕的田地；闲置；休整
v. 使（翻耕后的土地）休闲
words.ex: The farmer lets the field lie fallow this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年农夫让这块地休耕。
words.en: If land is fallow, it is not planted with crops, in order to improve the quality of the soil.

words.ex: He has good habits every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都有好习惯。
words.en: A habit is something that you do often or regularly.

words.ex: He shifts his job to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他把工作转换到一个新的城市。
words.en: Shifts refer to the periods of work that people are assigned to, especially in a job that operates 24 hours a day. It can also mean a change in position, direction, or tendency.

words.ex: They settled in a small village after retirement.
words.ex_cn: 他们退休后在一个小村庄安顿下来。
words.en: To settle means to resolve or come to an agreement about a dispute, to establish a permanent home in a particular place, or to come to rest in a particular position.

words.ex: The storm caused a brutal flood that destroyed many homes.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了残酷的洪水，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A brutal act or person is cruel and violent.

words.ex: He assists his brother with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助弟弟做作业。
words.en: If you assist someone, you help them to do a job or task by doing part of the work for them.

words.tr: v. 拒绝；否认；“deny”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He denied my request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了我的求助请求。
words.en: If you deny something, you say that it is not true.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: Martin is my neighbor who loves gardening.
words.ex_cn: 马丁是我的邻居，他喜欢园艺。
words.en: A common male given name.

words.tr: n. 中风；划水动作；一击；
words.ex: He had a stroke last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年中风了。
words.en: A stroke is a medical condition in which poor blood flow to the brain results in cell death. It can also refer to an act of hitting or striking someone or something, or a gentle movement of the hand over a surface.

words.tr: n. 持有者；拥有者；支架
words.ex: The holder of the ticket won a prize.
words.ex_cn: 票的持有者中了奖。
words.en: A holder is a person or thing that holds something.

words.ex: The covers of the books are colorful.
words.ex_cn: 这些书的封面是五颜六色的。
words.en: To cover something means to place something else over it, often to protect or hide it, or to include or deal with a particular subject or area.

words.ex: He graduated from Oxford.
words.ex_cn: 他从牛津大学毕业。
words.en: Oxford is a city in central southern England, famous for its university, which is the oldest in the English-speaking world. The term can also refer to a type of laced shoe.

words.ex: The sentence has a clause that explains why he left.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子有一个解释他为什么离开的从句。
words.en: A clause is a particular section of a legal document such as a contract, will, or treaty, that contains a condition or stipulation.

words.tr:
n. 同事；（组织的）会员；家伙；同胞；
adj. 同类的；同事的；
words.ex: He works as a fellow with Dr. Smith in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室里与史密斯博士一起工作，是他的同事。
words.en: A fellow is a man or boy. In British English, a fellow is also a member of certain academic societies.

words.tr: v. 推，推动； adj. 没有空的，忙碌的 v. 推，推动( push的过去式和过；
words.ex: He pushed the cart to the store.
words.ex_cn: 他把购物车推到了商店。
words.en: To exert force against (someone or something) in order to move them away from oneself or the origin of the force.

words.tr: n. 停顿；停顿( pause的名词复数 )； v. 停顿；
words.ex: The speaker took long pauses between sentences.
words.ex_cn: 演讲者在句子之间做了长时间的停顿。
words.en: Brief interruptions in speech or writing.

words.ex: I forget where I put my keys.
words.ex_cn: 我忘记把钥匙放在哪儿了。
words.en: If you forget something, you fail to remember it.

words.ex: Please ensure the door is locked.
words.ex_cn: 请确保门锁好了。
words.en: To make certain that something will occur or be the case.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.ex: He rarely eats fast food.
words.ex_cn: 他很少吃快餐。
words.en: Not often; seldom.

words.ex: He felt wasted after spending all his money on useless things.
words.ex_cn: 他花光了所有钱买无用的东西后，感觉很浪费。
words.en: If something is wasted, it is not used effectively or is used in a way that does not produce a useful result.

words.ex: He was robbed of his wallet on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他在街上被抢走了钱包。
words.en: To take property unlawfully from (a person or place) by force or threat of force.

words.ex: The knight rode a horse and wore shiny armor.
words.ex_cn: 骑士骑着马，穿着闪亮的盔甲。
words.en: In the Middle Ages, a knight was a man of high social rank who had a duty to fight for his king. Knights are often depicted as noble warriors on horseback.

words.tr: n. 威尼斯（意大利东北部城市）
words.ex: We visited Venice last summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们去年夏天去了威尼斯。
words.en: Venice is a city in northeastern Italy and the capital of the Veneto region. It is situated across a group of 118 small islands that are separated by canals and linked by over 400 bridges.

words.tr: v. 赚得；获得；“earn”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He earned money by delivering newspapers.
words.ex_cn: 他送报纸赚了钱。
words.en: Gained or deserved through effort or work.

words.tr:
n. 离别；分别；分界线；分界处
adj. 离别时的；逝去的
v. 分离；分开；“part”的现在分词
words.ex: He said goodbye with a sad parting smile.
words.ex_cn: 他带着悲伤的告别微笑说了再见。
words.en: The act of leaving or separating from someone or something.

words.tr: v. 参观；游览；访问；探望；访问( visit的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: They visited the museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末参观了博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place for a short period of time, especially as a tourist or as part of an official duty.

words.tr: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；
words.ex: This is a typical example of a sunny day.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个晴天的典型例子。
words.en: You use typical to describe someone or something that shows the most usual characteristics of a particular type of person or thing, and is therefore a good example of that type.

words.tr: n. 债务人（debtor的复数形式）
words.ex: The bank sent letters to the debtors.
words.ex_cn: 银行给债务人寄了信。
words.en: Debtors are individuals or entities that owe money to another party.

words.ex: The soft chair gives me comfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把软椅子给我带来舒服。
words.en: If you comfort someone, you make them feel less worried, unhappy, or upset, for example by saying kind things to them.

words.tr: n. 写作；文章； v. 写作；“write”的现在分词；
words.ex: His writing is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 他的写作清晰简洁。
words.en: The activity or skill of marking coherent words on paper and composing text.

words.ex: She readily agreed to help me.
words.ex_cn: 她很容易就同意帮我了。
words.en: If you do something readily, you do it in a way which shows that you are very willing to do it.

words.tr: n. 持票人；搬运工；送信人
words.ex: The bearers carried the box carefully.
words.ex_cn: 搬运工小心地搬着箱子。
words.en: A bearer is someone who carries or holds something, such as a ticket, a message, or a physical object.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: Be careful when you cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。
words.en: If you are careful, you give serious attention to what you are doing, in order to avoid harm, damage, or mistakes.

words.ex: He likes all fruits, notably apples.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢所有水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use notably to specify an important or typical example of something that you are talking about.

words.ex: The revival of traditional music brought joy to many people.
words.ex_cn: 传统音乐的复兴给许多人带来了快乐。
words.en: The process of something becoming popular or active again after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.ex: He finished in seventh place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第七名。
words.en: The seventh item in a series is the one that you count as number seven.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.ex: The boat is sinking fast in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 船正在海里迅速下沉。
words.en: To go down below the surface of water, mud, etc.; to become submerged.

words.ex: Richard is a kind teacher.
words.ex_cn: 理查德是一位善良的老师。
words.en: A male given name.

words.ex: The police are investigating the motives behind the crime.
words.ex_cn: 警方正在调查犯罪背后的动机。
words.en: A motive is a reason for doing something, especially one that is hidden or not obvious.

words.ex: She was fully clothed when she answered the door.
words.ex_cn: 她开门时穿着整齐。
words.en: Wearing clothes; not naked.

words.tr: n. 梳理（羊毛、棉等纤维）
words.ex: He is carding wool to make a sweater.
words.ex_cn: 他正在梳理羊毛来织毛衣。
words.en: Carding is the process of preparing fibers, such as wool or cotton, for spinning by separating and straightening them.

words.ex: He asked for her consent before starting the project.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始这个项目之前征求了她的同意。
words.en: Consent is permission for something to happen or agreement to do something.

words.ex: The victims were helped by volunteers.
words.ex_cn: 受害者得到了志愿者的帮助。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been hurt or killed by someone or something, or someone who has suffered because of a bad situation.

words.ex: The lawyers are helping the client in court.
words.ex_cn: 律师们正在法庭上帮助客户。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who practices or studies law, especially (in the UK) a solicitor or a barrister or (in the US) an attorney.

words.ex: She tried to prevail on him to change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 她试图劝服他改变主意。
words.en: If a proposal, principle, or opinion prevails, it gains influence or is accepted, often after a struggle or argument.

words.ex: The horrors of war upset many people.
words.ex_cn: 战争的恐怖让许多人感到不安。
words.en: Horrors refer to things that cause a feeling of fear, shock, or disgust.

words.ex: He is a wealthy man who owns many houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是个富有的人，拥有许多房子。
words.en: A wealthy person, organization, or country has a lot of money, resources, or assets.

words.tr: v. 降低；“lower”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He lowered the volume of the radio.
words.ex_cn: 他降低了收音机的音量。
words.en: To move something down to a less high position, or to reduce something in amount, degree, or quality.

words.ex: The child showed signs of talent in infancy.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在婴儿期就表现出天赋。
words.en: The earliest period of childhood, especially before the ability to walk has been acquired.

words.ex: The Christian church teaches the doctrine of the Trinity.
words.ex_cn: 基督教教会教导三位一体的教义。
words.en: In Christianity, the Trinity is the union of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit in one Godhead.

words.tr: v. 忽略；不理会；“ignore”的过去分词；
words.ex: He ignored the message and kept walking.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了那条消息，继续走。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.ex: The king rode in a wooden carriage drawn by four horses.
words.ex_cn: 国王乘坐一辆由四匹马拉的木制四轮马车。
words.en: A carriage is a vehicle with four wheels that is pulled by horses and is used for carrying people.

words.tr: v. 隐藏；遮蔽；（使）相形见绌（obscure 的过去式及过去分词）；
words.ex: The fog obscured the road ahead.
words.ex_cn: 雾隐藏了前方的路。
words.en: If something is obscured, it cannot be seen properly, because something else is in the way or because it is dark or unclear.

words.ex: He likes sciences like biology and chemistry.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物和化学等科学。
words.en: The systematic study of the structure and behavior of the physical and natural world through observation and experiment.

words.ex: Fourthly, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 第四，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: adverb. You use fourthly when you want to make a fourth point or give a fourth reason for something.

words.ex: He occupies a small room in the dorm.
words.ex_cn: 他住在宿舍里的一间小房间里。
words.en: If something occupies a particular area or place, it fills or covers it or exists there.

words.tr: adj. 对立的； v. 反对；“oppose”的现在分词；
words.ex: The two teams have opposing views on the rule change.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍对规则修改持有对立的观点。
words.en: If you are opposing someone or something, you are competing against them or trying to prevent them from doing something.

words.tr: adj. 感到宽慰的； v. 缓解；“relieve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt relieved when he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 当他通过考试时，他感到宽慰。
words.en: If you are relieved, you feel happy because something unpleasant has not happened or is no longer happening.

words.ex: The pain lessened after taking the medicine.
words.ex_cn: 服药后疼痛减轻了。
words.en: To become or make something become smaller, weaker, or less important.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.tr: adj. 单个的；单数的；特异的；
words.ex: Each singular student must submit a form.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都必须提交一份表格。
words.en: In grammar, singular means relating to or being a form of a word that refers to one person or thing.

words.tr:
adj. 最重要的；
adv. 首要地；
words.ex: He is the foremost expert in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的专家。
words.en: Most important or prominent; leading.

words.ex: He spent his lifetime teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他一生都在教孩子们。
words.en: The period of time during which an individual is alive.

words.ex: The meeting was fruitful and solved many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议富有成效，解决了许多问题。
words.en: Producing good or helpful results; productive.

words.tr: n. 范围；界限；疆界（confine的复数）; vt. 限制；禁闭（confine的三单形式）
words.ex: He stayed within the confines of the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他待在花园的范围内。
words.en: The limits or borders of something.

words.ex: The two groups are discrete and do not overlap.
words.ex_cn: 这两个群体是分离的，没有重叠。
words.en: Something that is discrete is separate and distinct in form or concept.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.ex: He concluded that the experiment failed.
words.ex_cn: 他得出结论说实验失败了。
words.en: If you conclude that something is true, you decide that it is true using the facts you know as a basis.

words.tr: n. 人性；人类；人道；仁慈；
words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

words.ex: He actively participates in class discussions.
words.ex_cn: 他积极参加课堂讨论。
words.en: In a way that involves positive action or participation.

words.ex: The bright colors attracts butterflies.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引蝴蝶。
words.en: If something or someone attracts you, they have particular qualities which cause you to like or admire them.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；合意的；宜人的；
words.ex: The weather was pleasant today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很令人愉快。
words.en: Something that is pleasant is enjoyable, attractive, or friendly.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr:
v. 报道；据说；传闻；述说；报告；
adj. 报告的；声称的；已汇报的；已举报的；
words.ex: The news reported a big storm yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 新闻报道了昨天一场大风暴。
words.en: If you report something, you tell people about it, often because it is important or necessary to do so.

words.ex: I remember my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我记得我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you remember people or events from the past, you still have an idea of them in your mind and you are able to think about them.

words.ex: He works as an exporter of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名咖啡出口商。
words.en: An exporter is a person, company, or country that sells goods to another country.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: He conceals his true feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他隐藏自己的真实感受。
words.en: To conceal something means to hide it or keep it secret.

words.ex: She is plaiting her hair slowly.
words.ex_cn: 她正在慢慢编辫子。
words.en: The act of weaving or braiding hair, straw, or other materials into a pattern.

words.ex: He is literally the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他确实是队里最好的球员。
words.en: In a literal manner or sense; exactly.

words.tr: n. 绅士；先生；有教养的人
words.ex: The gentleman smiled and held the door open.
words.ex_cn: 那位绅士微笑着为别人扶着门。
words.en: A gentleman is a man who is polite and well-educated, who has excellent manners and always behaves well.

words.ex: The price of oil fluctuates every day.
words.ex_cn: 油价每天都在波动。
words.en: To fluctuate means to change or vary frequently and unpredictably.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.ex: He testifies in court about what he saw.
words.ex_cn: 他在法庭上作证他所看到的事情。
words.en: To give evidence as a witness in a law court.

words.ex: The test has only numerical answers.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试只有数字答案。
words.en: Numerical means relating to numbers or consisting of numbers.

words.tr: adj. 突出的；杰出的；显著的；
words.ex: He is a prominent scientist in the field of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他是医学领域的一位突出的科学家。
words.en: Someone or something that is prominent is important and well-known, or is positioned in a way that makes them easily seen or noticed.

words.tr: adj. 可被整除的；可分的
words.ex: The number 12 is divisible by 3.
words.ex_cn: 12 能被 3 整除。
words.en: Capable of being divided, especially with no remainder.

words.ex: He denounced the lie in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在大家面前谴责了这个谎言。
words.en: To publicly declare to be wrong or evil; to criticize harshly and publicly.

words.ex: He solves simple equations every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解简单的方程。
words.en: An equation is a mathematical statement that asserts the equality of two expressions.

words.tr: adj. 印象深刻的； v. 使印象深刻；“impress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was impressed by her kindness.
words.ex_cn: 她的善良给我留下了深刻的印象。
words.en: If you are impressed by something or someone, you feel great admiration for them.

words.tr: n. 估计；估计的成本；估计( estimate的名词复数 )； v. 估计；
words.ex: The estimates for the cost are too high.
words.ex_cn: 这个成本的估计太高了。
words.en: Approximate calculations or judgments about the value, number, quantity, or extent of something.

words.tr: adj. 有人居住的；人口密集的； v. 居住于；“populate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The island is populated by only a few families.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛上只有几户人家居住。
words.en: An area that is populated has people living there.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的现在分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school is providing free lunches to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: Used to say that something will happen only if a particular condition is met.

words.tr:
adj. 作为结果的；合成的
n. 结果；产物
words.ex: The resultant force moved the box forward.
words.ex_cn: 合力把箱子向前推了。
words.en: A resultant thing or situation is the one that follows or is caused by a particular event or action.

words.ex: Some apologists defend the old policy.
words.ex_cn: 一些辩解者为旧政策辩护。
words.en: A person who offers an argument in defense of something controversial.

words.tr: n. 枯竭；耗尽；筋疲力尽；
words.ex: The long hike led to his exhaustion.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的徒步旅行导致他筋疲力尽。
words.en: A state of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.ex: He sleeps abnormally late on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他在周末反常地睡得很晚。
words.en: In a manner that deviates from what is normal or expected.

words.ex: His deficiency in math made him struggle in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的缺乏让他在课堂上很吃力。
words.en: A deficiency is a lack or shortage of something that is needed.

words.tr: v. 使社会化；使适应社会生活
words.ex: The children were socialised in a small community.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子在一个小社区中接受了社会化教育。
words.en: To socialise means to train or adapt someone to live in society, or to make something suitable for society.

words.tr: n. 悬浮；暂时停职（停学、停赛）；
words.ex: The suspension of dust in the air made the sky look gray.
words.ex_cn: 空气中的尘埃悬浮使天空看起来灰蒙蒙的。
words.en: The act of temporarily stopping something from happening or being in effect, or the state of being stopped in this way.

words.tr: adj. 受控制的； v. 控制；“control”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The experiment was conducted in a controlled environment.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验是在受控制的环境中进行的。
words.en: If something is controlled, it is done or organized according to a particular method or system.

words.tr: v. 促进；使便利；使容易；
words.ex: The teacher facilitates learning by asking questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过提问来促进学习。
words.en: To make an action or process easier or more likely to happen.

words.tr: adj. 使人精疲力竭的； v. “exhaust”的现在分词；
words.ex: The long hike was exhausting.
words.ex_cn: 这次长途徒步让人精疲力竭。
words.en: If you describe an activity or situation as exhausting, you mean that it makes you feel extremely tired.

words.tr: v. 继续；连续；“continue”的现在分词； adj. 连续的；持续的；继续的；
words.ex: He is continuing his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后继续做作业。
words.en: adjective. Continuing is used to describe something that keeps happening or existing without stopping.

words.ex: The rules show uniformity in all schools.
words.ex_cn: 这些规则在所有学校中都保持一致。
words.en: The state or quality of being uniform; consistency.

words.ex: The dog left excretions on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 狗在草地上留下了排泄物。
words.en: The process by which waste products are eliminated from an organism, or the substances that are eliminated.

words.ex: New technology helps farmers grow more food.
words.ex_cn: 新技术帮助农民种植更多的粮食。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.ex: Henceforth, I will wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 从今以后，我会早起。
words.en: From this time on; from now on.

words.ex: He took a circuitous route to avoid the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他绕了远路以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A circuitous route, journey, or piece of writing is longer than it needs to be because it is not direct.

words.ex: Many small businesses open near schools.
words.ex_cn: 许多小生意在学校附近开张。
words.en: Businesses are organizations that produce or sell goods or services in order to make a profit.

words.ex: The rubber band shows great elasticity when stretched.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋被拉伸时表现出很大的弹性。
words.en: The ability of an object or material to resume its normal shape after being stretched or compressed.

words.tr: v. 下降；“descend”的现在分词； adj. 下降的；
words.ex: The birds are descending slowly to the ground.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿正在缓缓下降到地面。
words.en: Moving or sloping downward.

words.tr: n. 耕者；栽培者；耕田机
words.ex: The farmer uses a cultivator to prepare the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用耕作机来准备土壤。
words.en: A cultivator is a person or machine that prepares land for growing crops.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.tr:
prep. 关于；鉴于
v. 尊重；尊敬；遵从；“respect”的现在分词
words.ex: We should be respecting others' opinions.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该尊重他人的意见。
words.en: prep. concerning; about

words.tr: v. 从事；承担；“undertake”的过去分词；
words.ex: He undertook a new job last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月从事了一份新工作。
words.en: If you undertake a task or a responsibility, you start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.tr: n. 途径；方法；“approach”的复数； v. 接近；靠近；
words.ex: Different approaches can solve the same problem.
words.ex_cn: 不同的途径可以解决同一个问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in space, time, quality, or amount.

words.tr: v. 进行；继续；继续进行；“proceed”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting is proceeding as planned.
words.ex_cn: 会议按计划进行。
words.en: A proceeding is an event or a series of actions, especially one that is formal or official.

words.ex: The locomotives pull long trains across the country.
words.ex_cn: 机车牵引着长长的火车穿越全国。
words.en: A locomotive is a powered railway vehicle used for pulling trains.

words.tr: v. 分发，分配；散布，分布
words.ex: He distributes flyers around the neighborhood.
words.ex_cn: 他在 neighborhoods 分发传单。
words.en: To distribute means to give out or deliver something to a number of people or places, or to spread something over an area.

words.ex: He is squandering his money on games.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把钱浪费在游戏上。
words.en: To spend or use something wastefully or extravagantly.

words.ex: The elimination of waste is important for health.
words.ex_cn: 排除废物对健康很重要。
words.en: The act of removing or getting rid of something completely.

words.ex: The teacher gave clear instruction on how to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了如何解决这个问题的明确教授。
words.en: Detailed information telling how something should be done, operated, or assembled.

words.tr: adj. 可察觉到的；看得出的；可感知的
words.ex: The change was barely perceptible.
words.ex_cn: 这个变化几乎无法察觉。
words.en: Something that is perceptible can be seen, noticed, or felt.

words.ex: There are innumerable stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有数不清的星星。
words.en: Too many to be counted; very many.

words.ex: The goddess appeared in her incarnation as a bird.
words.ex_cn: 女神以鸟的化身出现。
words.en: The embodiment of a deity or spirit in some earthly form; a person who embodies in the flesh a deity, spirit, or quality.

words.tr: n. 替代物；代替者；替补（运动员）；[语法学]代用词；代替者( substitute的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The recipe uses honey as a substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱用蜂蜜作为糖的替代物。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another. In sports, a substitute is a player who replaces another player during a game.

words.ex: Technically, the phone works, but it's slow.
words.ex_cn: 技术上讲，这部手机能用，但很慢。
words.en: In a way that relates to the knowledge, machines, or methods used in science and industry.

words.tr: n. 进口；输入品；进口货
words.ex: The country banned the importation of old cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家禁止了旧汽车的进口。
words.en: The act of bringing goods or services into a country from abroad for sale.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: Scientists made new discoveries about the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们对海洋有了新的发现。
words.en: Discoveries are things that are found or learned about for the first time.

words.ex: The shopkeepers open their stores early every morning.
words.ex_cn: 店主们每天早上很早就开门营业。
words.en: A shopkeeper is a person who owns or manages a shop.

words.tr: adj. 可利用的；可开发的；可剥削的
words.ex: The漏洞 is exploitable by hackers.
words.ex_cn: 这个漏洞可以被黑客利用。
words.en: Capable of being utilized or turned to practical account; susceptible of being made use of.

words.tr: v. 引入；介绍；“introduce”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is introducing a new math game to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向班级引入一个新的数学游戏。
words.en: To introduce means to present someone or something new to another person or group, to bring something into use or operation for the first time, or to present a new topic or idea.

words.ex: It is unnecessary to bring an umbrella today.
words.ex_cn: 今天带伞是不必要的。
words.en: If you describe something as unnecessary, you mean that it is not needed or does not have to be done, and often that it may be harmful or undesirable.

words.tr: v. 包含，合并；组成公司；掺和，混合（成分）（incorporates 的第三人称单数）
words.ex: This new model incorporates several new features.
words.ex_cn: 这款新模型包含了几项新功能。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: She is incomparably better at math than her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她在数学上比她弟弟强得多。
words.en: In a way that is beyond comparison; matchlessly.

words.ex: He is substituting numbers for letters in the equation.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用数字代替方程中的字母。
words.en: To replace someone or something with another person or thing.

words.ex: The teacher asked for simple descriptions of the animals.
words.ex_cn: 老师要求对这些动物做出简单的描述。
words.en: Descriptions are detailed accounts or explanations of something.

words.ex: He received fair remuneration for his work.
words.ex_cn: 他因工作获得了公平的报酬。
words.en: Remuneration refers to the money that is paid to someone for the work that they have done.

words.ex: He showed indifference to his friend's problems.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的问题表现出冷淡。
words.en: Indifference is the state of being indifferent, especially in the sense of not caring or being uninterested.

words.tr: v. 建立；确定；建立( establish的现在分词 )；
words.ex: They are establishing a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在村里建立一所新学校。
words.en: Creating, setting up, or proving the existence of something.

words.tr: n. 前辈；前身；前任；前任( predecessor的名词复数 )；
words.ex: Our predecessors built the first roads here.
words.ex_cn: 我们的前辈修建了这里的第一条道路。
words.en: A predecessor is someone who had a job or a position before someone else, or something that comes before another thing in time or in a series.

words.tr: v. 承认；“acknowledge”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认了自己的错误。
words.en: Recognized as being true or existing.

words.ex: The two stories are intertwining in the novel.
words.ex_cn: 这两个故事在小说中交织在一起。
words.en: To twist or weave together; to become mutually involved or interconnected.

words.tr: v. 证明；示范，演示；表露；
words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100°C时沸腾。
words.en: If you demonstrate a particular skill, quality, or feeling, you show by your actions that you have it.

words.ex: The road closure caused an inconvenience to commuters.
words.ex_cn: 道路封闭给通勤者带来了不便。
words.en: Inconvenience refers to the state or quality of being inconvenient; trouble or difficulty caused to one's personal requirements or comfort.

words.ex: His comprehension of the story was very good.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个故事的理解很好。
words.en: Comprehension is the ability to understand something.

words.ex: The new policy substantially improved the results.
words.ex_cn: 新政策实质上改善了结果。
words.en: To a great extent or degree; considerably.

words.tr: n. 修改；变更；改进；“modification”的复数；
words.ex: The teacher made some modifications to the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师对试卷做了一些修改。
words.en: Changes made to something in order to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 可区别的；可辨别的
words.ex: The two colors are distinguishable under bright light.
words.ex_cn: 在强光下，这两种颜色是可以区分的。
words.en: If something is distinguishable, it can be recognized or identified as different from something else.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.ex: The cwts are small stones in the field.
words.ex_cn: 这些cwts是田里的小石头。
words.en: An abbreviation for 'coursework'.

words.ex: The star shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这颗星星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A star is a large ball of burning gas in space that you can see as a point of light in the sky at night.

words.tr:
v. 适合；相配；
n. 套装；西装；诉讼；
words.ex: This color suits her well.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色很适合她。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually consisting of a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be appropriate or acceptable for someone or something.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put something into a container or space so that it is completely or almost completely full.

words.tr:
v. 隐藏；躲藏；
n. 兽皮；
words.ex: He hides the key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: To conceal something or someone from view or discovery.

words.ex: The wolf howled at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: A wolf is a wild animal that is related to the dog and lives and hunts in groups.

words.ex: She added a little salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她在汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: Salt is a white crystalline substance that is used for seasoning or preserving food. It is also used in various industrial processes.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.tr: v. 削减；切；（从某物上）切下；
words.ex: The company cuts costs to save money.
words.ex_cn: 公司削减成本以节省资金。
words.en: Cuts can refer to the act of making an incision or reducing something in size, amount, or extent. It can also denote a wound or incision made by a sharp object.

words.tr: v. 移动；搬家；搬动；行动；进展； adj. 受感动的；受感动的 v. 移动，搬动( move的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He moved the chair to the window.
words.ex_cn: 他把椅子移到了窗边。
words.en: If you are moved by something, it makes you feel strongly emotional, often causing you to want to help or show sympathy. As a verb, it refers to the action of changing position or causing something to change position.

words.ex: He has forty books on his shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他的书架上有四十本书。
words.en: The number 40.

words.ex: The children play under the trees.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在树下玩耍。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant that has a wooden trunk and branches that grow from its upper part.

words.ex: The miser saved all his money and never spent it.
words.ex_cn: 这个吝啬鬼把所有的钱都存起来，从不花掉。
words.en: A miser is a person who is extremely unwilling to spend money, often to the point of living in poverty despite having wealth.

words.ex: The floor is dirty after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，地板变得肮脏了。
words.en: If something is dirty, it is marked or covered with stains, spots, or mud, and needs to be cleaned.

words.tr: adj. 更宽的；更宽阔的；“wide”的比较级；
words.ex: This road is wider than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 这条路比上一条更宽。
words.en: Comparative form of wide; having a greater extent from side to side.

words.ex: The ocean is very big and deep.
words.ex_cn: 海洋非常大且深。
words.en: The vast body of salt water that covers almost three quarters of the earth's surface.

words.tr:
adv. 相同地；相像地；
adj. 相同的；相像的；
words.ex: They dress alike.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿得一样。
words.en: If two or more things are alike, they are similar in some way.

words.tr: adj. 敏锐的；急性的；严重的；
words.ex: He has an acute mind and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他思维敏锐，能快速解决问题。
words.en: An acute problem or negative feeling is very severe.

words.ex: The machine stops when the power is off.
words.ex_cn: 当电源关闭时，机器停止工作。
words.en: Stops: (verb) Ceases movement or activity.

words.ex: The wound began to swell after the insect bite.
words.ex_cn: 被昆虫叮咬后，伤口开始肿胀。
words.en: To increase in size or volume as a result of internal pressure; to expand.

words.ex: He has fifty dollars in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有五十美元。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and ten; ten more than forty; 50.

words.ex: We took a different route to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们换了条路线以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A route is a way from one place to another, or the path that something follows to reach a destination.

words.ex: Each unit in the course lasts two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 课程中的每个单元持续两周。
words.en: Units refer to individual parts or elements that are part of a larger whole, often used in the context of measurement, education, or components of a system.

words.tr: n. 根；根源；根本；“root”的复数；
words.ex: The roots of the equation are 2 and 3.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程的根是2和3。
words.en: The underground parts of a plant that anchor it and absorb water and nutrients.

words.ex: He feels deeply the pain of others.
words.ex_cn: 他深感他人的痛苦。
words.en: Third-person singular present of 'feel'; experiences an emotion or sensation.

words.ex: The magnets have two poles.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁有两个极。
words.en: The term 'poles' refers to either of the two points at the ends of the axis of rotation of the Earth or another celestial body, or to a long, slender, rounded piece of wood or metal.

words.tr:
n. 枢；中心；旋转
v. 在枢轴上转动；以…为中心
words.ex: The door pivots on a hinge.
words.ex_cn: 门围绕一个铰链旋转。
words.en: A pivot is the central point, pin, or shaft on which a mechanism turns or oscillates. It can also refer to the central or most important person or thing in a situation.

words.ex: The penal system aims to punish criminals.
words.ex_cn: 刑罚制度旨在惩罚罪犯。
words.en: Relating to, used for, or prescribing the punishment of offenders under the legal system.

words.tr: adj. 虔诚的；信神的；伪善的
words.ex: He is a pious man who prays every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个每天祈祷的虔诚的人。
words.en: Someone who is pious is very religious and moral.

words.ex: The trader sells fruits every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人每天早上卖水果。
words.en: A trader is a person who buys and sells goods, currencies, or shares.

words.tr: n. 精神；才智；机敏；朝气; n. （Esprit）（美、法、英、比、加、荷）埃斯普里（人名）
words.ex: The esprit de corps of the team was evident in their synchronized movements.
words.ex_cn: 团队的集体精神在他们整齐划一的动作中显而易见。
words.en: Liveliness of mind or spirit; a sense of belonging and loyalty to a group.

words.tr:
n. 谜语；费解的事
v. 解谜；出谜；使布满窟窿；打洞
words.ex: He told me a riddle and I solved it.
words.ex_cn: 他给我出了一道谜语，我解出来了。
words.en: A riddle is a question or statement that is deliberately very confusing and has a clever or amusing answer.

words.ex: He runs with great vigour every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都充满精力地跑步。
words.en: Physical or mental strength and energy.

words.ex: He lived in Paris for a decade.
words.ex_cn: 他在巴黎生活了十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.ex: The kitchen has three timers for baking cookies.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里有三个计时器用来烤饼干。
words.en: A timer is a device that measures or signals the end of a set period of time.

words.ex: The repeal of the old law took effect last month.
words.ex_cn: 这项旧法律的废止上个月生效了。
words.en: If the government repeals a law, it officially ends it, so that it is no longer valid.

words.ex: He reverted to his old habits after the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 假期后，他恢复了旧习惯。
words.en: To return to a former state, practice, topic, etc.

words.tr: n. 感觉官能；“sense”的复数； v. 感觉到；
words.ex: The baby explores the world with his senses.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿用他的感觉官能探索世界。
words.en: The faculties of sight, smell, hearing, taste, and touch; a feeling that something is the case.

words.ex: I reckon it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我认为明天会下雨。
words.en: If you reckon that something is true, you think that it is true.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.tr:
n. 锤子；
v. 锤打；
words.ex: He hit the nail with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子敲钉子。
words.en: A hammer is a tool that consists of a heavy piece of metal at the end of a handle, used for hitting things.

words.ex: Plants release oxygen into the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物向空气中释放氧气。
words.en: A colourless, odourless reactive gas, the chemical element of atomic number 8 and the life-supporting component of the air.

words.ex: The lawyer helped her client with the contract.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助她的客户处理合同。
words.en: A client is a person or organization receiving services or advice from a professional or company.

words.tr: n. 长处；[宗教]（行善得到的）功德( merit的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The merits of this plan are clear to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划的长处人人都看得出来。
words.en: The quality of being particularly good or worthy, especially so as to deserve praise or reward.

words.ex: The zoo keeper feeds the lions every morning.
words.ex_cn: 动物园饲养员每天早上喂狮子。
words.en: A keeper is someone whose job is to look after a particular place or thing.
