words.ex: He worked hard to attain his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到他的目标。
words.en: If you attain something, you gain it or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.tr:
adj. 内陆的；
adv. 向内地；在内陆；
n. 内地；内陆；
words.ex: The small village is located inland, far from the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于内陆，远离大海。
words.en: Inland means situated in the interior of a country rather than on the coast.

words.ex: Running a business entails hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经营企业必然需要努力工作。
words.en: If one thing entails another, it involves it or causes it.

words.tr: n. 独立电影或音乐制作公司
words.ex: The band plays in small indies around the city.
words.ex_cn: 这支乐队在城市的小独立场所演出。
words.en: Indies refers to independent film or music production companies, often characterized by their creative freedom and lower budgets compared to major studios.

words.ex: He will modify the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会更改计划。
words.en: To change something slightly, especially in order to make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The doctor said the patient needs urgent care.
words.ex_cn: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期一有个会议。
words.en: Monday is the day of the week between Sunday and Tuesday.

words.ex: The cake has three layers.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层。
words.en: Layers refer to sheets, quantities, or thicknesses of material, typically one of several, covering a surface or body. It can also refer to a person or thing that lays something, especially in a particular way.

words.tr: n. 租约，租契( lease的名词复数 )
words.ex: He signs leases for his apartments every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年都会签署公寓的租赁合同。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.tr: v. 看；“see”的现在分词；领悟； conj. 鉴于；
words.ex: I am seeing the bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我正在看树上的鸟。
words.en: the ability to see; the act of perceiving with the eyes

words.ex: He will submit his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会提交他的作业。
words.en: To yield or surrender (oneself) to the will or authority of another.

words.ex: The forest is a virgin land, untouched by humans.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是未开发的土地，从未被人类触及过。
words.en: A virgin is someone who has never had sexual intercourse. It can also describe something that is in its original pure or natural condition and has not been touched or changed by people.

words.ex: My parent helps me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母帮我做作业。
words.en: A parent is a mother or father.

words.ex: Children can play freely in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们可以在公园里自由地玩耍。
words.en: If you can do something freely, you can do it without being controlled or restricted by anyone.

words.tr: v. 创造；制造硬币( coin的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He coined a new word for the invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为这项发明创造了一个新词。
words.en: To coin a word or phrase means to invent it.

words.ex: She plants flowers in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种花。
words.en: A garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass.

words.ex: The stars are bright on cold nights.
words.ex_cn: 在寒冷的夜晚，星星很明亮。
words.en: The period of darkness in each twenty-four hours; the time from sunset to sunrise.

words.ex: I looked everywhere, but my keys are nowhere.
words.ex_cn: 我到处找了，但我的钥匙无处可寻。
words.en: In no place or state; not anywhere.

words.ex: The removal of the old tree made the yard bigger.
words.ex_cn: 移除那棵老树让院子变大了。
words.en: The act of removing something or someone from a place or position.

words.ex: He resumed his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后继续做作业。
words.en: To begin again or continue after an interruption.

words.ex: He conform to the rules of the school.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守学校的规章制度。
words.en: To conform means to behave in a way that is accepted by most people or to obey a rule, law, or custom.

words.ex: This bag is durable and lasts for years.
words.ex_cn: 这个包很耐用，可以用很多年。
words.en: Something that is durable is strong and lasts a long time without breaking or becoming weaker.

words.tr: n. 农事；耕作；养殖； v. 务农；“farm”的现在分词；
words.ex: Farming is hard work in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 农事在乡村是很辛苦的工作。
words.en: Farming is the activity of growing crops or keeping animals on a farm.

words.tr: adv. 在其中；在那里；在那一点上
words.ex: The document outlines the terms and conditions therein.
words.ex_cn: 该文件概述了其中的条款和条件。
words.en: In that place, matter, or respect.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.ex: The bright flowers attract bees.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的花朵吸引蜜蜂。
words.en: If something or someone attracts you, they have particular qualities which cause you to like or admire them.

words.tr: n. 回复；回答 v. 回复；回答
words.ex: He read all the replies on the post.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读了帖子上的所有回复。
words.en: To say or write something as an answer to someone or something.

words.ex: The editing of the book took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的编辑花了三个月。
words.en: The process of revising and preparing a written, recorded, or filmed material for publication or presentation.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.tr:
n. 出纳员，收银员
v. 革除（军职）
words.ex: The cashier counted the money at the end of the day.
words.ex_cn: 收银员在一天结束时清点了钱。
words.en: A cashier is a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a shop, bank, or business.

words.ex: He is a deep thinker who solves problems slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个深思熟虑的思考者，慢慢解决问题。
words.en: A thinker is someone who spends a lot of time thinking deeply about important things, especially someone who is famous for thinking of new or interesting ideas.

words.ex: He lives in Belgium.
words.ex_cn: 他住在比利时。
words.en: A country in western Europe, bordered by the Netherlands, Germany, Luxembourg, France, and the North Sea.

words.ex: This is a genuine diamond.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石。
words.en: If something is genuine, it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.tr: adj. 表面上的； v. “seem”的现在分词；
words.ex: His seeming kindness hid his true intentions.
words.ex_cn: 他表面上的善良掩盖了真实的意图。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.tr: v. 使成三倍；增加两倍
words.ex: He trebled his savings last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年把积蓄增加了两倍。
words.en: To make or become three times as much or as many.

words.tr: v. 竖立；建立；“erect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They erected a statue in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园里竖立了一座雕像。
words.en: Built or placed upright, especially a structure like a building or monument.

words.ex: The weather is sunny today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气晴朗。
words.en: The condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, especially with regard to temperature, precipitation, and wind.

words.ex: He finally grasped the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他终于理解了这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To seize and hold firmly; to understand something completely.

words.ex: The soldier walks to the camp every morning.
words.ex_cn: 士兵每天早上步行去营地。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.tr:
adj. 立即的；即时的；
n. 瞬间；立即；
words.ex: He wants an instant answer.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个立即的回答。
words.en: An instant is a very short period of time, or a particular point in time.

words.tr: v. 收养；采用；采纳；“adopt”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They adopted a little boy from the orphanage.
words.ex_cn: 他们从孤儿院收养了一个小男孩。
words.en: If you adopt a new method, idea, or attitude, you start to use it or accept it. If you adopt a child, you take it into your own family and make it legally your son or daughter.

words.ex: She works out to augment her strength.
words.ex_cn: 她锻炼以增强力量。
words.en: If you augment something, you make it larger, stronger, or more effective by adding something to it.

words.ex: He squeezed into the small seat.
words.ex_cn: 他挤进了小座位里。
words.en: To squeeze something means to press it firmly, usually with your fingers or hands, often to get liquid out of it or to make it smaller.

words.ex: The builder constructed a new house last month.
words.ex_cn: 这位营造商上个月建造了一栋新房子。
words.en: A builder is a person whose job is to build or repair houses and other buildings.

words.ex: The soldiers received their daily rations at noon.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们中午领到了他们的日常口粮。
words.en: A fixed amount of a commodity officially allowed to each person during a time of shortage, as in wartime.

words.ex: He got a penalty for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而受到惩罚。
words.en: A penalty is a punishment that is imposed on someone for doing something that is against the rules or the law.

words.tr: v. 等待；等候；“wait”的现在分词； n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: He is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他正在等公交车。
words.en: the act of staying in one place or remaining inactive in expectation of something

words.tr: adv. 更远地；“far”的比较级； adj. 更远的；“far”的比较级；
words.ex: He ran farther than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比他弟弟更远。
words.en: At or to a greater distance or more advanced point.

words.ex: The transit of goods takes three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输需要三天。
words.en: The act or process of passing through or across; the conveyance of people or goods from one place to another.

words.ex: The law imposes strict rules on drivers.
words.ex_cn: 法律对司机施加了严格的规定。
words.en: To impose means to force something to be accepted or put into effect, often without the consent of others.

words.ex: The factory replaced its old boilers with more efficient models.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用更高效的模型替换了旧的锅炉。
words.en: A boiler is a device for heating water or generating steam, typically as part of a heating system or to power engines.

words.ex: The team celebrated their victory after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球队庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A victory is a success in a struggle, war, or competition.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.tr: n. 打猎；寻找； v. “hunt”的现在分词；
words.ex: Hunting is popular in some rural areas.
words.ex_cn: 打猎在一些农村地区很流行。
words.en: The activity of chasing and killing wild animals and birds for food or sport.

words.tr: v. 压下；降低；使沮丧；使不活泼；使萧条
words.ex: He depresses the button to start the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他按下按钮启动机器。
words.en: If something depresses you, it makes you feel sad and disappointed.

words.ex: She strongly believes in honesty.
words.ex_cn: 她强烈相信诚实。
words.en: In a strong manner; with strength or force.

words.ex: His judgment was clear and fair.
words.ex_cn: 他的判断清晰而公正。
words.en: A judgment is an opinion that you have or express after thinking carefully about something.

words.ex: The garden has manifold flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园里有繁多的花朵。
words.en: If something is manifold, it has many different parts, features, or forms.

words.tr: n. 航运；船运；运输； v. 装运；“ship”的现在分词；
words.ex: The shipping industry moves goods across oceans.
words.ex_cn: 航运业将货物运过海洋。
words.en: The act of sending goods from one place to another, especially by ship.

words.ex: She embraces every new challenge.
words.ex_cn: 她拥抱每一个新的挑战。
words.en: To hold someone closely in one's arms, especially as a sign of affection; to accept or support a belief, theory, or change willingly and enthusiastically.

words.ex: He loves reading literary books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读文学书籍。
words.en: Literary means concerned with or connected with the writing, study, or appreciation of literature.

words.ex: He procured a new book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 他从图书馆借到了一本新书。
words.en: To obtain something, especially with care or effort.

words.tr: n. 等级；类别层次；括弧( bracket的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He moved up in the company brackets after his promotion.
words.ex_cn: 他升职后，在公司等级中提升了。
words.en: Brackets are a pair of marks ( ) that are used around a word, phrase, or sentence in a piece of writing to show that what is inside them is separate from the main part of the text.

words.ex: He was born in the province of Guangdong.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在广东省。
words.en: A province is a large area of a country that has its own administration and often its own culture.

words.tr: v. 分配，拨给，摊派( allot的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: He was allotted five minutes to speak.
words.ex_cn: 他被分配了五分钟来发言。
words.en: Given or assigned as a share, portion, or lot.

words.ex: The class will commence at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程将在上午9点开始。
words.en: To begin something; to start.

words.tr: n. 代表大会；议会；国会；
words.ex: The congress met to discuss new laws.
words.ex_cn: 代表大会召开以讨论新法律。
words.en: A congress is a formal meeting of representatives, as of various nations, to discuss problems or to make decisions.

words.tr: n. 被除数；股份红利；股息
words.ex: In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, the dividend is 12.
words.en: A dividend is a sum of money paid regularly (typically annually) by a company to its shareholders out of its profits (or reserves).

words.ex: Somebody left their umbrella here.
words.ex_cn: 某人把伞落在这里了。
words.en: Somebody refers to a person who is not known or not specifically named.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.tr:
n. 脚注；次要者
v. 为…作脚注
words.ex: He added a footnote to explain the word.
words.ex_cn: 他加了一个脚注来解释这个词。
words.en: A footnote is a note at the bottom of a page in a book which provides more detailed information about something mentioned in the text above it.

words.ex: He bought nouveaux shoes at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了新鞋。
words.en: New or recent, especially in fashion or art.

words.tr: v. 使能够，提供做…的权利[措施]； adj. 有可能，或有条件完成的 v. 使能够，提供做…的权利[措施]( enable的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The new law is enabling more people to vote online.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律使更多人能够在线投票。
words.en: Present participle of enable: giving someone the means or opportunity to do something.

words.ex: He worked overtime to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他加班完成了这个项目。
words.en: Overtime refers to the time worked beyond one's regular working hours, often with additional pay.

words.tr: v. 获得；设法得到；保卫；使安全；紧固，拴牢（secure 的现在分词）；
words.ex: He is securing a job before graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他正在毕业前获得一份工作。
words.en: To secure something means to obtain it, especially as a result of effort, or to make something safe from harm or loss.

words.tr: n. 管理者；经理；“manager”的复数；
words.ex: The managers plan the work for their teams.
words.ex_cn: 管理者为他们的团队规划工作。
words.en: Managers are people who are responsible for controlling or administering all or part of a company or similar organization.

words.ex: He has many problems with math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上有很多问题。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: The contents of the book are easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的内容很容易理解。
words.en: The things that are contained within something, especially a written work or a container.

words.ex: The shipment arrived on time.
words.ex_cn: 运输按时到达了。
words.en: The act of sending goods from one place to another, especially by ship.

words.tr: v. 口授；大声讲或读( dictate的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The boss dictated the letter to his assistant.
words.ex_cn: 老板向他的助手口述了这封信。
words.en: Ordered or commanded by someone in authority; determined by external factors.

words.ex: The magnates own many big companies.
words.ex_cn: 这些巨头拥有许多大公司。
words.en: A magnate is a person of great influence, importance, or standing in a particular enterprise or field of business.

words.tr: adj. 可怕的；极坏的；糟糕的；
words.ex: The storm caused a terrible flood.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了一场可怕的洪水。
words.en: If something is terrible, it is very bad or of very poor quality.

words.tr: n. 加倍； v. 使加倍；“double”的现在分词；
words.ex: The doubling of the budget helped improve the school.
words.ex_cn: 预算的加倍帮助改善了学校。
words.en: The act of making something twice as much or as many.

words.ex: The scientist wrote three analyses of the data.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家写了三项数据分析。
words.en: Analyses are detailed examinations of the elements or structure of something, typically as a basis for discussion or interpretation.

words.tr: n. 支配；领土；统治（权）；管辖
words.ex: The king had dominion over the land.
words.ex_cn: 国王对这片土地拥有统治权。
words.en: Dominion refers to the power or right of governing and controlling; it can also denote a territory or sphere of influence.

words.tr: adj. 位于…的；处于…的境地的； v. 使位于；使坐落于；“situate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is situated near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子位于湖边。
words.en: If something is situated in a particular place or position, it is in that place or position.

words.ex: He lives in the southern part of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城市的南部。
words.en: Located in or characteristic of a region in the south.

words.tr: adj. 详细的；细致的； v. “detail”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He gave a detailed description of the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他对事故做了详细的描述。
words.en: A detailed account or report contains a lot of details.

words.ex: The accident resulted in serious injuries.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故导致了严重伤害。
words.en: to happen or exist because of something else

words.tr: v. 选择；挑选；“select”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 挑选出来的；精选的；
words.ex: He selected the red shirt for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对选择了红色衬衫。
words.en: Chosen as the best or most suitable from a group of similar things.

words.tr: adj. 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的；
words.ex: He is a notorious thief who stole from many stores.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个声名狼藉的小偷，偷过许多商店。
words.en: Someone or something that is notorious is well known for something bad.

words.ex: The teachers use the workrooms to prepare lessons.
words.ex_cn: 老师们使用工作间备课。
words.en: A room or area where work is done, especially in a professional or artistic context.

words.tr: n. 搅动；煽动；激动；不安
words.ex: The agitation of the water made the dirt rise.
words.ex_cn: 水的搅动使灰尘浮起。
words.en: Agitation is a state of anxiety or nervous excitement.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.tr: n. 违反；妨碍；侵犯；违背；
words.ex: The driver got a ticket for traffic violation.
words.ex_cn: 司机因违反交通规则被开罚单。
words.en: A violation is an action that breaks a law, agreement, principle, etc.

words.tr: v. 促进；推销；<正>促进( promote的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The program is promoting healthy eating.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在促进健康饮食。
words.en: If people promote something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread.

words.ex: He bought a new accessory for his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的手机买了一个新配件。
words.en: An accessory is something such as a bag or piece of jewelry that you wear or carry because it is attractive.

words.tr: v. （使）联合；兼有； n. 结合性的，化合的 v. （使）联合( combine的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is combining the two groups into one.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把两个小组合并成一个。
words.en: The act of joining two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.tr: v. 支持；支撑；维持；支持( support的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He supported his friend during the hard time.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友困难的时候支持了他。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.ex: His behaviour at school is very good.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校的行为很好。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.tr: adj. 有精神病的；心理不正常的；精神紊乱的； v. 打扰；妨碍；“disturb”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The disturbed man talked to himself all day.
words.ex_cn: 那个有精神病的人整天自言自语。
words.en: If someone is disturbed, they are very worried or troubled by something.

words.tr: n. 高原地区；山岳地带（highland 的复数形式）
words.ex: The highlands are known for their rugged terrain.
words.ex_cn: 这些高原地区以其崎岖的地形而闻名。
words.en: Highlands are areas of high or mountainous land. They are often found in countries like Scotland, where they are known for their scenic beauty and rugged terrain.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.ex: We have lunch in the afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在下午吃午饭。
words.en: The part of the day from noon or lunchtime to evening.

words.tr: adv. 断然地；果断地；明确地；
words.ex: He decidedly refused to join the project.
words.ex_cn: 他断然拒绝参加这个项目。
words.en: In a way that is clear and definite; undoubtedly.

words.tr: v. 详细说明；指定；阐述；“specify”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 指定的；规定的；详细说明的；
words.ex: He specified the rules clearly before the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛前清楚地详细说明了规则。
words.en: If something is specified, it is clearly stated or identified in detail.

words.tr: v. 发起；开始；开始( initiate的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He initiated a new project last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月发起了一项新计划。
words.en: To initiate something means to start it or cause it to happen.

words.tr: n. 反对者；对手；敌手；对手，敌手( opponent的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The opponents of the new law spoke at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 新法律的反对者在会议上发言。
words.en: Those who are opposed to someone in a contest or conflict.

words.tr: v. [贸易]进口；[贸易]进口（import 的现在分词）；
words.ex: They are importing coffee from Brazil.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在从巴西进口咖啡。
words.en: The act of bringing goods or services into a country from abroad for sale.

words.tr: n. 农民阶级; （总称）农民; 农民的状况、地位或行为
words.ex: The decline of the peasantry has led to changes in rural economies.
words.ex_cn: 农民阶级的衰落导致了农村经济的变革。
words.en: The peasantry refers to the class of people in a society who are engaged in agricultural labor, typically as small-scale farmers or laborers on larger estates.

words.ex: He buys new notebooks every semester.
words.ex_cn: 他每学期都买新笔记本。
words.en: A book of blank or lined pages for writing notes.

words.tr: v. 经历；承受；“undergo”的过去分词；
words.ex: He has undergone a big change.
words.ex_cn: 他经历了一次巨大的变化。
words.en: If you undergo something, especially something that is unpleasant or difficult, you experience it or go through it.

words.tr: adj. 确信的；深信的；信服的； v. 说服；使确信；“convince”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I am convinced that he will win.
words.ex_cn: 我确信他会赢。
words.en: If you are convinced of something, you are sure that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: Don't interfere when I am working.
words.ex_cn: 我工作时不要打扰。
words.en: To interfere means to involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, often causing problems or hindering progress.

words.tr: adj. 无耻的；脸皮厚的；不知羞耻的
words.ex: He gave a shameless excuse for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他为迟到提供了一个无耻的借口。
words.en: If you describe someone as shameless, you mean that they should be ashamed of their behavior, which is unacceptable to other people.

words.ex: He has illusions about being rich one day.
words.ex_cn: 他幻想有一天会变得富有。
words.en: An illusion is a false idea or belief, or a deceptive appearance or impression.

words.tr: n. 肩膀；肩部；肩膀（shoulder 的复数）；
words.ex: He carried the bag on his shoulders.
words.ex_cn: 他把包扛在肩膀上。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the arm is connected, or the part of a piece of clothing that covers this.

words.ex: The ruins show the antiquity of this civilization.
words.ex_cn: 这些废墟展示了这个文明的古老。
words.en: The ancient past, especially the period before the Middle Ages.

words.tr:
adv. 昨天；
n. 昨天；
words.ex: I saw her yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天见到她了。
words.en: The day before today.

words.tr: adj. 经验主义的；以经验为根据的；
words.ex: The scientist used empirical data to support her theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用经验数据来支持她的理论。
words.en: Empirical evidence or study relies on practical experience rather than theories.

words.ex: He is a practised speaker who never gets nervous.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个老练的演讲者，从不紧张。
words.en: Someone who is practised at something is very good at it because they have had a lot of experience doing it.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.tr: adv. 无限地；无穷地；极大地；
words.ex: The stars are infinitely far away.
words.ex_cn: 星星离得无限远。
words.en: In a way that is without limits or bounds; extremely or immeasurably.

words.ex: The possessors of the key can open the door.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙的拥有者可以打开门。
words.en: People or entities that own or hold something.

words.ex: The bank paid interest to the depositors.
words.ex_cn: 银行向存款人支付利息。
words.en: A depositor is a person or organization that places money in a bank account or other financial institution.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.tr: n. 检查；视察；查看；审视；
words.ex: The teacher did an inspection of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师对教室进行了检查。
words.en: An inspection is an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.ex: I will definitely come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我肯定会来参加派对。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.tr: v. 叙述；描写；形容；描写( describe的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is describing the accident to the police.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向警察叙述事故经过。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.tr: v. 使变形；使变质；使变化
words.ex: The old metal was transmuted into gold.
words.ex_cn: 旧金属被转化为黄金。
words.en: To change in form, nature, or substance.

words.tr: v. 抱怨，诉苦，投诉；申诉，控诉，抗议；诉说，申诉；抱怨，诉苦，投诉( complain的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He complained about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨邻居很吵。
words.en: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

words.tr: v. 表明；指出；“indicate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The dark clouds are indicating rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.ex: He lengthened his shirt to cover his waist.
words.ex_cn: 他把衬衫拉长以遮住腰部。
words.en: To make or become longer.

words.ex: He showed conformity with the group's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守了小组的规定。
words.en: Conformity is the act of matching attitudes, beliefs, and behaviors to group norms or standards.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.tr: n. 倾向，趋势；倾向，趋势( tendency的名词复数 )；
words.ex: Children have tendencies to copy their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子有模仿父母的倾向。
words.en: A tendency is a likelihood or natural inclination to behave in a particular way or to have a particular characteristic.

words.ex: The tourists visited many small localities.
words.ex_cn: 游客们参观了许多小地方。
words.en: Localities refer to specific places or areas, often with distinct characteristics or features.

words.ex: He saw the sufferings of the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他看到了穷苦孩子们的苦难。
words.en: The experience of physical or mental pain or distress.

words.ex: She ordinarily wakes up at six o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 她通常六点起床。
words.en: In a usual or normal manner.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.tr:
adj. 心不在焉的；出神的
v. 提取；抽取；作…的摘要；“abstract”的过去式和去分词
words.ex: She seemed abstracted, lost in her own thoughts.
words.ex_cn: 她看起来心不在焉，沉浸在自己的思绪中。
words.en: If someone is abstracted, they are not paying attention to what is happening around them because they are thinking deeply about something else.

words.tr: v. 发音；宣告；“pronounce”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 显著的；
words.ex: He pronounced the word correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地发音了这个单词。
words.en: Something that is pronounced is very noticeable or obvious.

words.ex: The generating of electricity requires wind or water.
words.ex_cn: 电力的生成需要风或水。
words.en: To generate means to cause something to exist or occur.

words.ex: There is little intercourse between the two villages.
words.ex_cn: 这两个村庄之间很少交往。
words.en: Intercourse refers to communication or dealings between individuals or groups, or sexual activity between people.

words.ex: The legislature passed a new law last week.
words.ex_cn: 立法机构上周通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A legislature is the part of a country's government that is responsible for making laws.

words.tr: n. 获得；得到的东西；收购；
words.ex: The acquisition of new skills takes time.
words.ex_cn: 获得新技能需要时间。
words.en: An acquisition is something that someone buys, often to add to a collection of things.

words.tr: v. 接近；靠近；“approach”的现在分词； adj. 接近的；临近的；
words.ex: The train is approaching the station.
words.ex_cn: 火车正在接近车站。
words.en: Coming closer in distance or time.

words.tr: adj. （男性）家长制的；族长制的；父权制的
words.ex: He lives in a patriarchal family where the father makes all the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个父亲做所有决定的父权家庭中。
words.en: Relating to, characteristic of, or denoting a system of society or government controlled by men.

words.tr: n. 地基；基础；基金（会）；“foundation”的复数；
words.ex: The builders laid the foundations before pouring the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工人在浇筑混凝土之前铺设了地基。
words.en: The lowest load-bearing part of a building, typically below ground level; an underlying basis or principle for something.

words.tr: v. 了解; 懂，理解( understand的第三人称单数 ); 默认; 听说
words.ex: He understands the basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他理解基本的数学。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.ex: The weather is exceedingly cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气极其寒冷。
words.en: To a very great degree; extremely.

words.ex: The car accelerates on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在高速公路上加速。
words.en: If the process or rate of something accelerates or if something accelerates it, it gets faster and faster.

words.ex: The store was overstocked with winter coats.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的冬衣存货过多。
words.en: Having more of a product or item than is needed or can be sold.

words.tr: v. （使）收缩；订合同；“contract”的现在分词；
words.ex: The muscles are contracting during exercise.
words.ex_cn: 肌肉在锻炼时收缩。
words.en: If you contract with someone to do something, you legally agree to do it for them or for them to do it for you.

words.tr: adj. 不感兴趣的；不关心的；
words.ex: He was indifferent to the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影不感兴趣。
words.en: If you accuse someone of being indifferent to something, you mean that they have a complete lack of interest in it.

words.ex: The denominator is 5 in the fraction 3/5.
words.ex_cn: 在分数 3/5 中，分母是 5。
words.en: The number below the line in a fraction that shows the number of equal parts into which the whole is divided.

words.ex: The store sells cheap merchandise.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售廉价商品。
words.en: Goods to be bought and sold.

words.ex: He is tapping his pen incessantly.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地敲打钢笔。
words.en: Without interruption; constantly.

words.ex: The photo showed an enlargement of the tiny letter.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了那个小字母的放大版。
words.en: The act of making something larger or the state of being made larger.

words.ex: The book is interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书很有趣。
words.en: If something is interesting, it attracts your attention, because it is unusual, exciting, or has lots of ideas.

words.tr: n. 公式化；阐述方式；规划；配方
words.ex: The formulation of the equation took hours.
words.ex_cn: 这个公式的推导花了好几个小时。
words.en: The act or process of formulating something, especially a systematic statement of principles or a particular method of preparing something.

words.tr: n. 职业；工作；雇用（employment的复数）
words.ex: The company offers a variety of employments in different sectors.
words.ex_cn: 该公司在不同领域提供多种职业。
words.en: The state of being employed; work or occupation.

words.tr: adj. 专门的；特别的； v. “specialise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He works in a specialised hospital for children.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家专门治疗儿童的医院工作。
words.en: Designed or developed for a particular purpose or area of knowledge.

words.ex: He paused momentarily to catch his breath.
words.ex_cn: 他停了一下，喘口气。
words.en: For a very short time; immediately.

words.tr: n. 倾向; 责任，义务; 债务，负债
words.ex: The company's main liabilities are its bank loans and unpaid bills.
words.ex_cn: 该公司的主要负债是银行贷款和未付账单。
words.en: Liabilities refer to the financial debts or obligations that a company or individual owes to others, which must be settled over time through the transfer of economic benefits including money, goods, or services.

words.ex: The workers live on large plantations.
words.ex_cn: 工人们住在大型种植园里。
words.en: A plantation is a large piece of land, especially in a tropical country, where crops such as coffee, sugar, rubber, etc. are grown.

words.tr: adv. 间断发生地；零星地
words.ex: He visits his grandma sporadically.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望奶奶。
words.en: If something happens sporadically, it happens occasionally and not regularly or continuously.

words.tr: n. 均等，平等化，同等化; 整平
words.ex: The policy aims to promote equalization of educational opportunities.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策旨在促进教育机会的均等化。
words.en: The act of making equal or uniform; the state of being equal or uniform.

words.ex: He insulted her gratuitously.
words.ex_cn: 他无端地侮辱了她。
words.en: In a way that is not necessary or is done without good reason; free of charge.

words.ex: He wears conventional clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿传统服装去上班。
words.en: Conventional ideas, methods, or systems are the ones that are generally accepted and used, and that have been used for a long time.

words.tr: adj. 引导的；介绍的；开端的；
words.ex: This is an introductory book for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这是一本为初学者引导的书。
words.en: An introductory remark, event, or action is one that comes at the beginning of something, often in order to explain or introduce it.

words.tr: adj. 关于财富的；以财富为目的的
words.ex: He is chrematistic about money and never gives away anything.
words.ex_cn: 他对金钱很功利，从不给予任何东西。
words.en: Relating to the pursuit of wealth; concerned with the acquisition of wealth.

words.tr: n. 间歇；暂停；中间休息
words.ex: There is a ten-minute intermission during the play.
words.ex_cn: 这场戏中间有十分钟的中场休息。
words.en: An intermission is a short break between parts of a play, film, concert, or other performance.

words.ex: The car's acceleration increased when the driver pressed the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当司机踩油门时，汽车的加速度增加了。
words.en: Acceleration is the rate at which a car or other vehicle can increase its speed, often measured in the time it takes to go from 0 to 60 miles per hour.

words.tr: v. 使混合；组成公司( incorporate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is incorporating sugar into the tea.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把糖混入茶中。
words.en: To include something as part of a larger group, system, or plan; to form a legal corporation.

words.tr: n. 工业家；实业家；企业家
words.ex: The industrialist built a large factory in the town.
words.ex_cn: 这位工业家在镇上建了一家大工厂。
words.en: An industrialist is a person who owns or is involved in the management of an industrial enterprise.

words.ex: Mercantilists believed that a nation's wealth comes from exporting more than importing.
words.ex_cn: 重商主义者认为，一个国家的财富来自于出口多于进口。
words.en: Mercantilists were proponents of mercantilism, an economic theory that advocates for government regulation of a nation's economy to augment state power at the expense of rival national powers.

words.tr: n. 不足，不充分；机能不全；不适当
words.ex: The insufficiency of water caused the plants to die.
words.ex_cn: 水的不足导致植物死亡。
words.en: If there is an insufficiency of something, there is not enough of it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.ex: She is extraordinarily kind.
words.ex_cn: 她非常善良。
words.en: To an unusual or remarkable degree.

words.tr: n. 英担（英国重量单位，等于112磅或50.8公斤）
words.ex: The farmer sold 2 cwt of potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 农民卖了两百磅（cwt）的土豆。
words.en: A unit of weight in the British Imperial System, equal to 112 pounds or 50.8 kilograms.

words.ex: He ate bread made from rye.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用黑麦做的面包。
words.en: Rye is a type of cereal plant grown in cool climates. It is used for making bread, whiskey, and animal feed.

words.ex: He got a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.ex: The girl is playing with her dog.
words.ex_cn: 这个女孩正在和她的狗玩。
words.en: A girl is a female child or young woman.

words.ex: He owns a small red car.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一辆红色的小汽车。
words.en: To have something as one's own; to possess.

words.ex: The atom is the smallest part of matter.
words.ex_cn: 原子是物质的最小单位。
words.en: An atom is the smallest unit of ordinary matter that forms a chemical element. Every solid, liquid, gas, and plasma is composed of neutral or ionized atoms.

words.ex: He robs a bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周抢劫一家银行。
words.en: To take something from someone unlawfully, typically using force or threat.

words.ex: We eat lunch at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: Noon is the middle of the day, 12 o'clock in the daytime.

words.tr: v. “breed”的过去式和过去分词；培育；繁殖；
words.ex: The dogs were bred to be friendly and smart.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗被培育得友好而聪明。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.ex: He wants to join the football team.
words.ex_cn: 他想加入足球队。
words.en: To become a member of a group or organization; to connect or fasten things together.

words.tr:
adj. 寒冷的；冰冷的；
n. 寒冷；
words.ex: The cold wind made me shiver.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的风让我发抖。
words.en: Something that is cold has a low temperature, especially when compared to the temperature of the human body. It can also describe a lack of warmth in someone's behavior or a situation.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.ex: The jury decided the man was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团裁定这个人无罪。
words.en: A jury is a group of people who are chosen to decide whether someone is guilty or not guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.ex: He rept his old shoes to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他重复使用旧鞋来省钱。
words.en: A reptile, especially one that is considered in a general or informal context.

words.tr:
n. 鞭策；
v. 刺激；
words.ex: The competition served as a spur to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 竞争成了推动他更努力工作的鞭策。
words.en: A spur is something that makes you want to do something or that encourages you to do it. It can also refer to a sharp device worn on the heel of a rider's boot to urge a horse forward.

words.ex: He forgot the keys to the locks.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了锁的钥匙。
words.en: Locks are devices used to secure doors, containers, etc., and can also refer to sections of a canal or river where the water level changes, controlled by gates.

words.ex: He chewed a quid of tobacco after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后咀嚼了一小块烟草。
words.en: A quid is a British slang term for one pound sterling. It can also refer to something that is chewed, such as tobacco.

words.tr:
n. 时距；跨度；
v. 跨越；
words.ex: The span of his career was 40 years.
words.ex_cn: 他职业生涯的时距是40年。
words.en: The extent or measure of space between two points or extremities, as of a bridge or a roof; the full extent, stretch, or reach of anything.

words.ex: He wears hats every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都戴帽子。
words.en: Hats are head coverings, often worn for protection against the elements, for ceremonial reasons, for safety, or as a fashion accessory.

words.tr:
n. 洗涤槽；水槽；
v. （使）沉没；
words.ex: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
words.ex_cn: 脏盘子在水槽里。
words.en: If a boat sinks, or if something sinks it, it disappears below the surface of a mass of water.

words.ex: He enjoys long walks in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在公园里长时间散步。
words.en: To move along on foot; advance by steps.

words.ex: He did not avail himself of the opportunity.
words.ex_cn: 他没有利用这个机会。
words.en: If you avail yourself of something, you use it or take advantage of it.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；伟大的；
n. 巨人；伟人；
words.ex: The giant elephant stood near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的大象站在树旁。
words.en: A giant is an imaginary person who is very big and strong, especially one mentioned in old stories. In everyday language, a giant can also refer to a very large and successful company or organization.

words.tr: n. 马达；发动机；机动车；
words.ex: The car has a strong motor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强大的马达。
words.en: A motor is a device that changes energy into mechanical motion, especially such a device that provides power for a vehicle or for another device with moving parts.

words.ex: The media reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 媒介迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the Internet), regarded collectively.

words.ex: The bands played at the music festival last night.
words.ex_cn: 这些乐队昨晚在音乐节上表演了。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for fastening or binding things together.

words.tr:
adj. 希腊的；
n. 希腊语；
words.ex: He loves eating Greek food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃的希腊食物。
words.en: Relating to Greece, its people, or their language.

words.ex: He ate eggs and bacon for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了鸡蛋和培根。
words.en: Bacon is a type of salt-cured pork made from various cuts, typically from the pork belly or from back cuts, which are less fatty than the belly.

words.ex: He built a wall with red brick.
words.ex_cn: 他用红砖砌了一堵墙。
words.en: A brick is a rectangular block of baked clay used for building walls, which are usually red or brown.

words.ex: Each link in the chain is important.
words.ex_cn: 链条中的每一个环节都很重要。
words.en: If there is a link between two things or situations, there is a relationship between them.

words.ex: The tribe lives in the forest and follows old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在森林里，遵循古老的传统。
words.en: A tribe is a social division in a traditional society consisting of families or communities linked by social, economic, religious, or blood ties, with a common culture and dialect, typically having a recognized leader.

words.tr: v. 拥有；“own”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 自身拥有的；
words.ex: He owned a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年拥有一家小店。
words.en: Possessed or controlled by someone or something.

words.ex: He sells his wares at the market every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都在市场上卖他的商品。
words.en: Goods or merchandise that are for sale.

words.tr: n. 打气筒；泵( pump的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He used the pumps to fill the bicycle tires.
words.ex_cn: 他用打气筒给自行车轮胎打气。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action, typically converted from electrical energy into hydraulic energy. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.tr:
n. 触摸；触觉；触感；
v. 触摸；接触；触动；
words.ex: The touch of her hand was gentle.
words.ex_cn: 她手的触摸很温柔。
words.en: If you touch something, you feel it with your hand, or come into physical contact with it.

words.ex: He wrote his notes on ruled paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在有平行线条的纸上记了笔记。
words.en: To have control and authority over a country, area, or group of people.

words.ex: He wears a white shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件白衬衫去上班。
words.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing for the upper body, typically having a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

words.tr: v. 结束；终止；结束，终止（end 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The movie ended at 9 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 电影在晚上9点结束了。
words.en: If something ends, or if you end it, it stops or you stop it.

words.ex: He bought three pairs of shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他买了三双鞋。
words.en: Two things of the same type that are used together or regarded as a unit.

words.ex: He gave the rope a twist to tie it tight.
words.ex_cn: 他把绳子拧了一下以便系紧。
words.en: To twist something means to turn it in a different direction or to change its shape by turning it.

words.ex: He chose the red shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了红色的衬衫。
words.en: If you choose someone or something from several people or things that are available, you decide which person or thing you want to have.

words.tr: n. 代替; 用处，好处; 有帮助 v. 对。。有用
words.ex: He took the place of his brother in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中代替了他的兄弟。
words.en: If you do something in someone's stead, you do it instead of them.

words.ex: Farmers grow barley for animal feed.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植大麦作为动物饲料。
words.en: Barley is a cereal grain that is used as food and also in making beer and whiskey.

words.ex: The dog seizes the ball and runs.
words.ex_cn: 狗抓住球然后跑掉了。
words.en: To take hold of something suddenly and forcibly; to take possession of something by legal authority.

words.ex: The gentry owned most of the land in the old village.
words.ex_cn: 绅士阶层拥有这个古老村庄的大部分土地。
words.en: The gentry are people of high social class, especially in the past.

words.ex: He dreams of a perfect utopia where everyone is happy.
words.ex_cn: 他梦想一个每个人都很幸福的完美乌托邦。
words.en: An imagined place or state of things in which everything is perfect.

words.tr:
v. 引用；
n. 报价；
words.ex: He quotes his favorite poet in every speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在每次演讲中都引用他最喜欢的诗人。
words.en: Quotes refer to words or phrases taken from a text or speech, or the act of repeating someone else's words. It can also mean to give someone an estimated price for a service or product.

words.ex: Children learn morals from their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们从父母那里学习道德。
words.en: Morals are principles or standards of good behavior, especially in matters of sexual relationships.

words.ex: The flowers will perish if you don't water them.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不给花浇水，它们会死。
words.en: If people or animals perish, they die as a result of very harsh conditions or as the result of an accident.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: The pauper lived in a small hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个穷人住在一间小屋里。
words.en: A pauper is someone who is extremely poor and has very little money or possessions.

words.ex: Leaves fall in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在秋季落下。
words.en: Autumn is the season between summer and winter when leaves change color and the weather becomes cooler.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: He lives on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个小岛上。
words.en: An island is a piece of land that is completely surrounded by water.

words.tr: v. 把…带错方向；“mislead”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was misled by the false advertisement.
words.ex_cn: 他被虚假广告误导了。
words.en: If you say that someone has misled you, you mean that they have made you believe something which is not true, either by telling you a lie or by giving you a wrong idea or impression.

words.ex: He ignored the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了警告标志。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.ex: The editor corrected the grammar in the article.
words.ex_cn: 编辑纠正了这篇文章的语法。
words.en: An editor is a person who is in charge of a newspaper or magazine and who decides what will be published in it.

words.tr: adj. 适合的；合适的； v. 适合；“suit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This job is suited for someone who loves quiet work.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作适合喜欢安静工作的人。
words.en: If someone or something is suited to a particular purpose, they have the right qualities or characteristics for it.

words.tr: adj. 被偷走的； v. 偷；“steal”的过去分词；
words.ex: The stolen bike was found near the park.
words.ex_cn: 那辆被偷的自行车在公园附近找到了。
words.en: Taken without the owner's consent; obtained by theft.

words.tr: n. 莫斯科（俄罗斯首都）
words.ex: He lives in Moscow.
words.ex_cn: 他住在莫斯科。
words.en: Moscow is the capital city of Russia, known for its significant role in Russian history and culture.

words.tr:
n. 警方；警察部门；
v. 监督；
words.ex: The police caught the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警方昨晚抓到了小偷。
words.en: The police are the official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law, for catching criminals, and for keeping public order.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: If you listen to someone or something, you give your attention to a sound or to what someone says.

words.tr: adj. 欠缺的；过小的；少量的
words.ex: He had scanty food for the whole day.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天的食物很少。
words.en: If something is scanty, there is not enough of it or it is too small in amount.

words.tr:
n. 法令；判决
v. 判决；颁布；裁定
words.ex: The king issued a decree to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 国王发布了一项法令来停止战争。
words.en: An official order issued by a legal authority.

words.ex: There are eleven apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有十一个苹果。
words.en: The number 11.

words.tr:
n. 战斗；
v. 战斗；
words.ex: The soldiers fought in a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们进行了一场漫长的战斗。
words.en: A battle is a violent fight between groups of people, especially one between military forces during a war.

words.ex: The sandpaper feels coarse to the touch.
words.ex_cn: 这张砂纸摸起来很粗糙。
words.en: Coarse things have a rough texture because they consist of thick threads or large pieces.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；强大的；
adv. 非常；
words.ex: The mighty river flows through the valley.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的河流流经山谷。
words.en: Possessing great power, strength, or force; formidable.

words.ex: She picked up a thread from the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她从布料上捡起一根线。
words.en: A thread is a long, thin strand of cotton, nylon, or other fibers used in sewing or weaving. It can also refer to a theme or idea that connects parts of a story or discussion.

words.tr: v. 教；教导；“teach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My mom taught me how to cook.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈教我做饭。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of teach, which means to impart knowledge or instruct someone in a particular skill or subject.

words.ex: I will go to the park on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 我将在星期五去公园。
words.en: Friday is the day of the week between Thursday and Saturday.

words.tr: adj. 有法律约束力的；必须遵守的； n. 封皮； v. “bind”的现在分词；
words.ex: The contract is binding for both parties.
words.ex_cn: 这份合同对双方都有法律约束力。
words.en: Binding refers to the act of fastening or securing something, or the material used to do this. It can also describe something that is obligatory or that imposes a legal or moral obligation.

words.tr: n. 普鲁士（历史上位于欧洲中北部的一个国家）
words.ex: Prussia was a powerful kingdom in Europe.
words.ex_cn: 普鲁士是欧洲的一个强大王国。
words.en: A historical region and former kingdom in north-central Europe, which played a significant role in the history of Germany and Europe.

words.tr: v. 污辱；打上...的烙印；“brand”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有品牌的；
words.ex: The scandal branded him as a liar.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻污辱了他，让他被视为骗子。
words.en: Marked with a brand or trademark; having a brand name.

words.tr: adj. 屈从的；奴隶的；逢迎的
words.ex: He gave a servile answer to his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他向老板给出了卑躬屈膝的回答。
words.en: If you describe someone as servile, you disapprove of them because they are too eager to obey someone or do things for them.

words.ex: She picked up the threads from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 她从地上捡起了细线。
words.en: Threads are long, thin pieces of a material such as cotton, nylon, or silk, used in sewing or weaving. They can also refer to a theme or idea that runs through a discussion or piece of writing.

words.ex: The arrival of the train was delayed by 20 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 火车的到达晚了20分钟。
words.en: The act of coming to a place or the moment when something or someone arrives.

words.tr: v. 暗示；“imply”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: His silence implied he disagreed.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他不同意。
words.en: Suggested or understood without being stated directly.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.ex: He decides to go to school early.
words.ex_cn: 他决定早点去学校。
words.en: If you decide to do something, you choose to do it, usually after you have thought carefully about the other possibilities.

words.ex: The fish swim in the streams.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在小溪里游动。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. As a verb, it means to transmit or receive data (especially video and audio material) over the internet as a steady, continuous flow.

words.ex: He borrows a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 他从图书馆借了一本书。
words.en: To borrow means to take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.tr: v. 检查；“check”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher checked the students' homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师检查了学生的作业。
words.en: Having a pattern of squares, typically of two colors; past tense and past participle of check, meaning to examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition.

words.tr: n. 商人；经销商；“trader”的复数；
words.ex: The traders sell fruit at the market.
words.ex_cn: 商人们在市场卖水果。
words.en: People who buy and sell goods, especially in large quantities.

words.ex: The fireman saved the cat from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 消防员从树上救下了那只猫。
words.en: A fireman is a person whose job is to put out fires and rescue people from dangerous situations, especially in buildings.

words.tr: n. 切割；剪辑； v. 削减；切；割；“cut”的现在分词； adj. 锐利的；
words.ex: The cutting of the tree took only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 砍树的切割只用了五分钟。
words.en: The act or process of cutting something; a piece cut off from something, especially a plant.

words.ex: He learns new phrases every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天学习新的短语。
words.en: A phrase is a short group of words that people often use as a way of saying something. The meaning of a phrase is often not obvious from the meaning of the individual words in it.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.tr: adj. 更轻的；更浅的；“light”的比较级；
words.ex: This bag is lighter than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这个包比另一个更轻。
words.en: A lighter is a device that produces a small flame, used to light cigarettes, cigars, or pipes. It can also refer to a boat used to transport goods between a ship and the shore.

words.ex: His mission is to help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他的使命是帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

words.ex: The princes live in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 王子们住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A prince is a male member of a royal family, especially a son of the king or queen.

words.ex: Exercise lessens stress.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼减轻压力。
words.en: To make or become less; reduce in size, amount, degree, or intensity.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.tr: v. 送；派遣；使进入； n. 发送；派遣；送( send的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is sending a letter to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他正在给朋友寄一封信。
words.en: To cause to go or be taken to a particular destination; dispatch.

words.tr: n. 钓鱼；捕鱼； v. 钓鱼；捕鱼；“fish”的现在分词；
words.ex: He likes fishing by the lake every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每周末去湖边钓鱼。
words.en: Fishing is the activity of trying to catch fish.

words.tr: n. 舞台造型；戏剧性的场面
words.ex: He drew a tableau of the scene on paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画出了那个场景的图示。
words.en: A tableau is a group of models or motionless figures representing a scene from a story or from history; a picturesque grouping of persons or objects; a striking or artistic grouping.

words.tr: n. 母亲；根源（mother 的复数）；
words.ex: Mothers love their children deeply.
words.ex_cn: 母亲们深爱着自己的孩子。
words.en: A mother is a female parent of a child. Mothers are women who inhabit or perform the role of bearing some relation to their children, who may or may not be their biological offspring.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: His avarice knew no bounds, always seeking more wealth.
words.ex_cn: 他的贪婪无止境，总是追求更多的财富。
words.en: Avarice is extremely strong desire for money and possessions.

words.ex: He fancies her because she is kind and smart.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢她，因为她善良又聪明。
words.en: Fancies refer to whimsical or imaginative thoughts, often not based on reality.

words.tr: adj. 焦虑的；渴望的；担忧的；
words.ex: He feels anxious before every test.
words.ex_cn: 他每次考试前都感到焦虑。
words.en: If you are anxious to do something or anxious that something should happen, you very much want to do it or very much want it to happen.

words.ex: He contends that education is the key to success.
words.ex_cn: 他主张教育是成功的关键。
words.en: If you contend with someone or contend with something, you have to deal with a difficult situation or problem. If you contend that something is true, you state or argue that it is true.

words.ex: He tried to justify his mistake by saying he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他试图以自己累了为由来证明自己的错误是正当的。
words.en: To justify something means to show or prove that it is reasonable, necessary, or correct.

words.ex: The fathers took their children to the park.
words.ex_cn: 父亲们带他们的孩子去公园了。
words.en: Fathers refers to male parents or ancestors. It can also denote founders or originators of a movement or idea.

words.tr:
n. 冒险事业；商业冒险；投机；
v. 冒险；投机；
words.ex: He started a new venture in technology.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一项新的科技冒险事业。
words.en: If you venture somewhere, you go somewhere that might be dangerous. If you venture a question or statement, you say it in an uncertain way because you are afraid it might be stupid or wrong.

words.tr: v. 犯罪；承诺；把…托付给
words.ex: He commits to exercising every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺每天早上锻炼。
words.en: If someone commits to something, they dedicate themselves to it or promise to do it.

words.ex: Drugs can relieve pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To relieve someone or something means to make a problem, pain, or unpleasant feeling less severe or to take it away completely.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a way of working, organizing, or doing something which follows a fixed plan or set of rules. You can use system to refer to an organization or institution that is organized in this way.

words.ex: The placing of the chairs was done carefully.
words.ex_cn: 椅子的安放是仔细进行的。
words.en: The act of putting something in a particular place or position.

words.ex: Beggars sit on the street and ask for money.
words.ex_cn: 乞丐坐在街上乞讨钱。
words.en: People who ask for money or food in the streets because they are poor.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

words.tr: n. 缺点；缺陷；毛病；缺点，缺陷，毛病（defect 的复数）；
words.ex: The phone has some small defects.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一些小缺点。
words.en: A defect is a fault or imperfection in a person or thing. To defect means to abandon one's country or cause in favor of an opposing one.

words.ex: The country fell into anarchy after the war.
words.ex_cn: 战争之后，这个国家陷入了混乱。
words.en: Anarchy is a state of disorder due to absence or nonrecognition of authority or other controlling systems.

words.tr: v. 照顾；照顾（tend 的现在分词形式）；
words.ex: She is tending her sick mother.
words.ex_cn: 她正在照顾她生病的母亲。
words.en: If you tend to someone or something, you take care of them or deal with their needs.

words.ex: The child's recovery was a miracle.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的康复是个奇迹。
words.en: A miracle is an event that cannot be explained by the laws of nature and is therefore considered to be the work of a divine agency.

words.tr: v. （使）挨饿，饥饿( starve的过去式和过去分词 ); 缺乏，急需; 缺胶
words.ex: The dogs were starved after the storm cut off food supplies.
words.ex_cn: 风暴切断了食物供应后，这些狗挨饿了。
words.en: Suffering or dying from hunger; extremely hungry.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: His article was a polemic against government corruption.
words.ex_cn: 他的文章是对政府腐败的抨击。
words.en: A polemic is a very strong written or spoken attack on, or defence of, a particular belief or opinion.

words.ex: This story relates to our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与我们的日常生活有关联。
words.en: If something relates to a particular subject, it concerns that subject or is connected with it.

words.tr: adj. 很长的；漫长的；冗长的；
words.ex: The meeting was lengthy and tiring.
words.ex_cn: 会议很长，很累人。
words.en: Something that is lengthy lasts for a long time, often longer than you want or expect.

words.ex: He works in the domains of math and science.
words.ex_cn: 他从事数学和科学领域的工作。
words.en: A domain is a particular field of thought, activity, or interest, especially one over which someone has control, influence, or rights.

words.ex: He wrongly answered the question.
words.ex_cn: 他错误地回答了这个问题。
words.en: Incorrectly or unjustly.

words.ex: He had sudden attacks of pain last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚他突然发作疼痛。
words.en: An attack is an act of violence against someone or something, or strong criticism of them.

words.tr: v. 朝向；前进；“head”的现在分词； n. 标题；
words.ex: The ship is heading north.
words.ex_cn: 船正朝北航行。
words.en: A heading is a word, phrase, or sentence at the beginning of a written passage that explains what it's about.

words.ex: He wants to inquire about the bus schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他想询问公交车的时刻表。
words.en: If you inquire about something, you ask for information about it.

words.ex: He counted the coins with his fingers.
words.ex_cn: 他用手指数硬币。
words.en: Fingers are the long thin parts on the end of your hand that you use to hold things.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.ex: The gang extorted money from the shop owner.
words.ex_cn: 帮派向店主勒索钱财。
words.en: To extort means to obtain something, especially money, by force, threats, or other unfair means.

words.tr: n. 代理；代理处；“agency”的复数；
words.ex: The agencies help people find houses.
words.ex_cn: 这些代理帮助人们找房子。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.tr: adj. 由...所生的；v. 产生（beget的过去分词）
words.ex: He was the only son begotten by his father.
words.ex_cn: 他是他父亲唯一的亲生儿子。
words.en: past participle of beget; to produce as an effect or result.

words.ex: The company's holdings include real estate and stocks.
words.ex_cn: 该公司的资产包括房地产和股票。
words.en: The assets or property owned by an individual or organization, especially investments in stocks, bonds, or real estate.

words.tr:
n. 倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；
v. 倒塌；崩溃；
words.ex: The collapse of the old bridge caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥的倒塌引起了诸多问题。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.tr: vt. 暗示；暗指；意味着（imply 的现在分词）；
words.ex: His silence was implying he disagreed.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他不同意。
words.en: If you imply that something is the case, you say something which indicates that it is the case in an indirect way.

words.ex: He resorted to asking for help when he was stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他只好求助。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because other methods have failed.

words.ex: He is eighteen years old.
words.ex_cn: 他十八岁。
words.en: The number 18.

words.ex: He is deriving the formula from the data.
words.ex_cn: 他正在从数据中推导出公式。
words.en: To obtain or receive something from a source; to originate or come from something.

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.ex: His presence made everyone feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 他的存在让每个人都感到平静。
words.en: The state or fact of existing, occurring, or being present in a place or thing.

words.tr: v. 挨饿；“starve”的现在分词； adj. 饥饿的；挨饿的；
words.ex: The children were starving after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 洪水过后，孩子们都饿坏了。
words.en: Suffering or dying from hunger.

words.ex: The validity of the test results is important.
words.ex_cn: 测试结果的有效性很重要。
words.en: The quality of being logically or factually sound; soundness or cogency.

words.ex: The colliers worked hard in the dark mine.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们在黑暗的矿井里努力工作。
words.en: Colliers are people who work in coal mines, extracting coal from the earth.

words.ex: The citizens vote for their leader.
words.ex_cn: 公民们为他们的领导人投票。
words.en: A citizen is a person who is legally recognized as a member of a particular country or state, with certain rights and responsibilities.

words.ex: The team welcomed new recruits last week.
words.ex_cn: 团队上周迎来了新成员。
words.en: Recruits are people who have recently joined an organization or the armed forces. To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to find new people to join an organization or support a cause.

words.tr: adj. 区分的，分划的 v. 划分; 分( divide的现在分词 ); 分离; （使）产生分歧
words.ex: He is dividing the apples among his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把苹果分给他的朋友们。
words.en: To separate something into parts or sections, or to cause something to be separate.

words.ex: He wrote a treatise on ancient Chinese philosophy.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于中国古代哲学的专著。
words.en: A treatise is a formal and systematic written discourse on some subject, generally longer and more detailed than an essay.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: The northern wind is cold in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天的北风很冷。
words.en: Northern means situated in, directed towards, or facing the north.

words.ex: The new software augments the system's speed.
words.ex_cn: 新软件增强了系统的速度。
words.en: To augment something means to make it larger, stronger, or more effective by adding something to it.

words.tr: adj. 可触摸的；实际的；有形的；确凿的；
words.ex: The statue is tangible and can be touched.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像可以触摸，是实实在在的。
words.en: Something that is tangible is clear enough or definite enough to be easily seen, felt, or noticed.

words.ex: The conquest of the mountain took three days.
words.ex_cn: 攻克这座山花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of conquering a place or people.

words.tr: n. 非贵族出身的地主，小地主；乡绅
words.ex: Benjamin Franklin invented the lightning rod.
words.ex_cn: 本杰明·富兰克林发明了避雷针。
words.en: A name, particularly referring to Benjamin Franklin, a Founding Father of the United States, or a term used in medieval England to denote a freeholder who was not of noble birth.

words.tr:
adj. 埃及的；
n. 埃及语；
words.ex: She bought an Egyptian scarf at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一条埃及风格的围巾。
words.en: Of or relating to Egypt or its people, language, or culture.

words.ex: He reads the comments on the video.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读视频下的评论。
words.en: Comments are statements that express someone's opinion or reaction to something.

words.tr: v. 变更；改动；“alter”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is altering the plan to fit the new schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他正在更改计划以适应新的时间表。
words.en: Making partial or complete changes to something, often to improve or modify it.

words.tr: v. 围起；“enclose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They enclosed the garden with a fence.
words.ex_cn: 他们用篱笆把花园围了起来。
words.en: If something is enclosed, it is placed inside an envelope, package, or container, often for the purpose of sending it to someone.

words.tr: adj. 上升的；增长的； n. 底托；登上；乘骑； v. “mount”的现在分词；
words.ex: The mounting pressure made him nervous.
words.ex_cn: 上升的压力让他感到紧张。
words.en: The act of fixing or attaching something in position.

words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.tr: v. 使富裕；使富足；“enrich”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The new job enriched his life.
words.ex_cn: 这份新工作使他的生活富裕起来。
words.en: Made richer or more abundant in some desirable quality or component.

words.ex: He exclaims, 'I won!' when he sees the score.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到分数时，他大喊：‘我赢了！’
words.en: To say something suddenly and loudly, especially because of surprise, anger, or pain.

words.ex: The observer recorded the weather every day.
words.ex_cn: 观测者每天记录天气。
words.en: An observer is someone who sees or notices something, or who watches something carefully.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The existent evidence supports the theory.
words.ex_cn: 存在的证据支持这一理论。
words.en: Something that is existent exists or is present in a particular situation.

words.ex: The bus stops at the terminal at 9 PM.
words.ex_cn: 公交车晚上9点到达终点站。
words.en: A terminal is a place where vehicles, passengers, or goods begin or end a journey. It can also refer to a computer device at which a user enters data or commands.

words.ex: His thoughts are clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 他的想法清晰而简单。
words.en: The process of thinking; the ideas or opinions that result from thinking.

words.tr: v. 受损害；受痛苦；变差；受痛苦( suffer的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He suffered from the cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 他因寒冷的天气而受损害。
words.en: If you suffer pain, you feel it in your body or in your mind. In a war, for example, people suffer a great deal.

words.ex: He depended on his parents for money.
words.ex_cn: 他依赖父母给钱。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply.

words.tr: v. 补充; （使）复原， （使）更新，赋予新的生命和活力( renew的现在分词 ); 重新开始;
words.ex: The garden looks beautiful after the rain, renewing its freshness.
words.ex_cn: 雨后花园看起来很美，恢复了它的清新。
words.en: To make something new, fresh, or strong again; to begin doing something again after a pause or interruption.

words.tr: v. 使困惑；使混淆；挫败
words.ex: The noise confounds her concentration.
words.ex_cn: 噪音扰乱了她的专注力。
words.en: To confuse or perplex someone; to mix up or mistake one thing for another.

words.ex: The town is famous for its potteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇以它的陶瓷制品闻名。
words.en: Potteries refer to objects made from clay and hardened by heat, or the place where such objects are made.

words.tr: n. 附加物；附属物；附属肢体
words.ex: The crab has an appendage that looks like a claw.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹有一个看起来像钳子的附属物。
words.en: An appendage is something that is joined to or connected with something larger or more important.

words.ex: The juridical system is complex and often confusing.
words.ex_cn: 司法系统复杂且常常令人困惑。
words.en: Relating to the administration of justice or the function of a judge or legal scholar.

words.ex: He is presently working at a bank.
words.ex_cn: 他现在在一家银行工作。
words.en: At the present time; now. Or in a short time; soon.

words.ex: He is expending all his money on books.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把所有的钱花在书上。
words.en: To spend or use up resources, time, or energy.

words.tr: adj. 受保护的； v. 保护；“protect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The protected forest is home to many rare animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个受保护的森林是许多稀有动物的家园。
words.en: If something is protected, it is kept safe from harm or damage.

words.tr: n. 拜物教；盲目崇拜；[医] 恋物癖
words.ex: He believes in fetishism, thinking that objects have special power.
words.ex_cn: 他相信拜物教，认为物体具有特殊的力量。
words.en: Fetishism is a form of sexual behavior in which gratification is linked to an abnormal degree to a particular object, item of clothing, part of the body, etc.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents every fortnight.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周拜访一次祖父母。
words.en: A fortnight is a period of two weeks.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.tr: adj. 折算的，修正的，校正的 v. 改正( correct的过去式和过去分词 ); [数学、物理
words.ex: The corrected score was posted on the board.
words.ex_cn: 修正后的分数被贴在了公告板上。
words.en: Adjusted or amended to be accurate or right; having mistakes rectified.

words.ex: The vagabonds slept under the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 这些流浪汉睡在桥下。
words.en: A vagabond is a person who wanders from place to place without a home or job.

words.tr:
adj. 季度的；
adv. 每季一次；
words.ex: The company releases its quarterly report every three months.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每三个月发布一次季度报告。
words.en: Something that happens quarterly happens four times a year, at intervals of three months.

words.tr: n. 殖民地开拓者，移民，殖民地居民( colonist的名词复数 )
words.ex: The colonists lived near the coast.
words.ex_cn: 殖民者住在沿海地区。
words.en: People who settle in a new country or region, often with the intention of developing it.

words.tr: v. 找回；重新获得；恢复；恢复( recover的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He recovered his lost wallet.
words.ex_cn: 他找回了丢失的钱包。
words.en: If you recover something that has been lost or stolen, you find it or get it back. If you recover from an illness or injury, you become well again.

words.ex: The class commenced at eight o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 课程八点开始。
words.en: To begin or start something.

words.tr: v. 投资；投入；“invest”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is investing money in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他正在投资一笔钱到一家小企业。
words.en: The act of committing money or capital to an endeavor with the expectation of obtaining an additional income or profit.

words.ex: My parents give me a weekly allowance.
words.ex_cn: 我父母每周给我零用钱。
words.en: An allowance is money that is given regularly, usually to a child, by their parents, or by the government to someone who is unemployed or ill.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.tr: n. 创造( creation的名词复数 ); 创造物; （尤指<圣经>所述由上帝）创造天地; 宇宙
words.ex: The artist made beautiful creations from clay.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家用泥土制作了美丽的作品。
words.en: The act of creating something, or something that has been created.

words.tr: v. 截断，缩短( curtail的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: His vacation was curtailed due to an emergency.
words.ex_cn: 由于紧急情况，他的假期被缩短了。
words.en: If you curtail something, you reduce or limit it.

words.tr: v. 超过，凌驾（surpass 的过去分词形式）
words.ex: He surpassed his brother in math scores.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学成绩超过了他哥哥。
words.en: If one person or thing surpasses another, the first is better than, or has more of a particular quality than, the second.

words.tr: v. 遗弃；抛弃；“abandon”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被遗弃了的；
words.ex: They abandoned the old car by the road.
words.ex_cn: 他们把那辆旧车遗弃在路边。
words.en: Left behind or deserted; given up.

words.ex: He walked backwards to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他向后走到门边。
words.en: If you move or look backwards, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

words.ex: I eat bread and eggs for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃面包和鸡蛋。
words.en: The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.

words.tr: v. 企图；试图；“attempt”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He attempted to steal the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他企图偷那辆自行车。
words.en: An attempted action is one that someone has tried to do but has not succeeded in doing.

words.ex: A multitude of people attended the festival.
words.ex_cn: 大量的人参加了这个节日。
words.en: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.ex: The music accompanies the dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐伴随舞蹈。
words.en: To go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort; to play a musical accompaniment for.

words.tr:
n. 权宜之计；应急办法
adj. 权宜的
words.ex: Closing the factory was an expedient to save money.
words.ex_cn: 关闭工厂是为了省钱的权宜之计。
words.en: An expedient action or solution to a problem is one that is convenient or practical, although it may not be morally right.

words.tr: v. 抛开；遗弃；废弃；“discard”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He discarded the old book.
words.ex_cn: 他扔掉了那本旧书。
words.en: If you discard something, you get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it.

words.ex: The fence separates the garden from the road.
words.ex_cn: 篱笆把花园和道路隔开。
words.en: To separate means to divide or keep apart; to set or keep apart from others.

words.ex: The movie was fantastic!
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极好！
words.en: If you describe something as fantastic, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good or that you like it a lot.

words.ex: He arrived unusually early for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他开会时到得不平常地早。
words.en: To an unusual degree; exceptionally.

words.tr:
prep. 不包括；除…外
v. 拒绝；排斥；排除；“exclude”的现在分词
words.ex: The company offers benefits to all employees, excluding part-timers.
words.ex_cn: 公司向所有员工提供福利，不包括兼职人员。
words.en: If you exclude someone or something, you deliberately do not include them in an activity or situation.

words.ex: There are plentiful apples in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 篮子里有丰富的苹果。
words.en: If something is plentiful, there is a lot of it available.

words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.ex: The officials announced a new policy.
words.ex_cn: 官员们宣布了一项新政策。
