words.ex: He hammered the nail into the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他把钉子敲进了木头里。
words.en: A nail is a thin pointed piece of metal that is hammered into materials as a fastener. It can also refer to the hard covering at the end of fingers and toes. As a verb, to nail means to fasten something with a nail or to catch or accomplish something successfully.

words.tr:
n. 供过于求；过量
v. 使充满；过量供应
words.ex: The market has a glut of cheap phones.
words.ex_cn: 市场上廉价手机泛滥。
words.en: An excessive supply of something, more than is needed, wanted, or can be used; to supply or fill to excess.

words.ex: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 狗把一根骨头埋在了花园里。
words.en: The hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates, composed chiefly of calcium salts.

words.tr:
v. 使翘棱；使扭曲变形
n. 弯曲；歪曲
words.ex: The heat will warp the metal.
words.ex_cn: 热量会使金属变形。
words.en: To warp is to bend or twist something out of its natural shape, often as a result of heat or moisture. It can also refer to the state of being bent or twisted.

words.tr:
adj. 黑暗的；暗色的；深色的；
n. 黑暗；夜；暗色；
words.ex: The room was dark after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间变得黑暗。
words.en: The absence of light in a place is referred to as dark. It can also describe something that is not light in color, or something that is mysterious or difficult to understand.

words.tr:
adj. 温暖的；
v. （使）变暖；
words.ex: The sun gives us warm light.
words.ex_cn: 太阳给我们温暖的光。
words.en: Having or giving out a moderate degree of heat, as perceived by the senses.

words.ex: He weaves jute into bags.
words.ex_cn: 他把黄麻织成袋子。
words.en: Jute is a long, soft, shiny vegetable fiber that can be spun into coarse, strong threads. It is produced from plants in the genus Corchorus, which is in the mallow family Malvaceae.

words.tr: adj. 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；
words.ex: The wise old man gave good advice.
words.ex_cn: 这位充满智慧的老人给出了很好的建议。
words.en: If you describe someone as wise, you mean that they have experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

words.ex: There is a hole in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一个洞。
words.en: A hole is an opening or hollow space in something solid, or a place in the ground that is deeper than the surface around it.

words.ex: Anne is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 安是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A female given name.

words.ex: Washing hands can kill germs.
words.ex_cn: 洗手可以杀死病菌。
words.en: A germ is a very small organism that causes disease.

words.tr:
n. 后部；
v. 饲养；抚养；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: The rear of the car was damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后部在事故中受损了。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; to bring up and care for a child until they are fully grown.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.ex: He pays 100 dollars per annum.
words.ex_cn: 他每年支付100美元。
words.en: A year, especially in reference to a financial or academic year.

words.tr: v. 哭泣；喊叫；吠；（鸟或其他动物）鸣，叫；（小贩）沿街叫卖（cry 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: The baby cried when she was hungry.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝饿的时候哭了。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of cry. To shed tears, especially as a result of strong emotion such as grief, sorrow, pain, or happiness. Also, to shout or scream, typically to express fear, pain, or grief.

words.tr: n. 君主；国王；（纸牌中的）老 K；君主，国王( king的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The kings ruled the land long ago.
words.ex_cn: 这些君主很久以前统治着这片土地。
words.en: A king is a man who is the most important member of the royal family of his country, and who is considered to be the Head of State of that country.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.ex: He gave a quick answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了一个快速的回答。
words.en: Moving fast or doing something in a short time.

words.ex: He was unfit for the job because he lacked experience.
words.ex_cn: 他因缺乏经验而不合格。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is unfit for a particular purpose or job, you are criticizing them because they are not good enough for that purpose or job.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.ex: The child was naked in the bathtub.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在浴缸里是裸体的。
words.en: If something is naked, it is not covered by anything such as clothes or paint.

words.ex: He is a maker of wooden chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他是木椅的制造者。
words.en: A maker is a person or company that makes or produces something.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.ex: My mother teaches me math every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上教我数学。
words.en: To impart knowledge or skill to someone through instruction or example.

words.ex: Children play different roles in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校的话剧中扮演不同的角色。
words.en: A role is a part that someone or something has in a particular situation, system, or process.

words.ex: The factory has a quota of 1000 units per day.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每天有1000件的配额。
words.en: A quota is the limited number or quantity of something which is officially allowed.

words.ex: The man was punished for fraud.
words.ex_cn: 这个人因欺骗而受到惩罚。
words.en: Fraud is the crime of gaining money or financial benefits by a trick or by lying.

words.ex: The blind man walks with a white cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位失明的男人用白色手杖走路。
words.en: Unable to see; lacking the sense of sight.

words.ex: The children are playing on the hills.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小山上玩耍。
words.en: Hills are areas of land that are higher than the land surrounding them but smaller and less steep than mountains.

words.tr:
n. 螺丝钉；
v. 拧紧；
words.ex: He tightened the screw with a screwdriver.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了螺丝钉。
words.en: A screw is a metal object similar to a nail, with a raised spiral line around it. Screws are used to fasten things together.

words.ex: She found lumps of sugar in the tea.
words.ex_cn: 她在茶里发现了几块糖。
words.en: A lump is a small, solid piece of something, often without a definite shape.

words.tr: adj. 武装的； v. “arm”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The armed soldiers marched through the town.
words.ex_cn: 武装的士兵穿过城镇。
words.en: Equipped with weapons, especially firearms.

words.ex: The wind blows hard in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天风刮得很猛。
words.en: To move air or wind; to cause something to move by the force of air or wind.

words.ex: Jacob is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 雅各布是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A male given name of Hebrew origin, meaning 'supplanter' or 'held by the heel'.

words.ex: The dog buried the bones in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 狗把骨头埋在了院子里。
words.en: The hard parts inside a human or animal that make up its skeleton.

words.ex: Louis is a common name in France.
words.ex_cn: n. 路易是法国常见的名字。
words.en: A male given name of French origin.

words.ex: The dog has eaten all the food.
words.ex_cn: 狗已经把所有食物吃光了。
words.en: The past participle of 'eat', used to describe something that has been consumed.

words.ex: He wears a blue shirt every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一件蓝色衬衫。
words.en: Has clothing or accessories on one's body; endures or tolerates.

words.ex: This movie is a horror genre film.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部恐怖类型影片。
words.en: A genre is a particular type of literature, painting, music, film, or other art form which people consider as a class because it has special characteristics.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.ex: The vacuum cleaner sucks up the dust.
words.ex_cn: 吸尘器吸走灰尘。
words.en: To draw into the mouth by contracting the muscles of the lips and mouth to make a partial vacuum; to be very bad or unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 一阵强劲的气流；爆炸；
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit the window.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风击中了窗户。
words.en: A blast is a sudden loud noise or a strong gust of wind. It can also refer to an explosion or the act of blowing something up. As a verb, it means to explode or to criticize severely.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.tr: v. 追溯到；“date”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 过时的；陈旧的；
words.ex: This coin is dated to the year 1500.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币追溯到1500年。
words.en: Something that is dated is old-fashioned and no longer relevant or useful.

words.tr: n. 基地；基础；根据；“basis”的复数；“base”的复数；
words.ex: The soldiers returned to their bases after the mission.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们完成任务后回到了他们的基地。
words.en: The plural form of 'base'; a foundation or starting point; a place used as a center of operations by the armed forces or others; to establish or found on a particular basis.

words.tr: n. 一页，页码；对开纸；对开本的书; adj. 对开的，对折的; vt. 编页码; n. （Fol...
words.ex: Please turn to the next folio.
words.ex_cn: 请翻到下一页。
words.en: A folio is a book or manuscript consisting of large sheets of paper folded in half to make two leaves or four pages.

words.ex: The doctor checked his skins for rashes.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的皮肤是否有皮疹。
words.en: The natural outer layer of a person's or animal's body.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put into as much as can be held.

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: The beast ran fast through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 那只野兽在森林里快速奔跑。
words.en: A beast is a large and dangerous animal.

words.ex: The nerve in his finger was damaged.
words.ex_cn: 他手指里的神经受到了损伤。
words.en: A nerve is a bundle of fibers that transmits impulses of sensation to the brain or spinal cord, and impulses from these to the muscles and organs. It also refers to the courage or control needed to do something difficult or dangerous.

words.ex: He uses logic to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用逻辑来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Logic is a method of reasoning that involves a series of statements, each of which must be true if the statement before it is true.

words.ex: The cat takes leaps over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳过篱笆。
words.en: A sudden and significant increase or improvement; a jump or spring.

words.ex: The roads are busy in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上的道路很繁忙。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.tr: adj. 古怪的；难以解释的
words.ex: He is queer and proud of who he is.
words.ex_cn: 他是同性恋，并为自己是谁而自豪。
words.en: Queer is used to describe something that is strange or unusual, or someone who is homosexual.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；废墟；“ruin”的复数； v. 毁灭；破坏；
words.ex: The war left the city in ruins.
words.ex_cn: 战争使这座城市化为废墟。
words.en: The remains of a building, city, etc., that has been destroyed or is in a state of decay.

words.ex: He misses his youth when he played football every day.
words.ex_cn: 他怀念每天踢足球的青春时光。
words.en: The period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young.

words.ex: He put on his glove before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打棒球前戴上了手套。
words.en: A glove is a piece of clothing which covers your hand and wrist and has individual sections for each finger.

words.ex: The merit of this plan is its simplicity.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划的优点是简单。
words.en: If something has merit, it has good or worthwhile qualities.

words.tr: adj. 装有弹簧的; v. 蹦跳；突然弹起；突然启动；惊起（猎鸟）；给……装上软垫；（米料）翘曲；...
words.ex: The chair had a sprung seat for added comfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子有一个装有弹簧的座位，以增加舒适度。
words.en: Sprung is the past tense and past participle of spring, which means to move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction, often by jumping.

words.tr: n. 君主的统治( reign的名词复数 ); 君主统治时期; 任期; 当政期
words.ex: The reigns of these kings lasted for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这些国王的统治持续了很多年。
words.en: Exercises control or authority, especially as a monarch or dominant force.

words.ex: He tried to resist the temptation to eat sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抵制吃甜食的诱惑。
words.en: If you resist something such as a change, you refuse to accept it and try to prevent it.

words.ex: The turner fixed the metal part on the lathe.
words.ex_cn: 车床工人把金属零件固定在车床上。
words.en: A turner is someone who operates a lathe or is skilled in turning wood or metal on a lathe.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: Fear drives him to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 恐惧驱使他更加努力工作。
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to compel or force someone to act in a particular way.

words.ex: He nailed the wood boards to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把木板钉在墙上。
words.en: Planks of wood; a group of people who manage or direct a company or organization; the stage in a theater.

words.ex: He will finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他会在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish something means to reach the end of it or to complete it.

words.tr:
n. 压力；（动植物的）品种；
v. 竭力；
words.ex: The job gave him a lot of strain.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作给他带来了很大的压力。
words.en: To strain means to make a great effort to do something, to pull or stretch something tightly, or to injure a muscle by stretching it too much.

words.ex: He devotes his time to helping children.
words.ex_cn: 他投入时间帮助孩子们。
words.en: If you devote yourself, your time, or your energy to something, you spend all or most of your time or energy on it.

words.tr: v. 同意；赞成；“agree”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 已一致的；同意的；
words.ex: We agreed to meet at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们同意下午五点见面。
words.en: If people are agreed, they have reached a joint decision on something or have the same opinion about something.

words.tr: v. 杀死； adj. 被杀死的，断开的 v. 杀死( kill的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The lion killed the deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子杀死了那只鹿。
words.en: If someone or something is killed, they are caused to die.

words.ex: We shall meet again on the morrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们将在次日再次见面。
words.en: The following day; tomorrow.

words.tr: v. 摇动；“shake”的过去分词； adj. 受惊吓的；
words.ex: He was shaken by the strong wind.
words.ex_cn: 他被强风摇动了。
words.en: If you are shaken, you are upset and unable to think calmly because of something that has happened.

words.ex: The children starve without food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们没有食物就会挨饿。
words.en: To suffer or die from lack of food.

words.ex: The trains arrive every hour.
words.ex_cn: 火车每小时到达一次。
words.en: To train means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills. It can also refer to a series of connected railway carriages or wagons moved by a locomotive or by integral motors.

words.ex: He bought two new shirts.
words.ex_cn: 他买了两件新衬衫。
words.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing that you wear on the upper part of your body. Shirts have a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

words.ex: He closes the door before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前关上门。
words.en: To (cause something to) change from being open to not being open, or to (cause something to) end.

words.ex: The farmer piled up fodder for the cows.
words.ex_cn: 农夫为奶牛堆了一堆饲料。
words.en: Fodder is food that is given to cows, horses, and other animals.

words.ex: The murder happened last night in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这起谋杀发生在昨晚的公园里。
words.en: Murder is the unlawful premeditated killing of one human being by another.

words.tr: n. 日内瓦（瑞士西南部城市）
words.ex: Geneva is known for its diplomatic history and international organizations.
words.ex_cn: 日内瓦以其外交历史和国际组织而闻名。
words.en: Geneva is a city in Switzerland that is known for its role as a global hub for diplomacy and banking.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.tr:
n. 吸引力；上诉；
v. 吸引；诉请；呼吁；
words.ex: The appeal of the beach drew many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. If you appeal against a decision or sentence, you formally ask a court or other authority to change it. If something appeals to you, you like it or it interests you.

words.ex: He drinks brandy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后喝白兰地。
words.en: Brandy is a strong alcoholic drink made from wine or fermented fruit juice.

words.tr:
adj. 最新的；最后的；最近的；
n. 最新事物；
words.ex: He bought the latest phone on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他买了市场上最新的手机。
words.en: The most recent or the newest.

words.ex: The romans built many roads and bridges.
words.ex_cn: 罗马人修建了许多道路和桥梁。
words.en: The term 'Romans' can refer to the people of ancient Rome or to a book in the New Testament of the Bible, which is a letter written by the Apostle Paul to the Christians in Rome.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.ex: The vendor sells fresh fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这个商贩在市场卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A vendor is a person or company that sells goods or services.

words.ex: The boiler heats water for the house.
words.ex_cn: 锅炉为房子加热水。
words.en: A boiler is a device that heats water or produces steam.

words.tr: n. 十分位（tenth 的复数形式）
words.ex: The price is five and three tenths dollars.
words.ex_cn: 价格是五点三美元。
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number ten in a series.

words.ex: She makes crafts with paper and glue.
words.ex_cn: 她用纸和胶水做手工艺品。
words.en: Crafts refer to activities involving the making of decorative or functional objects by hand, often using traditional techniques.

words.tr: v. 拉过来；拉( pull的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He pulled the chair closer to the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把椅子拉近了桌子。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of pull. To exert force on (someone or something) so as to cause movement towards oneself.

words.tr: adv. 一个一个地；单独地
words.ex: He solved the problems singly, without help.
words.ex_cn: 他独自解决了这些问题，没有帮助。
words.en: Individually; one by one.

words.ex: The dog is on a long chain.
words.ex_cn: 狗被一条长链拴着。
words.en: A chain consists of connected links, typically made of metal, used for fastening or securing something, or a series of connected things.

words.ex: Interest will accrue over time.
words.ex_cn: 利息会随着时间积累。
words.en: If money or interest accrues, it gradually increases in amount over a period of time.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.ex: She insists on going home now.
words.ex_cn: 她坚决要求现在回家。
words.en: If you insist on doing something, you keep doing it, even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.tr: v. 锻造；伪造；稳步前进
words.ex: He forges metal into beautiful tools.
words.ex_cn: 他把金属锻造成美丽的工具。
words.en: To forge means to make or shape something, especially metal, by heating it and hammering it. It can also mean to create something strong or lasting, or to move forward steadily.

words.tr: v. 抓住；赶上；“catch”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The boy caught a fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在河里抓到了一条鱼。
words.en: Caught is the past tense and past participle of catch, which means to seize or capture something or someone.

words.ex: His wisdom helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的智慧帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: Wisdom is the ability to use your knowledge and experience to make good decisions and judgments.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.tr: v. 暗指；（间接）提到；影射
words.ex: He alluded to the problem without naming it.
words.ex_cn: 他暗示了这个问题，但没有点明。
words.en: To allude to something means to mention it in an indirect way.

words.tr: adv. 公正地；正当地；应得地
words.ex: He was justly punished for lying.
words.ex_cn: 他因为撒谎而得到了应有的惩罚。
words.en: In a fair and deserved manner; rightly.

words.tr: n. 关税；税率；（旅馆、饭店等的）价目表
words.ex: The government raised the tariff on imported cars.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了进口汽车的关税。
words.en: A tariff is a tax that a government collects on goods coming into a country.

words.tr: n. （议会、法院等的）书记员；<美>店员；<英>办事员；<美>店员( clerk的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The clerks wrote down all the court proceedings.
words.ex_cn: 书记员记录了所有的法庭程序。
words.en: Clerks are people who work in offices or shops, performing tasks such as keeping records or serving customers.

words.ex: He hastened to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他赶紧在晚饭前写完作业。
words.en: If you hasten to do something, you quickly do it or quickly go somewhere.

words.ex: The family had a meagre meal with just bread and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭只吃了一顿贫乏的饭，只有面包和水。
words.en: If you describe an amount or quantity of something as meagre, you are critical of it because it is very small or not enough.

words.ex: He had to endure the cold winter without a coat.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不在没有外套的情况下忍受寒冷的冬天。
words.en: To endure means to suffer something difficult, unpleasant, or painful, or to continue to exist for a long time.

words.ex: She tied a red ribbon around the box.
words.ex_cn: 她把一条红色的带状物系在盒子上。
words.en: A ribbon is a long, narrow piece of cloth that you use for tying things together or as a decoration.

words.tr: v. 出现；起身；“arise”的过去分词；
words.ex: A problem has arisen during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议中出现了一个问题。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises, it begins to exist or people start to become aware of it.

words.tr: v. 连接；联系；“link”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two roads are linked by a bridge.
words.ex_cn: 两条路通过一座桥连接起来。
words.en: Connected or related to something else.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.ex: The river swells after the heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 大雨过后，河水上涨。
words.en: To increase in size or volume as a result of internal pressure; to become larger or more intense.

words.ex: He is laying the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把书放在桌子上。
words.en: To put something down, especially horizontally or in a flat position; to produce eggs; to prepare or make ready by putting something in position.

words.ex: He fulfilled his promise to help me.
words.ex_cn: 他履行了帮助我的承诺。
words.en: To fulfil means to do something that is expected, hoped for, or promised, or to cause it to happen.

words.tr: adj. 最老的；最旧的；最年老的；
words.ex: He is the oldest person in his family.
words.ex_cn: 他是家里最年长的人。
words.en: The superlative form of 'old', used to describe someone or something that is the most aged or has existed the longest among a group.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.ex: The tribes live in the forest far from cities.
words.ex_cn: 这些部落生活在远离城市的森林里。
words.en: A tribe is a social group consisting of people of the same race or nationality who share the same customs, traditions, and language.

words.tr: n. 反射动作；本能反应；反射作用；
words.ex: The knee jerk is a simple reflex.
words.ex_cn: 膝跳是一种简单的反射动作。
words.en: An automatic and often inborn response to a stimulus that typically involves a nerve impulse passing inward from a receptor to the spinal cord and then outward to an effector (as a muscle or gland) without reaching the level of consciousness.

words.ex: The children picked up sticks from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们从地上捡起了棍子。
words.en: A stick is a thin piece of wood that has fallen or been cut from a tree. Sticks are used for various purposes, such as fuel, for building, or for making things. In sports, a stick is a long, thin piece of wood that is used to hit or control the ball in games such as hockey or lacrosse.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.ex: He got good grades in math and science.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学和科学中取得了好成绩。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value that is used to classify or compare things. In education, it refers to the score or mark given to a student's work.

words.tr: adj. 静止的；不动的；休眠的；
words.ex: The resting lake reflected the sky.
words.ex_cn: 静止的湖面倒映着天空。
words.en: In a state of rest; not active or engaged in activity.

words.ex: The farmer works hard to sustain his crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民努力维持他的庄稼。
words.en: To sustain something means to continue it or maintain it for a period of time.

words.tr: n. （节目）重演( repeat的名词复数 ) v. 复述; 重做( repeat的第三人称单数
words.ex: The show will have repeats during the summer.
words.ex_cn: 这个节目将在夏季重播。
words.en: To do or say something again.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.ex: The hoarder's house was filled with stacks of newspapers and old magazines.
words.ex_cn: 囤积者的房子里堆满了成堆的报纸和旧杂志。
words.en: A hoarder is someone who collects large amounts of things and keeps them in a way that is not organized, often because they believe they may need them in the future.

words.tr: v. 使加倍；折叠； n. 双打；复制品（double 的复数）；
words.ex: The company doubles its profits every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年使利润翻倍。
words.en: Doubles refers to a game or match in which two players compete against two others, especially in tennis, badminton, or table tennis. It can also refer to a dance performed by two people together.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.tr:
adj. 意大利的；意大利人的；意大利语的；
n. 意大利语；意大利人；
words.ex: She loves italian food.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢意大利食物。
words.en: Of or relating to Italy, its people, or its language.

words.ex: The government is looking for ways to fill its coffers.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在寻找充实国库的方法。
words.en: Coffers refer to the financial resources or funds of an organization or government, often stored in a treasury or vault.

words.tr: n. 西里西亚（中欧一地区）
words.ex: Silesia is a historical region in Central Europe.
words.ex_cn: 西里西亚是中欧的一个历史地区。
words.en: Silesia is a historical region in Central Europe, now divided between Poland, the Czech Republic, and Germany.

words.ex: He stayed home because of illness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: An illness is a particular disease, especially one that is not very serious.

words.tr: n. 牧师（尤指英国国教的教区牧师）
words.ex: The parsons in the village were well-respected by the community.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的牧师们深受社区尊敬。
words.en: A parson is a member of the clergy, especially a Protestant minister in charge of a parish.

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；恒久的； v. 持续；“last”的现在分词；
words.ex: The friendship between them is lasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的友谊是持久的。
words.en: Something that is lasting continues to exist or have an effect for a very long time.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.ex: The quiet music was a prelude to the loud concert.
words.ex_cn: 轻柔的音乐是盛大音乐会的前奏。
words.en: A prelude is an introductory piece of music, event, or action that comes before a more important one.

words.ex: He was arrested for a serious offence.
words.ex_cn: 他因严重犯罪被逮捕。
words.en: An offence is a crime or a violation of a rule or law.

words.tr: v. 喜欢；享受；过得愉快；“enjoy”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I enjoyed the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚喜欢这部电影。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.ex: We can utilise this tool to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以使用这个工具来解决问题。
words.en: To utilise something means to use it for a particular purpose.

words.tr: v. 触摸；接触；触动；“touch”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He touched the warm cup with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手摸了摸温热的杯子。
words.en: If you are touched by something, it affects you emotionally, often making you feel grateful or sympathetic.

words.tr: n. 调查发现； v. 找到；发现；“find”的现在分词；
words.ex: The finding of the study surprised many scientists.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究的调查发现让许多科学家感到惊讶。
words.en: A finding is a discovery or conclusion reached as a result of an investigation or research.

words.ex: The new law gave impetus to environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 新法律为环境保护提供了推动力。
words.en: Something that gives a process impetus or an impetus makes it happen or progress more quickly.

words.ex: The poorest children need more help with food and school.
words.ex_cn: 最贫困的孩子需要更多的食物和教育帮助。
words.en: The superlative form of 'poor', meaning having the least amount of money or resources among a group, or being of the lowest quality.

words.tr: n. 持有者; 支持物( holder的名词复数 ); （支票等）持有人; 支托（或握持）…之物
words.ex: The holders of the debt will be repaid first.
words.ex_cn: 债务持有者将首先得到偿还。
words.en: Holders are people or things that hold something. In a broader sense, it can refer to the owner of a particular item or right, such as a stockholder or a ticket holder. It can also refer to a device or container that holds something in place.

words.ex: They shared secrets under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他们在树下分享秘密。
words.en: Information that is not known or seen by others.

words.ex: The car deviated from the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车偏离了道路。
words.en: To deviate means to do something that is different from the usual or common way of behaving.

words.ex: They decided to prolong the meeting by one hour.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定将会议延长一小时。
words.en: To prolong something means to make it last longer.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.ex: The storm is ruining the crops.
words.ex_cn: v. 风暴正在毁坏庄稼。
words.en: The act of destroying or severely damaging something.

words.tr: n. 分类； v. 分类；整理；“sort”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sorting of books by genre makes the library easier to use.
words.ex_cn: 按类型对书籍进行分类使图书馆更容易使用。
words.en: The act of separating things into different groups, types, or sizes.

words.ex: The robbers broke into the bank at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 强盗们在午夜闯入了银行。
words.en: Robbers are people who steal from others, often using force or threats.

words.tr: n. 锻炼，伪造 v. 伪造; 锻造( forge的现在分词 ); 艰苦干成; 努力加强
words.ex: He is forging a new path in his career.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为自己的职业生涯开辟一条新路。
words.en: Forging is the process of shaping metal using localized compressive forces. The blows are delivered with a hammer (often a power hammer) or a die. Forging is often classified according to the temperature at which it is performed: cold forging (a type of cold working), warm forging, or hot forging (a type of hot working). For the latter two, the metal is heated, usually in a forge. Forged parts can range in weight from less than a kilogram to hundreds of metric tons. Forging has been done by smiths for millennia; the traditional products were kitchenware, hardware, hand tools, edged weapons, cymbals, and jewelry.

words.ex: The building has a strong footing on solid ground.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑坐落在坚固的地基上。
words.en: The term 'footing' refers to the basis or foundation on which something is established or the relationship between people or groups.

words.ex: They went on a long journey by train.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘火车进行了一次长途旅行。
words.en: A journey is the act of traveling from one place to another, especially when this involves a long distance or a lot of time.

words.tr:
n. 收看（电视）；察看；观看；亲眼目睹的机会（尤指观看艺术作品）；
v. 考虑；估量；观察；查看；
words.ex: His daily viewing of news shows keeps him informed.
words.ex_cn: 他每天收看新闻节目以保持信息灵通。
words.en: The act of looking at or inspecting something; the act of watching television or a film.

words.ex: He tried to conceal the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图隐藏真相。
words.en: If you conceal something, you prevent it from being seen or known about.

words.tr: n. 额外费用；保险费；溢价；
words.ex: You need to pay a premium for faster delivery.
words.ex_cn: 你需要支付额外费用才能享受更快的配送。
words.en: A premium is an amount of money that you pay regularly to an insurance company for an insurance policy, or an amount of money that is more than usual for a product or service because it is of higher quality.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.ex: The children drew circles on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在纸上画了圈。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the center of the area.

words.ex: His pursuit of happiness made him work hard every day.
words.ex_cn: 他对幸福的追求让他每天努力工作。
words.en: The act of pursuing something or someone, especially in order to catch or achieve them.

words.ex: I cherish every moment with my family.
words.ex_cn: 我珍惜与家人在一起的每一个瞬间。
words.en: A moment is a very short period of time.

words.tr: adj. 随后的；后来的；接踵而至的； v. “ensue”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ensuing meeting was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 随后的会议被取消了。
words.en: Following immediately after something else.

words.ex: He is an earnest student who always finishes his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个认真的学生，总是完成作业。
words.en: If you are earnest about something, you are serious about it and your intentions are honest and sincere.

words.ex: The river has a large outflow into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这条河有大量的水流流入大海。
words.en: An outflow is an amount of something such as a liquid or gas that flows out from a place.

words.ex: She wears a necklace made of crystal.
words.ex_cn: 她戴一条水晶制成的项链。
words.en: A crystal is a solid that has a regular, repeating arrangement of atoms. Crystals are often transparent and can be used in jewelry or as decorative objects.

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.ex: He is an eminent scientist who won the Nobel Prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位获得诺贝尔奖的杰出科学家。
words.en: An eminent person is well-known and respected, especially because they are good at their profession.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗好的衣物； v. 洗；洗涤；“wash”的现在分词；
words.ex: She put the washing into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 她把要洗的衣物放进洗衣机里。
words.en: The act of cleaning something using water and usually soap or detergent.

words.ex: His actions showed he was serious.
words.ex_cn: 他的行动表明他是认真的。
words.en: The things that someone does in order to achieve a particular purpose or to deal with a situation.

words.ex: The government decided to abolish the old law.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定废除这项旧法律。
words.en: If someone in authority abolishes a system or practice, they formally put an end to it.

words.tr: v. 收拾行李；“pack”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is packing his bags for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为旅行收拾行李。
words.en: The act of putting things into cases or boxes for storage or transport.

words.tr: n. 雅各宾派成员；激进派
words.ex: The Jacobins played a significant role in the French Revolution.
words.ex_cn: 雅各宾派在法国大革命中扮演了重要角色。
words.en: A Jacobin is a member of a radical political group that was prominent during the French Revolution.

words.ex: Equating success with wealth can lead to dissatisfaction.
words.ex_cn: v. 将成功与财富等同可能导致不满。
words.en: To consider or make equal; to treat as equivalent.

words.ex: The teacher showed a specimen of a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一个蝴蝶标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single thing or example of something, especially one that is used to represent the whole group or type.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.ex: The child shows great vitality while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时充满活力。
words.en: Vitality refers to the state of being strong and active; energy.

words.tr: v. 剥去；strip“”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He stripped the old paint from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙上的旧漆剥掉了。
words.en: If something is stripped, it has been removed or taken away, often leaving the underlying layer or structure exposed.

words.tr: n. 赌博； v. “gamble”的现在分词；
words.ex: He lost all his money on gambling.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的钱都输在了赌博上。
words.en: Gambling is the act of betting money on the outcome of a game, a contest, or an uncertain event.

words.ex: He was a faithful disciple of the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是老师的一名忠实弟子。
words.en: A disciple is a follower or student of a teacher, leader, or philosopher.

words.ex: The eventual winner was a young student.
words.ex_cn: 最后的赢家是一位年轻学生。
words.en: An eventual event or situation happens at the end of a process or period of time.

words.tr: v. 提取（存款）；“withdraw”的过去式；
words.ex: He withdrew $200 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了200美元。
words.en: To remove or take away (something) from a particular place or position; to discontinue or stop participating in an activity or membership.

words.ex: They have many disputes about money.
words.ex_cn: 他们经常为钱发生争执。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.ex: The government has been criticized for its excesses in spending.
words.ex_cn: 政府因过度开支而受到批评。
words.en: Excesses refer to instances of exceeding the usual, proper, or necessary limit, often implying a lack of moderation or restraint.

words.tr: v. 覆盖；“cover”的现在分词； n. 遮盖物；
words.ex: The snow is covering the ground.
words.ex_cn: 雪覆盖着地面。
words.en: A covering is a layer of something that spreads over or encloses something else, often to protect it or hide it.

words.tr: v. 成功；继承；接着发生
words.ex: She succeeds in her new job.
words.ex_cn: 她在新工作中取得了成功。
words.en: To achieve the desired aim or result; to come after and take the place of someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 鲁莽的；不计后果的；
words.ex: He drove reckless and got into an accident.
words.ex_cn: 他开车鲁莽，结果出了事故。
words.en: If you say that someone is reckless, you mean that they act in a way which shows that they do not care about danger or the effect their behaviour will have on other people.

words.tr: v. 积累；增加；自然增长
words.ex: Interest is accruing on the savings account.
words.ex_cn: v. 储蓄账户上的利息在不断增加。
words.en: To increase or accumulate over time, especially in terms of money or benefits.

words.ex: The company made the adoption of new technology quickly.
words.ex_cn: 公司迅速采用了新技术。
words.en: The act of legally taking another's child and bringing it up as one's own, or the act of accepting something new.

words.ex: The accident was a serious incident.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是一起严重事件。
words.en: An incident is an event that is either unpleasant or unusual.

words.tr: adj. 延期的； v. “defer”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The payment is deferred until next month.
words.ex_cn: 付款被推迟到下个月。
words.en: Postponed or delayed.

words.tr:
adj. 跛腿的；残废的
v. 使成瘸子；严重损坏（削弱）；“cripple”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The crippled boy walked with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这个跛腿的男孩拄着拐杖走路。
words.en: If someone is crippled, they are severely injured or disabled, especially in a way that makes it difficult for them to walk or move.

words.tr: v. （使）流干；（使）逐渐流走；喝光；喝干； n. 排水，泄水，排泄 v. （使）流干， （使）逐渐流走( drain的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The sun was draining the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 太阳正在使水坑干涸。
words.en: If you say that something is draining, you mean that it makes you feel very tired and exhausted.

words.tr: v. 承诺；有希望；“promise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He promised to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮我做作业。
words.en: If you promise that you will do something, you say to someone that you will definitely do it.

words.ex: The statue embodies the spirit of freedom.
words.ex_cn: 这尊雕像体现了自由的精神。
words.en: To embody means to represent or express something in a tangible or visible form.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.tr: adj. 神秘的；神秘主义的
words.ex: The painting had a mystical quality that captivated viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有一种神秘的特质，令观众着迷。
words.en: If you describe something as mystical, you mean that it has spiritual qualities or that it involves spiritual powers and influences.

words.ex: He tries to simplify the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简化这个数学问题。
words.en: If you simplify something, you make it easier to understand or you remove the things that make it complex.

words.ex: The cows grazed peacefully in the pastures.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛在牧场上安静地吃草。
words.en: Pastures are areas of land covered with grass or other plants, used for grazing animals.

words.tr: v. 管理；设法做到；完成（困难的事）；“manage”的现在分词； adj. 经营的；善经营的；
words.ex: He is managing a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他正在管理一家小商店。
words.en: Managing refers to the process of dealing with or controlling things or people. It can also mean to succeed in doing something, especially something difficult.

words.tr: v. 批准；“approve”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 经核准的；被认可的；
words.ex: The teacher approved my project.
words.ex_cn: 老师批准了我的项目。
words.en: If something is approved, it has been officially agreed to or accepted.

words.tr: n. 利益；好处；“benefit”的复数； v. 有益于；有助于；
words.ex: The benefits of exercise are clear.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼的好处是显而易见的。
words.en: Benefits are advantages or profits that you get from something, especially advantages that you get from the government or from your employer, such as money or health insurance.

words.ex: She shortens her dress to make it more fashionable.
words.ex_cn: 她把她的裙子改短，使其更时尚。
words.en: To make something shorter in length, duration, or extent.

words.tr: adj. 假的；伪造的；欺骗性的；谬误的
words.ex: The data is spurious and cannot be trusted.
words.ex_cn: 这些数据是虚假的，不可信。
words.en: Something that is spurious seems to be genuine, but is false.

words.tr: v. 系上；附加；使相关；使依附；隶属于；“attach”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 附属的；附加的；依恋的；
words.ex: He attached the leash to the dog's collar.
words.ex_cn: 他把狗绳系在狗的项圈上。
words.en: If you say that one thing is attached to another, you mean that the two things are connected, either physically or because they are related in some way.

words.tr: n. 照明；灯光； v. “light”的现在分词；
words.ex: The room has good lighting.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间照明很好。
words.en: The arrangement or type of light in a place.

words.ex: The house has three bedrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有三间卧室。
words.en: The plural form of 'bedroom', referring to more than one room in a house or apartment used for sleeping.

words.ex: The universe may be infinite.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙可能是无限的。
words.en: If you describe something as infinite, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in amount or degree.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.ex: The coach used coercive methods to make players train harder.
words.ex_cn: 教练使用了强制性手段让球员更努力地训练。
words.en: Coercive actions or powers are used to force people to do things that they are unwilling to do.

words.tr:
n. 内部；
adj. 内部的；
words.ex: The interior of the house is very cozy.
words.ex_cn: 房子的内部非常舒适。
words.en: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

words.ex: He has an appetite for spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢辛辣食物。
words.en: A desire or liking for something, especially food.

words.tr: n. 打印机；印刷厂；“printer”的复数；
words.ex: The office bought three new printers.
words.ex_cn: 办公室买了三台新打印机。
words.en: A printer is a machine that prints text or pictures onto paper, especially one linked to a computer.

words.ex: The farmer fattened the pigs before the market.
words.ex_cn: 农民在上市前把猪养肥了。
words.en: To make or become fat or fatter, especially by feeding.

words.tr: adj. 受过教育的；有教养的； v. 教育；“educate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is an educated man who reads books every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个每天都读书的受过教育的人。
words.en: Having been educated; having received education.

words.tr: n. 自耕农阶层；义勇骑兵队
words.ex: The yeomanry played a crucial role in the local defense during the war.
words.ex_cn: n. 义勇骑兵队在战争中发挥了关键的本地防御作用。
words.en: The yeomanry refers to a class of small freeholding farmers or a volunteer cavalry force.

words.ex: She is pregnant and will have a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她怀孕了，下个月就要生宝宝了。
words.en: Having a baby developing in the uterus.

words.ex: He is still immature and often cries when upset.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然不成熟，生气时经常哭。
words.en: If you describe someone as immature, you are criticizing them because they do not behave in a sensible or responsible way, or because they have not developed emotionally or mentally to the level that is normal for their age.

words.ex: The concert was fabulous!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something as fabulous, you are emphasizing that you like it a lot or think that it is very good.

words.ex: We go to the beach during holidays.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去海滩。
words.en: Holidays are days when people do not go to work or school, especially because of a religious or national celebration.

words.tr: adj. 发烧的；紧张忙乱的；极度紧张（或兴奋）的
words.ex: He is feverish after running in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他在太阳下跑步后发高烧。
words.en: If you are feverish, you are suffering from a fever, or you are extremely excited or worried about something.

words.ex: The infantry marched through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 步兵穿过森林行进。
words.en: Infantry refers to soldiers who fight on foot, especially in contrast to cavalry or artillery.

words.ex: Monsieur Dupont is a distinguished guest.
words.ex_cn: 杜邦先生是一位尊贵的客人。
words.en: A title or form of address for a man, especially a Frenchman, corresponding to Mr. or sir.

words.ex: He made many mistakes in his math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中犯了很多错误。
words.en: An action or judgment that is misguided or wrong.

words.ex: The book contains esoteric ideas that only experts understand.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包含了只有专家才能理解的深奥思想。
words.en: Intended for or likely to be understood by only a small number of people with a specialized knowledge or interest.

words.tr: n. 沉淀物；沉淀物 v. 安排( settle的现在分词 )； v. 安家；安排；（使）安定；
words.ex: The settling at the bottom of the jar is normal.
words.ex_cn: 瓶底的沉淀物是正常的。
words.en: The process by which particles suspended in a fluid descend under the influence of gravity to form a sediment, or the act of resolving a dispute or reaching an agreement.

words.tr: adj. 未铸造的；非造币的；非虚构的
words.ex: The gold remained uncoined in the vault.
words.ex_cn: 金子仍然在保险库里未铸造。
words.en: Not made into coins; not fabricated or invented.
